title: Multimodal cell foundation models require synergistic integration beyond alignment
zh_title: 多模态细胞基础模型需协同整合
summary: 提出协同信息评分，量化跨模态交互带来的信息增益，指出仅对齐目标可能不足。
key_points: 提出基于部分信息分解的协同信息评分
分析冻结单模态专家组合式融合
标准对齐目标可能遗漏跨模态协同信息
reason: 同行评审方法学研究，提出新指标但无临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Integrating measurements across modalities and scales into unified quantitative frameworks of cellular function is a central goal in computational biology. Although powerful unimodal foundation models exist, the scarcity of large-scale paired data limits joint multimodal training. This constraint favours compositional foundation models, which fuse frozen unimodal experts through a learned interface. However, it remains unclear when such fusion provides task-relevant information beyond the strongest unimodal representation rather than merely aggregating redundant signal. Here we introduce Synergistic Information Score, a metric grounded in partial information decomposition that quantifies information gain arising only from cross-modal interactions. Extending theory from self-supervised learning, we show that standard alignment-based objectives with frozen encoders collapse to detect linear redundancies, which constrains their ability to capture nonlinear synergistic states. This distinction is especially important for tasks that connect tissue morphology with gene expression. Benchmarking ten fusion methods on spatial transcriptomics datasets, we demonstrate that tasks dominated by linear redundancies are well served by unimodal baselines, whereas complex niche definitions benefit from synergy-aware integration. Finally, we perform a scaling analysis and show that fine-tuning a dominant unimodal expert is the most sample-efficient strategy for standard tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in multimodal modelling of cellular state requires shifting from alignment-based objectives to synergy-driven integration that exploits complementary cross-modal signal. Richter et al. show that simply aligning different types of biological data does not fully integrate them, revealing when data repeat the same information and, conversely, when they provide complementary insights.
zh_abstract: 将跨模态和跨尺度的测量整合为统一的细胞功能定量框架是计算生物学的核心目标。尽管存在强大的单模态基础模型，但大规模配对数据的稀缺限制了联合多模态训练。这一限制有利于组合式基础模型，即通过学习到的接口融合冻结的单模态专家模型。然而，目前尚不清楚这种融合何时能提供超越最强单模态表示的任务相关信息，而不是仅仅聚合冗余信号。在此，我们引入协同信息评分（Synergistic Information Score），这是一种基于部分信息分解的指标，可量化仅由跨模态相互作用产生的信息增益。扩展自自监督学习的理论，我们表明，采用冻结编码器的标准基于对齐的目标会退化为检测线性冗余，这限制了其捕捉非线性协同状态的能力。这一区分对于将组织形态与基因表达联系起来的任务尤为重要。在空间转录组学数据集上对十种融合方法进行基准测试，我们证明，以线性冗余为主的任务可由单模态基线很好地胜任，而复杂的生态位定义则受益于协同感知的整合。最后，我们进行缩放分析并表明，微调占主导地位的单模态专家模型是标准任务中样本效率最高的策略。总之，这些结果表明，细胞状态多模态建模的进展需要从基于对齐的目标转向利用互补跨模态信号的协同驱动整合。Richter等表明，仅仅将不同类型的生物数据对齐并不能将其完全整合，这揭示了数据何时重复相同信息，以及反过来何时提供互补见解。

title: Artificial intelligence triages chest radiographs: Optimising diagnostic workflow efficiency in hospital settings.
zh_title: AI辅助胸片分诊优化院内诊断流程
summary: 叙述性综述汇总9国12项研究，显示AI胸片分诊可缩短报告周转时间，但下游诊断与患者结局证据不足。
key_points: 纳入2021年后获批的胸片分诊软件
含1项大型随机对照试验与多项前瞻研究
报告周转时间下降，患者结局证据欠缺
reason: 叙述性综述上限6分，含多国研究与RCT但结论有限
abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] This narrative review assesses the impact of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven chest radiograph (CXR) triage on the efficiency and accuracy of diagnostic workflows in hospital radiology departments. It includes regulatory-approved CXR triage software introduced since 2021 and evaluates key metrics such as sensitivity and report turnaround time in both real-world and simulated clinical environments. Twelve peer-reviewed studies, including single-centre and multicentre investigations across nine countries, were synthesised. AI-driven CXR triage detected selected critical abnormalities and prioritised urgent cases, with reductions in report turnaround time reported across workflow simulations, retrospective evaluations, prospective studies, and one large randomised controlled trial. However, evidence of improved downstream diagnosis or patient outcomes remains limited. Current evidence supports the potential clinical value of AI-driven CXR triage as adjuncts to radiologists and radiographers in hospital settings, demonstrating meaningful improvements in diagnostic efficiency and workflow performance. Continued large-scale, real-world validation, alongside attention to ethical, educational, and integration factors, is needed to support safe and sustainable adoption in radiographic practice. The findings of this review offer valuable insights to inform clinical workflows in hospitals worldwide, particularly those managing substantial CXR caseloads. AI-driven CXR triage should support the interpretation by reporting practitioners. Safe implementation requires local validation, integration with existing workflows, clear governance, staff education, and ongoing monitoring of diagnostic accuracy, reporting efficiency, and downstream patient outcomes. Because faster reporting does not necessarily accelerate diagnosis or treatment, adoption should be supported by coordinated pathway redesign and continued human oversight.
zh_abstract: [Radiography（London, England：1995）] 本叙述性综述评估人工智能（AI）驱动的胸部X线摄影（chest radiograph, CXR）分诊对医院放射科诊断工作流程效率和准确性的影响。它纳入自2021年以来引入的、经监管批准的 CXR 分诊软件，并评估关键指标，如敏感性和报告周转时间，涵盖真实世界和模拟临床环境。共综合了12项同行评审研究，包括来自9个国家的单中心和多中心研究。AI驱动的 CXR 分诊检测了选定的关键异常并优先处理紧急病例，在工作流程模拟、回顾性评估、前瞻性研究以及一项大型随机对照试验中均报告了报告周转时间缩短。然而，改善下游诊断或患者结局的证据仍然有限。当前证据支持 AI 驱动的 CXR 分诊作为医院环境中放射科医生和放射技师的辅助手段具有潜在临床价值，显示出诊断效率和工作流程性能的有意义改善。需要持续开展大规模、真实世界验证，同时关注伦理、教育和整合因素，以支持在放射学实践中安全且可持续地采用。本综述的发现提供了宝贵见解，可为全球医院的临床工作流程提供信息，尤其是那些管理大量 CXR 病例负荷的医院。AI驱动的 CXR 分诊应支持报告执业人员的判读。安全实施需要本地验证、与现有工作流程整合、清晰的治理、员工教育，以及对诊断准确性、报告效率和下游患者结局的持续监测。由于更快的报告并不一定加速诊断或治疗，采用应得到协调的路径重新设计和持续人工监督的支持。

title: Artificial intelligence in glaucoma diagnosis and management: a systematic review of the past decade (2015-2026).
source: PubMed · Expert review of medical devices
zh_title: 青光眼诊疗AI十年系统综述（2015-2026）
summary: 按PRISMA与PROSPERO注册流程系统检索，纳入63项同行评审研究，评估青光眼AI诊断与监测的证据及转化障碍。
key_points: 检索3758条记录，最终纳入63项同行评审研究
多数研究用深度学习处理眼底照相、OCT等影像
梳理数据集、验证策略与已报告局限
reason: 纳入63项研究的系统综述，证据梳理有价值，但综述类上限档为6
abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used to support glaucoma detection and monitoring, with rapid advances in deep learning, multimodal imaging, and longitudinal prediction. This review evaluates the evidence supporting these developments and identifies barriers to clinical translation. A systematic search of PubMed, IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and SpringerLink was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, with the protocol registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261450819). Of 3,758 records identified, 63 eligible peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2026 were included. The review examined AI techniques, imaging modalities, datasets, diagnostic and predictive performance, validation strategies, and reported limitations in Glaucoma care. Most studies used deep learning applied to fundus photography, optical coherence tomography (OCT), OCT angiography, visual fields, or multimodal data. Many models achieved an area under the ROC curve of approximately 0.95. AI has substantial potential to improve glaucoma detection and monitoring, but high reported accuracy alone does not establish clinical readiness. Prospective multicenter validation using diverse populations, explainable and reproducible models, standardized evaluation, and integration into clinical workflows are essential before widespread implementation.
zh_abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于支持青光眼检测和监测，深度学习、多模态成像和纵向预测方面进展迅速。本综述评估支持这些发展的证据，并识别临床转化的障碍。按照 PRISMA 指南对 PubMed、IEEE Xplore、ScienceDirect 和 SpringerLink 进行了系统检索，方案注册于 PROSPERO（CRD420261450819）。在识别的3,758条记录中，纳入2015年至2026年间发表的63项符合条件的同行评审研究。本综述考察了青光眼诊疗中的 AI 技术、成像模态、数据集、诊断和预测性能、验证策略以及已报告的局限性。大多数研究将深度学习应用于眼底摄影、光学相干断层扫描（OCT）、OCT 血管成像、视野或多模态数据。许多模型达到约0.95的 ROC 曲线下面积。AI 在改善青光眼检测和监测方面具有巨大潜力，但仅凭报告的高准确率并不能确立临床就绪性。在广泛实施之前，必须使用多样化人群进行前瞻性多中心验证、采用可解释和可复现的模型、标准化评估，并整合到临床工作流程中。

title: Artificial intelligence analysis of oral mucosal lesions in white-light clinical photographs: A systematic review of visual features and validation.
source: PubMed · European journal of oral sciences
zh_title: 口腔黏膜病变白光照片AI分析的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入53项研究，评估AI对口腔黏膜病变视觉特征的表达、性能、验证与可解释性。
key_points: 仅纳入白光临床照片直接分析的研究
46项采用隐式深度学习视觉表征
用PROBAST+AI与GRADE评估偏倚与证据确定性
reason: 纳入53项研究的系统综述含偏倚与证据分级，但纳入研究质量受限，综述上限档
abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to conventional oral photographs for recognition, classification, localization, segmentation, and risk assessment of oral mucosal lesions. This systematic review evaluated how clinically relevant visual information-including color, texture, morphology, borders, and spatial patterns-is represented by AI systems and assessed performance, validation, explainability, human comparison, and clinical translation. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for studies directly analyzing conventional white-light clinical photographs. Risk of bias was assessed with PROBAST + AI, and certainty with Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation-based approaches. Fifty-three studies were included, 30 published in 2025-2026. Forty-six used implicit deep-learning visual representations, three multimodal vision-language models, two explicit color analyses, and two explicit texture analyses. Thirty-one studies primarily addressed image-level diagnostic classification/recognition, 15 spatial detection/localization or lesion delineation, six screening/triage/referral or biopsy-oriented decision support, and one longitudinal malignant-transformation prediction. Six used independent external cohorts and five compared AI with human readers. Methodological concerns were frequent, no sufficiently coherent group supported meta-analysis, and certainty remained limited across evidence bodies. Current evidence therefore supports technical feasibility rather than established clinical effectiveness, with translation requiring stronger patient-level independence, external validation, prospective multicenter evaluation, and evidence of clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于常规口腔照片，用于口腔黏膜病变的识别、分类、定位、分割和风险评估。本系统综述评估了临床相关视觉信息——包括颜色、纹理、形态、边界和空间模式——如何被AI系统表示，并评估了性能、验证、可解释性、与人类比较以及临床转化。检索了PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar，以寻找直接分析常规白光临床照片的研究。使用PROBAST + AI评估偏倚风险，并使用基于推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation）的方法评估确定性。共纳入53项研究，其中30项发表于2025-2026年。46项使用隐式深度学习视觉表示，3项使用多模态视觉-语言模型，2项进行显式颜色分析，2项进行显式纹理分析。31项研究主要涉及图像级诊断分类/识别，15项涉及空间检测/定位或病变勾画，6项涉及筛查/分诊/转诊或面向活检的决策支持，1项涉及纵向恶性转化预测。6项使用独立外部队列，5项将AI与人类阅片者进行比较。方法学问题频繁存在，没有足够一致的研究组支持荟萃分析，且各证据体的确定性仍然有限。因此，当前证据支持技术可行性而非已确立的临床有效性，临床转化需要更强的患者层面独立性、外部验证、前瞻性多中心评价以及临床获益证据。

title: SeqSol-FECS: An Integrated Deep Learning and Structural Modeling Framework for Protein Solubility Engineering.
zh_title: SeqSol-FECS：蛋白可溶性预测与改造框架
summary: 基于71,425条蛋白序列训练的可溶性预测模型SeqSol，在独立测试集AUC 0.840并结合结构指标优先突变位点。
key_points: 71,425条蛋白数据训练序列级预测模型
独立测试集准确率75.8%、AUC 0.840
结合柔性、可及性与保守性优选突变位点
reason: 同行评审、大样本训练且独立测试含实验验证，但无公开代码或前瞻验证
abstract: [Biomacromolecules] Escherichia coli is widely used as a workhorse for heterologous protein expression. However, insoluble protein expression is frequently encountered. The mechanisms underlying protein solubility remain incompletely understood, limiting the effectiveness of current protein solubility engineering strategies. Here, SeqSol, a sequence-level solubility prediction model capable of prioritizing single-amino-acid substitutions through WT-mutant rescoring, was developed using 71,425 proteins. SeqSol achieved an accuracy of 75.8% and an AUC of 0.840 on an independent test set and correctly identified experimentally validated solubility-enhancing mutations from diverse proteins. To minimize the risk of activity loss, candidate mutation sites were prioritized according to conformational flexibility, relative solvent accessibility, and evolutionary conservation before solubility engineering. Using only 30 experimentally tested mutations, the resulting SeqSol-FECS framework increased the solubility of two industrial enzymes from 56.18% and 10.53% to over 95%, respectively, while maintaining their specific activities. SeqSol-FECS provides an efficient strategy for enzyme solubility engineering and biomanufacturing applications.
zh_abstract: [Biomacromolecules] 大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）被广泛用作异源蛋白表达的“主力”宿主。然而，经常遇到不溶性蛋白表达。蛋白溶解性的潜在机制仍不完全清楚，限制了当前蛋白溶解性工程策略的有效性。在此，我们利用71,425种蛋白开发了SeqSol，一种序列水平溶解性预测模型，能够通过野生型-突变体重打分（WT-mutant rescoring）对单氨基酸替换进行优先级排序。SeqSol在独立测试集上达到75.8%的准确率和0.840的AUC，并正确识别了来自多种蛋白的经实验验证的溶解性增强突变。为尽量降低活性丧失风险，在进行溶解性工程之前，根据构象柔性、相对溶剂可及性和进化保守性对候选突变位点进行优先级排序。仅使用30个实验测试突变，所得的SeqSol-FECS框架将两种工业酶的溶解性分别从56.18%和10.53%提高到95%以上，同时保持其比活性。SeqSol-FECS为酶溶解性工程和生物制造应用提供了一种高效策略。

title: π-SPECFormer: A Mass Spectrometry-based Foundation Model for Decoding the Dark Proteome
zh_title: π-SPECFormer：质谱基础模型解码暗蛋白质组
summary: 在2.91亿张质谱上预训练的基础模型，迁移至从头肽段测序、谱聚类与修饰检测，并优于任务专用基线。
key_points: 两阶段自监督与PSM引导预训练
预训练规模达2.91亿张质谱
三任务迁移均优于专用基线
reason: 大规模质谱基础模型且多任务迁移优于基线，预印本属重要档
abstract: In mass-spectrometry-based proteomics, a substantial proportion of acquired spectra remain unidentified, concealing a vast reservoir of biological variations commonly termed the "dark proteome", potentially obscuring sequence mutations, non-canonical peptides and post-translational modifications. Existing deep-learning methods largely rely on supervised training with peptide-spectrum matches (PSMs), limiting their ability to learn from the much larger pool of unannotated spectra. Here we introduce {pi}-SPECFormer, a mass-spectrometry foundation model pre-trained on 291 million spectra through a two-stage framework that combines self-supervised and PSMs-guided representation learning. {pi}-SPECFormer transfers effectively to de novo peptide sequencing, spectrum clustering and modification detection, consistently outperforming task-specific baselines. When applied to proteomic profiles from 103 individuals with lung adenocarcinoma, the model identified nine high-confidence mutated peptides, including six that were absent from the reference databases. {pi}-SPECFormer thus enables unbiased decoding of molecular complexity beyond the boundaries of the canonical proteome.
zh_abstract: 在基于质谱的蛋白质组学中，相当一部分采集到的谱图仍未被鉴定，隐藏着大量通常称为“暗蛋白质组”的生物学变异，可能掩盖序列突变、非经典肽和翻译后修饰。现有深度学习方法主要依赖使用肽段-谱图匹配（PSMs）的监督训练，限制了其从更大规模未注释谱图池中学习的能力。在此，我们提出 {pi}-SPECFormer，一个质谱基础模型，通过结合自监督和 PSMs 引导表征学习的两阶段框架在 2.91 亿张谱图上预训练。{pi}-SPECFormer 可有效迁移至从头肽段测序、光谱聚类和修饰检测，并持续优于任务特定基线。应用于 103 名肺腺癌个体的蛋白质组谱时，该模型鉴定出 9 个高置信度突变肽，其中 6 个在参考数据库中不存在。因此，{pi}-SPECFormer 能够实现超越经典蛋白质组边界的分子复杂性无偏解码。

title: Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study
zh_title: 通用生成式AI能否为医学影像模型供训练数据
summary: 回顾性研究用生成模型合成医学影像训练诊断模型，并在真实数据上外部验证。
key_points: 覆盖胸片、眼底、CT与颈动脉超声四模态
仅用合成数据训练的模型在真实数据外部验证
肺炎任务AUROC 0.877（n=14863）
reason: 预印本但多模态合成数据训练并在真实数据外部验证，样本量大
abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.
zh_abstract: 【背景】标注良好且多样化的医学影像数据集仍是基于视觉的医学AI的主要制约因素。我们评估了 Nano Banana——一种通用图像生成与编辑模型——作为合成医学图像来源，用于模型训练、亚组增强和模型审计。【方法】在这项横跨四种影像模态的回顾性研究中，胸部X线摄影、眼底摄影和CT模型仅使用合成图像训练，并在真实世界数据上针对真实数据训练的模型进行外部验证。颈动脉超声模型在私有的 Human Phenotype Project 队列（年龄40-75岁）中训练，分别采用和不采用合成数据增强。临床医生对图像合理性进行评分。评估使用 AUROC、AUPR、校准和决策曲线分析。【发现】仅使用合成数据的模型在肺炎（n=14863）中达到AUROC 0.877（95% CI 0.843-0.910），在视网膜脱离（n=1149）中为0.963（0.948-0.975），在肾结石（n=4122）中为0.711（0.600-0.823），与真实数据训练的模型相当，但其校准和净获益并非始终更有利。采用合成与真实数据混合训练时，颈动脉超声模型产生一个序数血管年龄指数，将633名外部受试者分层为BMI和血糖不同的亚组（两者p<0.01），将血管老化与心脏代谢健康联系起来。为压力测试捷径学习，将中等程度的镶嵌图案编辑进眼底照片，使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变的真类概率从0.996降至0.822。临床医生引导的编辑将低质量CT的合理性评分从3.10/5提高到4.30/5。【解读】合成数据可在模型训练、亚组代表性和通过受控编辑进行模型测试方面补充真实数据，但其临床价值应通过校准、决策曲线分析和临床医生审查来评估，而不仅仅是区分度。

title: ICare-DT: a digital twin for continuous forecasting of intensive care patients
zh_title: ICare-DT：ICU患者持续预测数字孪生
summary: 基于Transformer的数字孪生按小时用新测量更新患者隐状态，在eICU-CRD训练并在MIMIC-IV外部验证仍保持增益。
key_points: 训练集为140,473例eICU-CRD住院记录
12个设定中后续预测均优于自身第6小时预测
无需重训即在MIMIC-IV 9个设定中8个保持增益
reason: 大样本且跨数据库外部验证并设预设评价，但为预印本且仅预测生命体征，属重要档
abstract: Digital twins of intensive care patients should update forecasts from new data and predict treatment responses, but few studies test whether routine records support either. We propose ICare-DT, a Transformer-based twin that updates a latent patient state hourly from new measurements without retraining. We trained it on 140,473 eICU-CRD stays to forecast vital signs crossing their training-set means. On test data, later forecasts beat the twin's own hour-6 forecasts of the same windows in all 12 settings (+0.073 to +0.153 AUROC). On validation data, controls that withheld or swapped the new hours traced the gain to the patient's own measurements. Without refitting, the model kept its gain on a second database (8 of 9 settings, +0.025 to +0.114 AUROC) in a prespecified evaluation of the previously analyzed MIMIC-IV test split. Refitted within MIMIC-IV, a twin state fine-tuned on clinical endpoints gave gradient boosting a significant gain for acute kidney injury (+0.0035 AUROC; hypotension +0.0010, not significant). To test response prediction, we built a benchmark that replaces the treatments in real records with simulated doses and injects responses of known size, visible only at measurement times. Ridge models supervised with injected effects recovered them from real records only through frequently measured variables (heart rate) read at their measurement times. We asked standard learners to predict these effects for a dosing regime no patient had received. No standard learner outperformed predicting zero effect at an out-of-support query. When told how the simulated responses were generated, a separate learner recovered the effects from the same records without seeing their true values (R2 0.30 to 0.40 at one effect size). Routine records support forecasts that improve with each patient's new data, and our benchmark is a testbed for models that learn how responses are generated.
zh_abstract: 重症监护患者的数字孪生应能根据新数据更新预测，并预测治疗反应，但很少有研究检验常规记录是否支持这两者。我们提出 ICare-DT，一种基于 Transformer 的孪生模型，可在不重新训练的情况下，根据新测量值每小时更新一次潜在患者状态。我们在 140,473 次 eICU-CRD 住院记录上训练它，以预测生命体征跨越其训练集均值。在测试数据上，较晚的预测在所有 12 种设置中均优于该孪生模型自身对相同窗口的第 6 小时预测（AUROC +0.073 至 +0.153）。在验证数据上，扣留或替换新增小时数据的对照实验将增益归因于患者自身的测量。在事先设定、针对此前已分析的 MIMIC-IV 测试划分的评估中，模型无需重新拟合就在第二个数据库上保持了增益（9 种设置中的 8 种，AUROC +0.025 至 +0.114）。在 MIMIC-IV 内重新拟合时，一个在临床终点上微调的孪生状态使梯度提升（gradient boosting）在急性肾损伤上获得显著增益（AUROC +0.0035；低血压 +0.0010，不显著）。为检验反应预测，我们构建了一个基准，将真实记录中的治疗替换为模拟剂量，并注入已知大小的反应，这些反应仅在测量时点可见。用注入效应监督的 Ridge 模型只能通过在其测量时点读取的频繁测量变量（心率）从真实记录中恢复这些效应。我们让标准学习器预测一种没有任何患者接受过的给药方案下的这些效应。在超出支持范围的查询上，没有任何标准学习器优于预测零效应。当被告知模拟反应是如何生成时，一个单独的学习器在未看到真实值的情况下从相同记录中恢复了这些效应（在一种效应量下 R2 为 0.30 至 0.40）。常规记录支持预测，且这些预测会随每位患者的新数据而改善；我们的基准是用于学习反应如何生成的模型的测试平台。

title: AI-Based Tools for Stroke Diagnosis, Treatment and Outcome Prediction: a Multicentre Prospective Observational Study
zh_title: AI卒中诊疗与预后多中心前瞻观察研究
summary: UMBRELLA-P在6国7家大学医院前瞻纳入1万例疑似卒中患者评估AI工具。
key_points: 多中心前瞻观察设计，计划入组10000例
覆盖院前、院内、院后全流程数据

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Hospital Universitari Vall d'Hebron Research Institute; conditions: Stroke, Ischemic Stroke, Intracerebral Hemorrhage, Transient Ischemic Attack, Atrial Fibrillation; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 10000; status: RECRUITING] Stroke is a leading cause of death and adult disability. Stroke care is still limited by fragmented care pathways, non-standardised diagnostic work-up and follow-up, and local, non-interoperable data systems across the pre-hospital, in-hospital and post-hospital settings. UMBRELLA-P is a multicentre, prospective, observational study in 7 university hospitals in 6 European countries (Spain, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland). Adults with clinically suspected acute stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) are managed according to standard of care. Routine clinical, imaging, laboratory, ECG and patient-reported data are collected, pseudonymised, stored on a dedicated server at each hospital and harmonised to the OMOP Common Data Model. The harmonised data form a federated real-world data platform (U-Platform). On this platform, artificial intelligence (AI) models are trained and validated through federated learning, so that no patient data leave the participating sites. The models aim to predict short- and long-term outcomes, reduce time to treatment, and support diagnosis, triage, discharge, follow-up and secondary prevention. Five clinical sub-studies address pre-hospital triage, fast track to reperfusion, emergent intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) management, TIA/minor stroke, and cardiac evaluation with blood biomarkers. The study is observational. The outputs of the AI models are used for research only and will not influence clinical decisions. Participants are followed for up to 12 months.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Hospital Universitari Vall d'Hebron Research Institute；疾病：卒中、缺血性卒中、脑出血、短暂性脑缺血发作、心房颤动；类型：观察性；入组人数：10000；状态：招募中] 卒中是导致死亡和成人残疾的主要原因。卒中诊疗仍受到以下因素限制：碎片化的诊疗路径、非标准化的诊断检查和随访，以及院前、院内和院后环境中各自独立、不可互操作的数据系统。UMBRELLA-P是一项多中心、前瞻性、观察性研究，在6个欧洲国家（西班牙、意大利、比利时、荷兰、德国和瑞士）的7所大学医院开展。临床疑似急性卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）的成人按标准诊疗进行管理。常规临床、影像、实验室、心电图和患者报告数据被收集、假名化、存储在各医院专用服务器上，并统一映射到OMOP Common Data Model。统一后的数据构成联邦式真实世界数据平台（U-Platform）。在该平台上，人工智能（AI）模型通过联邦学习进行训练和验证，因此没有患者数据离开参与站点。这些模型旨在预测短期和长期结局、缩短至治疗的时间，并支持诊断、分诊、出院、随访和二级预防。五项临床子研究涉及院前分诊、再灌注快速通道、急诊脑出血（ICH）管理、TIA/轻型卒中，以及采用血液生物标志物进行心脏评估。该研究为观察性研究。AI模型的输出仅用于研究，不会影响临床决策。参与者随访长达12个月。

title: Predictive Analytics and Workflow Automation to Reduce Administrative Burden and Clinician Burnout in United States Clinical Settings: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Advances in health information science and practice

summary: 系统综述考察预测分析与工作流自动化（含环境AI记录、收件箱优先级排序）对美国临床医生行政负担与倦怠的影响。

abstract: [Advances in health information science and practice] Electronic health record (EHR)-related administrative burden remains a frequently cited contributor to clinician burnout in the United States. Although digital systems were implemented to improve quality, safety, and care coordination, expanded documentation requirements, inbox messaging, and regulatory reporting have increased clerical workload. Traditional interruptive clinical decision support tools may further increase cognitive demands through alert fatigue and workflow disruption. Health systems have increasingly adopted predictive analytics and workflow-integrated automation, including ambient artificial intelligence (AI) documentation, inbox prioritization, and audit log-based workflow monitoring. However, their effects on operational efficiency and clinician well-being remain uncertain. This review examined clinician-facing interventions in US clinical settings and their impact on documentation workload, operational efficiency, and burnout-related outcomes. A systematic review guided by Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses was conducted using PubMed, CINAHL, and Embase. The search included English-language studies published between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2025, with an updated search capturing eligible early online publications through 2026. Eligible studies evaluated clinician-facing predictive analytics or workflow automation in US clinical settings and reported measurable outcomes, including documentation time, after-hours EHR use, alert burden, cognitive task load, productivity, or validated burnout measures. Findings were synthesized narratively because interventions and outcome measures varied. Of 520 records identified, 173 unique records were screened; 24 (13.9%) underwent full-text review, and 7 of 24 (29.2%) met inclusion criteria. Ambient AI documentation platforms were associated with approximately 10%-30% reductions in documentation time, although findings on after-hours EHR activity varied. Several multisite implementations reported improvements in validated burnout measures and cognitive task load. AI-driven inbox prioritization reduced message review time, while audit log-based clinical decision support monitoring identified changes in EHR activity patterns following intervention. Evidence quality varied, and follow-up periods were generally short. zh_abstract: [健康信息科学与实践进展] 在美国，与电子健康记录（EHR）相关的行政负担仍是临床医生职业倦怠的常见原因之一。尽管实施数字系统旨在改善质量、安全性和照护协调，但扩大的记录要求、收件箱消息和监管报告增加了文书工作量。传统的干扰性临床决策支持工具可能通过警报疲劳和工作流程中断进一步增加认知需求。卫生系统越来越多地采用预测分析和整合到工作流程中的自动化，包括环境人工智能（AI）记录、收件箱优先级排序和基于审计日志的工作流程监测。然而，它们对运营效率和临床医生福祉的影响仍不确定。本综述考察了美国临床环境中面向临床医生的干预措施及其对记录工作量、运营效率和职业倦怠相关结局的影响。按照系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses）指南，使用 PubMed、CINAHL 和 Embase 进行了系统综述。检索包括 2019 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日发表的英文研究，并通过更新检索纳入截至 2026 年的符合条件的早期在线发表。符合条件的研究评估了美国临床环境中面向临床医生的预测分析或工作流程自动化，并报告了可测量结局，包括记录时间、非工作时间 EHR 使用、警报负担、认知任务负荷、生产力或经过验证的倦怠测量指标。由于干预措施和结局指标各异，结果以叙述性方式综合。在识别出的 520 条记录中，筛选了 173 条唯一记录；24 条（13.9%）接受了全文审查，24 条中的 7 条（29.2%）符合纳入标准。环境 AI 记录平台与记录时间约减少 10%-30% 相关，尽管关于非工作时间 EHR 活动的发现不一。若干多中心实施报告了经过验证的倦怠测量指标和认知任务负荷的改善。AI 驱动的收件箱优先级排序减少了消息审阅时间，而基于审计日志的临床决策支持监测识别出干预后 EHR 活动模式的变化。证据质量不一，且随访期通常较短。整合到工作流程中的预测分析和自动化干预与文档工作量和 s 的可测量改善相关

title: Artificial intelligence for cerebrovascular digital subtraction angiography: methods, evidence, and challenges.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 脑血管DSA的人工智能：方法、证据与挑战
summary: 结构化综述梳理AI在脑血管数字减影血管造影中的方法、现有证据与验证挑战。
key_points: 覆盖2D DSA、三维旋转造影与4D DSA
文献经Web of Science等数据库筛选

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍然是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，在诊断、介入治疗计划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管DSA，但现有证据分散在不同的成像环境、技术任务、数据集和验证策略中。这篇结构化专题综述以DSA为中心，概述了二维DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维DSA中AI辅助的脑血管图像分析。使用预定义的纳入标准，在标题、摘要和全文层面筛选了来自Web of Science核心合集和主要工程数据库的文献。文献围绕六个相互关联的任务组织：图像预处理、血管和病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测以及血流动力学分析。综述了代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法，以及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计和可用的数据或代码资源，特别关注支持证据的优势和局限性。近期研究表明，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的使用日益增加，但临床转化仍受限于小型或单中心数据集、异质的采集方案和评价实践、有限的外部验证和前瞻性验证、模型可解释性以及部署要求。未来的工作应强调采集感知和物理信息建模、多中心和隐私保护协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程的更紧密结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持证据和转化挑战联系起来，本综述旨在支持开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管DSA AI方法。

title: Standardising ocular surface photography for artificial intelligence: current limitations and a proposed roadmap.
source: PubMed · Progress in retinal and eye research

summary: 综述评述眼表摄影缺乏标准化采集与处理规范的问题，并提出面向AI应用的标准化路线图。

abstract: [Progress in retinal and eye research] Slit-lamp colour photography remains a cornerstone of anterior segment documentation and longitudinal monitoring. However, conventional slit-lamp photography has seen relatively limited technological advancement compared with the rapid development of quantitative anterior-segment modalities such as AS-OCT, Scheimpflug tomography and confocal microscopy. Despite the wide diffusion of digital cameras, smartphones, and high-end slit-lamp systems, ocular surface photography (OSP) remains hampered by the absence of standardised acquisition and processing protocols. The convex, aspheric geometry of the ocular surface, off-axis illumination, peripheral defocus, automatic colour correction, and pupil-driven exposure variation in retroillumination limit reproducibility, inter-device comparability, and clinical utility. In this review we critically appraise current OSP applications across major ocular surface conditions (dry eye disease, conjunctival hyperaemia, infectious keratitis, ocular surface burns, and ocular surface neoplasia), mapping the hardware, software, and reproducibility limitations that constrain clinical practice. We then examine how these limitations propagate into artificial intelligence (AI) development, where the absence of large, well-annotated, demographically diverse OSP datasets, together with the lack of reproducible quantitative phenotypes and reliable labels, is now the principal bottleneck to clinically deployable models; we discuss patient-level data partitioning and external validation, and outline how deep learning, federated learning and foundation models can both utilise and improve OSP. Finally, we propose a minimum acquisition and dataset specification, tiered by clinical setting from research to community screening, and a staged roadmap that combines hardware standardisation (focus-stacked, illumination-controlled, colour-calibrated acquisition), interoperable metadata-rich storage (DICOM where infrastructure permits), quantitative phenotype definition, and diverse international dataset collaborations, so that the ocular surface can benefit from quantitative imaging and AI as other areas of ophthalmology have begun to.
zh_abstract: [视网膜与眼科学研究进展] 裂隙灯彩色摄影仍然是前节记录和纵向监测的基石。然而，与 AS-OCT、Scheimpflug 断层成像和共聚焦显微镜等定量前节模态的快速发展相比，传统裂隙灯摄影的技术进步相对有限。尽管数码相机、智能手机和高端裂隙灯系统广泛普及，眼表摄影（ocular surface photography, OSP）仍因缺乏标准化的采集和处理方案而受限。眼表的凸面、非球面几何形态，离轴照明，周边离焦，自动色彩校正，以及后照法中由瞳孔驱动的曝光变化，限制了可重复性、设备间可比性和临床效用。在本综述中，我们批判性评价当前 OSP 在主要眼表疾病（干眼病、结膜充血、感染性角膜炎、眼表烧伤和眼表肿瘤）中的应用，梳理限制临床实践的硬件、软件和可重复性局限。随后，我们审视这些局限如何传导至人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）开发；在此，缺乏大型、注释良好、人口学多样化的 OSP 数据集，以及缺乏可重复的定量表型和可靠标签，现已成为临床可部署模型的主要瓶颈；我们讨论患者级数据划分和外部验证，并概述深度学习、联邦学习和基础模型如何既能利用 OSP，又能改进 OSP。最后，我们提出最低采集和数据集规范，按从研究到社区筛查的临床场景分层，并提出分阶段路线图，结合硬件标准化（焦点堆叠、照明控制、色彩校准的采集）、可互操作且富含元数据的存储（在基础设施允许时使用 DICOM）、定量表型定义以及多样化国际数据集合作，使眼表能够像眼科其他领域已经开始的那样，从定量成像和 AI 中获益。

title: EvoXRare AI-Assisted Interpretation of Emergency Chest Radiographs
zh_title: EvoXRare：急诊胸片AI辅助判读的实用随机试验
summary: 华中科技大学同济医院注册一项7万例实用随机试验，评估EvoXRare胸片AI草稿报告与高危提示能否减少急诊重要漏诊。
key_points: 注册为干预性实用随机对照试验，计划入组7万例
AI提供胸片报告草稿并对少见重要异常发出预警
主要关注急诊高负荷下的重要诊断漏诊
尚未开始招募，无任何结果数据
reason: 大规模实用RCT设计且以临床漏诊为结局，但仅注册无结果，属值得关注档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Emergency and Critical Care, Chest Radiography, Diagnostic Error, Thoracic Abnormalities; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE1; enrollment: 70000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Chest radiography is widely used in emergency departments, resuscitation rooms, intensive care units, and other acute-care settings. Clinically important abnormalities may be missed because findings are subtle, uncommon, obscured by overlapping anatomy, or encountered under high workload. This pragmatic randomized trial evaluates whether EvoXRare, an artificial intelligence system that provides a draft chest radiograph report and high-risk alerts for uncommon or clinically important abnormalities, reduces clinically important diagnostic misses compared with routine physician interpretation alone. Approximately 70,000 adults will be randomized 1:1 across 15-20 hospitals in China. The primary endpoint is the patient-level rate of clinically important abnormalities present on the reference standard but not reported in the initial clinical interpretation. Key secondary outcomes include detection of rare or easily missed findings, time to recognition of critical abnormalities, report turnaround time, false-positive alerts, additional imaging, recall/communication events, and selected short-term clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院；疾病/状况：急诊与重症监护、胸部X线摄影、诊断错误、胸部异常；类型：干预性；阶段：PHASE1；入组人数：70000；状态：尚未招募] 胸部X线摄影广泛用于急诊科、复苏室、重症监护病房和其他急性照护环境。临床重要异常可能因表现细微、不常见、被重叠解剖结构遮挡或在高工作负荷下遇到而被漏诊。这项实用性随机试验评估 EvoXRare（一种人工智能系统，可提供胸部X线摄影报告草稿，并针对不常见或临床重要异常发出高风险警报）与仅由医生进行常规判读相比，是否减少临床重要诊断遗漏。约 70,000 名成人将在中国的 15-20 家医院按 1:1 随机分配。主要终点是患者层面，参考标准中存在但初始临床判读中未报告的临床重要异常发生率。关键次要结局包括罕见或易漏发现的检出、关键异常的识别时间、报告周转时间、假阳性警报、额外影像检查、召回/沟通事件以及选定的短期临床结局。

title: Large Language Model Risk of Bias Assessment for Studies in Environmental Health: Proof-of-Concept Study.
zh_title: 大模型评估环境健康研究偏倚风险的概念验证
summary: 用GPT-5-mini对128项观察性研究做偏倚风险评估，检验LLM在系统综述中的准确性。
key_points: 以NavGuide工具问题+全文相关段落为输入
样本为PFAS与健康结局综述的128项研究
旨在减少综述偏倚评估的人力与不一致
reason: 同行评审的概念验证评测，样本128项、任务明确，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] The assessment of the risk of bias (RoB) of each study is a necessary but labor-intensive step in conducting a systematic review (SR). There is a potential for AI to reduce the time and effort needed for RoB assessment and improve consistency between reviewers, but little is known about the accuracy of AI-based RoB assessments. In this study, we aim to evaluate the performance of a large language model (LLM) when given the questions from the RoB tool and the relevant passages from the full-text papers in assessing RoB in observational studies of environmental exposures and health outcomes. We evaluated the performance of GPT-5-mini on 128 observational studies from a SR of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances and health outcomes conducted by the National Academies of Sciences. The navigation guide (NavGuide), a domain-based RoB tool designed for environmental studies, was used. For each paper-domain pair, the LLM was provided with the questions and guidance from the NavGuide and the human-identified text passages addressing that domain. The LLM returned a structured RoB rating, which was compared to the human-adjudicated ratings to quantify agreement and identify patterns of discrepancy. GPT-5-mini RoB assessments for exact matches (64.5%; κ=0.199, Gwet AC2=0.882, F1-score=0.311) remained lower than the concordance between humans and the reference standard (87.5%-91.4%). Performance improved substantially for partial matches, reflecting agreement in direction but not necessarily in magnitude (eg, "low" and "probably low"), with percent concordance of 91.9% (κ=0.241, Gwet AC2=0.910, F1-score=0.614; for humans, 97.9%-98.6% concordance). Performance varied across the NavGuide domains, with the worst performance in domain 1 (selection bias) and the best in domain 4 (outcome assessment). The models tended to be more stringent than humans, often assigning higher RoB ratings (eg, "probably low" when humans assigned "low"). Our results suggest that although concordance was moderate and inconsistent across domains, LLMs may be sufficiently accurate for use with human oversight. LLMs can flag cases for human adjudication or consistency checking but are not ready for use as an independent second reviewer without human oversight.
zh_abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] 评估每项研究的偏倚风险（RoB）是开展系统综述（SR）必要但劳动密集的步骤。人工智能有望减少RoB评估所需的时间和精力并提高综述者之间的一致性，但人们对基于AI的RoB评估准确性知之甚少。本研究旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在获得RoB工具问题及全文中相关段落时，对环境暴露与健康结局观察性研究进行RoB评估的表现。我们评估了GPT-5-mini在128项观察性研究中的表现，这些研究来自美国国家科学院（National Academies of Sciences）开展的全氟和多氟烷基物质与健康结局系统综述。使用导航指南（NavGuide），这是一种为环境研究设计的基于领域的RoB工具。对于每个论文-领域配对，向LLM提供NavGuide中的问题和指导，以及人工识别的针对该领域的文本段落。LLM返回结构化RoB评级，将其与人工裁定评级进行比较，以量化一致性并识别差异模式。GPT-5-mini在精确匹配上的RoB评估（64.5%；κ=0.199，Gwet AC2=0.882，F1-score=0.311）仍低于人类与参考标准之间的一致性（87.5%-91.4%）。对于部分匹配，表现显著改善，反映出方向一致但不一定幅度一致（例如“low”和“probably low”），一致百分比为91.9%（κ=0.241，Gwet AC2=0.910，F1-score=0.614；人类为97.9%-98.6%一致性）。表现因NavGuide领域而异，领域1（选择偏倚）表现最差，领域4（结局评估）表现最好。模型往往比人类更严格，常给出更高的RoB评级（例如人类评为“low”时模型评为“probably low”）。我们的结果表明，尽管一致性为中等且跨领域不一致，LLM可能足够准确，可在人工监督下使用。LLM可以标记病例供人工裁定或一致性检查，但尚未准备好在没有人工监督的情况下作为独立的第二综述者使用。

title: Impact of training data on deep learning-based RNA 3D structure quality assessment.
zh_title: 训练数据对RNA三维结构质量评估的影响
summary: 对三个深度学习RNA结构质量预测器做交叉重训练，在RNA-Puzzles基准上比较架构与训练数据构成的贡献。
key_points: 构建新的非原生数据集RNA3DQA
三个预测器交叉重训练与独立基准评测
非原生数据训练常优于原生数据
reason: 系统性交叉训练分析有新意，但属方法学比较、无新模型发布
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning-based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets-including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project-and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning-based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 对预测的 RNA 3D 结构进行准确的无参考评估对于大规模 RNA 建模至关重要，然而训练数据对基于深度学习质量预测器的影响仍知之甚少。在此，我们对三种用于 RNA 3D 结构质量评估的深度学习预测器进行了系统性的交叉训练分析，每种预测器最初均在不同的训练集上开发。通过在每个预测器上使用替代性（非原生）数据集重新训练——包括 RNA3DQA，一个专门为本项目创建的新数据集——并在独立的 RNA-Puzzles 基准上评估性能，我们系统评估了模型架构与训练数据组成的相对贡献。我们的结果揭示了跨数据集泛化方面的显著差异，预测器在非原生数据集上训练时往往比在其原生数据集上训练时表现更好。值得注意的是，训练数据集的影响因预测器而异，RNA3DQA 特别为 ARES 模型带来总体最佳的准确率和排序稳定性结果。原生训练集对 RNA3DCNN 和 lociPARSE 产生更好的性能。这些发现表明，训练数据的特征在塑造无参考 RNA 3D 结构质量评估方法的性能和稳健性方面起主导且依赖模型的作用。我们最后提出了设计可迁移训练数据集以及基准测试基于深度学习的质量预测器在 RNA 结构生物信息学中的实用建议。

title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
zh_title: 蛋白质基序支架的动力学感知基准
summary: 发布BILBY-PRO基准，含220个基序案例，并评估六种支架生成模型的覆盖与产率。
key_points: 从PROSITE关联结构系统构建220例
评估RFDiffusion、Proteina与ESM3等六模型
主张成功标准应纳入构象动力学
reason: 预印本新基准，系统评估多种生成模型，证据有限但值得一看
abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质基序支架基准评估生成模型能否在功能重要残基周围构建支架。其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及哪些标准定义成功。现有基准通常使用小型手工整理的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往取决于构象集合与转变。在此，我们同时处理基准范围和成功标准。我们引入BILBY-PRO，这是一个从PROSITE关联实验结构中系统衍生的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自174个PROSITE基序模式条目的220个案例。评估六个近期支架生成模型揭示了靶标覆盖率和独特解产率方面的不同模式：RFDiffusion和Proteina解决了更多靶标，而ESM3在其解决的靶标上产生更多独特成功支架。我们进一步引入BILBY-MD，这是一个基于参考的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于原始MotifBench基准中静态求解的设计，它与参考模拟相比，比较基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保持以及基序二面角自由能景观。在55个静态求解的模型-问题对中，31个满足我们由MD支持的标准，仅8个通过所有检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常得到MD支持，而类界面或上下文依赖的基序更常失败。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY突出了基序支架评估的三个互补维度：靶标覆盖率、独特解产率和MD支持的动力学保真度。

title: Artificial intelligence in cardiology for non-experts: decoding key terms and understanding machine learning methodologies. A Scientific Statement of the ESC Working Group on e-Cardiology, the European Heart Rhythm Association (EHRA), the Association for Acute CardioVascular Care (ACVC), the Heart Failure Association (HFA), the European Association of Cardiovascular Imaging (EACVI), the European Association of Preventive Cardiology (EAPC), and the European Association of Percutaneous Cardiovascular Interventions (EAPCI) of the ESC, the ESC Regulatory Affairs Committee, and the ESC Digital Cardiology and Artificial Intelligence Committee.
source: PubMed · European heart journal. Digital health
zh_title: ESC多学会联合声明：面向非专家的心脏病学AI术语与方法解读
summary: 欧洲心脏病学会多个工作组联合发布科学声明，系统解释心脏病学AI的关键术语与机器学习方法，强调AI素养对临床医生的重要性。
key_points: 由ESC多个协会与委员会联合发布的科学声明
解读AI术语与机器学习方法，面向非专家读者
指出AI在诊断、风险预测与治疗决策中的潜在作用
reason: 多学会科学声明属综述/述评类，按上限6分；教育性内容无新数据
abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Evidence-based medicine represents the systematic approach through which physicians today use the best available scientific evidence from clinical research to guide their clinical decision-making process. However, the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), with its diverse models and potential applications in medicine, is leading to a new form of research driven by 'big data' and heterogeneous datasets, extending beyond conventional statistical analysis and thereby making AI literacy an increasingly essential competence for clinicians. Artificial intelligence applications in cardiology have shown potential to support disease diagnosis, risk prediction, workflow efficiency, and therapeutic decision-making. However, despite these opportunities, AI may also represent a technological barrier for many physicians, due to its mathematical foundations and the speed at which models evolve. A solid understanding of AI concepts is therefore necessary for cardiologists to critically interpret results and engage with this new research landscape. This scientific statement explores AI in cardiology from an educational perspective, outlining the key knowledge required to build adequate AI literacy. The goal is to enable cardiologists not only to avoid reliance on external experts for methodological decisions, but also to collaborate with greater insight and informed judgment.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] 循证医学代表了当今医生利用临床研究中可获得的最佳科学证据来指导临床决策过程的系统方法。然而，人工智能（AI）的出现，凭借其多样化的模型和在医学中的潜在应用，正在催生一种由“大数据”和异质数据集驱动的新型研究，超越了传统统计分析，从而使 AI 素养成为临床医生日益重要的能力。人工智能在心脏病学中的应用已显示出支持疾病诊断、风险预测、工作流程效率和治疗决策的潜力。然而，尽管存在这些机会，AI 也可能对许多医生构成技术壁垒，因为其数学基础以及模型演进的速度。因此，心脏病学家必须对 AI 概念有扎实理解，才能批判性地解读结果并参与这一新的研究格局。本科学声明从教育角度探讨心脏病学中的 AI，概述建立足够 AI 素养所需的关键知识。目标是使心脏病学家不仅能够避免在方法学决策上依赖外部专家，而且能够以更深刻的洞见和明智判断进行合作。

title: Coexistence of AI Nurse and AI-Simulated Patient in Nursing Education Using a Bidirectional Fine-Tuning Pipeline: Development and Content Analysis Study.
zh_title: AI护士与AI模拟患者共存于护理教育
summary: 研究用五步双向微调流程构建AI护士NURSE-ONE与AI模拟患者PATIENT-ONE，经内容分析与护理教师探索性评价，并设计三种运行模式。
key_points: 五步双向微调管线构建两个专用模型
用Berelson内容分析并由独立人工编码者验证
护理教师第三方探索性评价与三模式生态设计
reason: 方法有新意但仅内容分析与小规模教师探索评价，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR biomedical engineering] Simulated patient systems are essential in nursing education but face actor scarcity, instructor burden, cost, and disrupted continuity where in-person simulation cannot be sustained. Existing large language model (LLM)-based systems address these issues but treat the dialogic partner-the AI nurse-as a static prompt or unspecialized model, compromising data collection quality and pedagogical applicability. We report (1) the construction of 2 specialized fine-tuned models, NURSE-ONE (AI nurse) and PATIENT-ONE (AI-simulated patient), via a 5-step bidirectional fine-tuning pipeline; (2) their evaluation using Berelson content analysis validated by independent human coders; (3) an exploratory third-party evaluation by nursing faculty; and (4) the design of a coexistence simulation ecosystem supporting 3 operating modes, including offline disaster preparedness applicability. On a single consumer-grade graphics processing unit (NVIDIA RTX 4090; 24 GB video random access memory), the multimodal base model gemma4-E4B-it was fine-tuned via low-rank adaptation in five steps: (1) a 251-scenario base from 29 institutionally authored nursing care plans and 20 items from the 115th Japanese National Nursing Examination; (2) a provisional dialogue system (AutoGen v18, maxmsg=25) to collect training dialogues; (3) NURSE-ONE fine-tuning across 3 training volume conditions (245, 735, and 1225 cases); (4) 4-condition Berelson comparison; and (5) PATIENT-ONE fine-tuning on NURSE-ONE-generated dialogues with a 3-condition comparison. Interrater reliability was confirmed by 2 independent nursing experts (196 blinded utterances, κ=0.770) and corroborated by 2 LLM raters (κ=0.742). Ten nursing faculty evaluated 3 coexistence modes in a working web user interface (21-item rubric; item-level content validity index=1.00). Four-condition Berelson analysis (χ215=42.0, P<.001) identified the 735-case nurse-side condition (open question rate=21.5%) as NURSE-ONE; information collection rate reached 15.5% (~4× baseline) at 1225 cases. PATIENT-ONE A/B/C analysis (χ210=11.8, P=.30) showed no significant category shift but the lowest response length variability (SD 24.5) and highest information-providing rate (47.9%) at 735 cases, adopted as PATIENT-ONE. The 2 adapters appeared to operate on different axes-qualitative questioning style on the nurse side and quantitative response stability on the patient side-a preliminary observed pattern we term functional asymmetry, pending replication. Thi
zh_abstract: [JMIR biomedical engineering] 模拟患者系统在护理教育中至关重要，但面临演员稀缺、教师负担、成本以及在无法维持面对面模拟时的连续性中断等问题。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统解决了这些问题，但将对话伙伴——AI 护士——视为静态提示或非专业化模型，从而损害数据收集质量和教学适用性。我们报告：(1) 通过 5 步双向微调流程构建 2 个专用微调模型 NURSE-ONE（AI 护士）和 PATIENT-ONE（AI 模拟患者）；(2) 使用由独立人工编码者验证的 Berelson 内容分析对其进行评估；(3) 由护理教师进行的探索性第三方评估；以及 (4) 支持 3 种运行模式的共存模拟生态系统的设计，包括离线灾害准备适用性。在单块消费级图形处理器（NVIDIA RTX 4090；24 GB 视频随机存取存储器）上，通过低秩适配分五步对多模态基础模型 gemma4-E4B-it 进行微调：(1) 由 29 份机构编写的护理计划和第 115 届日本国家护理考试中的 20 道题构建的 251 个情景基础集；(2) 一个临时对话系统（AutoGen v18，maxmsg=25）用于收集训练对话；(3) 在 3 种训练量条件（245、735 和 1225 个病例）下对 NURSE-ONE 进行微调；(4) 4 条件 Berelson 比较；以及 (5) 在由 NURSE-ONE 生成的对话上对 PATIENT-ONE 进行微调，并进行 3 条件比较。评分者间信度由 2 名独立护理专家确认（196 条盲法话语，κ=0.770），并由 2 名 LLM 评分者佐证（κ=0.742）。10 名护理教师在一个可工作的 Web 用户界面中评估了 3 种共存模式（21 项评分表；条目水平内容效度指数=1.00）。四条件 Berelson 分析（χ215=42.0，P<.001）确定 735 病例的护士侧条件（开放问题率=21.5%）为 NURSE-ONE；在 1225 个病例时，信息收集率达到 15.5%（约为基线的 4 倍）。PATIENT-ONE 的 A/B/C 分析（χ210=11.8，P=.30）显示类别没有显著变化，但 735 个病例时响应长度变异性最低（SD 24.5），信息提供率最高（47.9%），因此采用为 PATIENT-ONE。2 个适配器似乎在不同轴上起作用——护士侧的定性提问风格和患者侧的定量响应稳定性——这是一种初步观察到的模式，我们称之为功能不对称，尚待重复验证。Thi

title: MELD: Mutation Effect Learning through Differential embeddings
zh_title: MELD：基于差异嵌入的突变效应预测模型
summary: MELD直接在野生型与突变型差异上训练，预测单核苷酸变异的功能后果，并在ClinVar大规模变异集上评测。
key_points: 将突变-野生型logit差纳入训练目标
结合共享CNN-Transformer编码器与突变掩码增强
在ClinVar约157万变异上评测
reason: 新方法并有大规模基准对比，但为预印本、缺乏外部验证，属值得一看档上沿
abstract: We introduce MELD (Mutation Effect Learning through Differential Embeddings), a compact model for predicting the functional consequences of single nucleotide variants (SNVs) by training directly on the wild-type (WT) versus mutant differential. Interpreting SNVs is central to clinical genomics, yet experimental characterization cannot scale to millions of observed variants. Leading sequence-to-function models (Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome) are trained on absolute genomic tracks and score variants post hoc through in-silico mutagenesis (ISM), so the WT-mutant difference never enters the training loss. MELD instead places the logit difference {Delta}z = zmut - zwt inside the supervised objective. It combines a shared CNN-Transformer encoder, a mutant-specific mutation-mask boost, multiscale mutation-centered pooling, and a learned adaptive amplification factor . On ClinVar (1.57M variants), MELD (1.9M parameters) reached an AUROC of 0.986 versus 0.800 for a same-data, same-backbone ISM baseline, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component. On a shared benchmark, it outperformed frozen foundation models with 3-1,300x more parameters (AUROC 0.967 vs. 0.924 for AlphaGenome and 0.936 for Nucleotide Transformer). With only 50, 000 training variants, it exceeded the ISM baseline trained on all 1.48M (AUROC 0.903 vs. 0.796) variants. On BRCA1 saturation genome editing, frozen MELD achieved a Spearman {rho} of 0.42, above Borzoi (0.40), and ClinVar transfer raised it to 0.45. These results demonstrate that direct differential supervision is a compact, data-efficient alternative to post-hoc ISM scoring with substantially larger pretrained models.
zh_abstract: 我们提出MELD（Mutation Effect Learning through Differential Embeddings，通过差异嵌入学习突变效应），一种紧凑模型，通过直接基于野生型（WT）与突变型差异进行训练，预测单核苷酸变异（SNV）的功能后果。解读SNV是临床基因组学的核心，但实验表征无法扩展到数百万个已观察到的变异。领先的序列到功能模型（Enformer、Borzoi、AlphaGenome）在绝对基因组轨迹上训练，并通过计算机模拟诱变（in-silico mutagenesis, ISM）事后对变异评分，因此WT-突变型差异从未进入训练损失。MELD则将logit差异Δz = zmut − zwt置于监督目标中。它结合了共享的CNN-Transformer编码器、突变型特异性突变掩码提升、多尺度以突变为中心的池化，以及学习到的自适应放大因子。在ClinVar（157万个变异）上，MELD（190万参数）达到AUROC 0.986，而使用相同数据、相同骨干网络的ISM基线为0.800，消融实验证实了各组成部分的贡献。在共享基准上，它优于参数量多3至1,300倍的冻结基础模型（AUROC 0.967，而AlphaGenome为0.924，Nucleotide Transformer为0.936）。仅使用50,000个训练变异时，它超过了使用全部148万个变异训练的ISM基线（AUROC 0.903 vs. 0.796）。在BRCA1饱和基因组编辑中，冻结的MELD达到Spearman ρ为0.42，高于Borzoi（0.40），ClinVar迁移将其提高到0.45。这些结果表明，直接差异监督是一种紧凑、数据高效的替代方案，可替代使用显著更大预训练模型的事后ISM评分。

title: FDA asks for input on regulating telesurgery and autonomous surgical robots, with comments due Jan. 5
zh_title: FDA就远程手术与自主手术机器人监管征求意见
summary: FDA就远程手术与自主手术机器人的监管公开征求意见，截止日期为1月5日。
