title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs
zh_title: LLM生成病历内容对下游模型的影响
summary: 研究LLM生成的冗余摘要与诊断过度记录如何影响读取同一病历的下游LLM。
key_points: 区分记录膨胀与临床发现失真两类伪影
以诊断过度记录为失真案例
强调双向读写下的安全部署问题
reason: 预印本揭示病历LLM循环风险，问题重要但证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于处理医疗记录，以完成临床记录等医疗保健任务。由于这些工具也会生成记录，这种关系现在是双向的：模型既从记录中读取，也向记录中写入。因此，理解 LLM 在读取已包含 LLM 撰写内容的记录时如何表现，对其安全部署至关重要。在本研究中，我们考察医疗记录中由 LLM 撰写的内容如何影响读取同一记录的下游 LLM。我们考虑两类由 LLM 诱导的伪影：膨胀，即 LLM 生成的摘要累积在记录中，并随着时间改变其内容的长度和来源；以及失真，即 LLM 微妙地改变临床发现，而非直接捏造事实。作为失真的一种案例，我们研究诊断过度判读（在记录中记载未经确认的鉴别诊断），并检验其是否会传播到阅读型 LLM 的输出。在来自四个模型家族的七个阅读模型中，我们发现了两种效应的证据。第一，与长度匹配的复制前移文本和模板化文本相比，LLM 生成的摘要记录轻微但持续地降低了下游住院病程生成。第二，注入的过度判读以下游输出中再次出现，其发生率因阅读模型而异，而标准质量指标未检测到变化。这些发现表明，需要监测医疗记录中 AI 生成的内容，并在这些记录随后由 AI 处理时将其考虑在内。

title: Adversarial Evaluation of Large Language Models for Patient-Friendly Radiology Report Summarization
zh_title: 面向患者友好型放射报告摘要的LLM对抗评测
summary: 预印本提出临床对抗评测框架，用18,000组报告变体测试6个大语言模型生成患者友好型放射报告摘要的稳健性。
key_points: 基于放射科医生验证的对抗词典构造报告变体
评估事实忠实性、确定性保真与幻觉率
两位放射科医生在105例上评估一致性
reason: 预印本，评测规模大且有放射科医生参与，但无外部临床验证
abstract: Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports. Methods: We introduced a clinically grounded adversarial framework that uses controlled term substitutions and impression removals across intensity levels. Using a radiologist-validated adversarial dictionary, we generated adversarial variants of CT and MRI reports. Six LLMs summarized original and adversarial impressions using 2 prompt styles, yielding 18,000 evaluation pairs. Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate. Failure mode analysis quantified vulnerabilities in incorporating clinical modifiers. Agreement with two radiologists was assessed on 105 cases. Results: GPT-5-mini achieved the highest factual faithfulness and certainty fidelity under both adversarial edits. Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma. Impression-removal edits were handled more robustly than term substitutions. Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%. Judge-radiologist agreement (macro-F1: 0.55-0.56) was comparable to inter-radiologist agreement (0.53). Conclusions: Adversarial evaluation exposes clinically meaningful failure modes, including missed anatomical modifiers, altered diagnostic certainty, and omitted severity descriptors.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并验证一个可扩展的对抗性评估框架，用于评估生成放射科报告患者友好型摘要的大语言模型（LLMs）的稳健性。【方法】我们引入了一个具有临床依据的对抗性框架，该框架在多个强度级别上使用受控术语替换和印象移除。使用经放射科医生验证的对抗性词典，我们生成了CT和MRI报告的对抗性变体。六种LLM使用2种提示风格对原始和对抗性印象进行摘要，产生18,000个评估对。稳健性通过自动化LLM作为评判者的框架进行评估，评分内容包括事实忠实性、对对抗性编辑的敏感性、确定性保真度和幻觉率。失败模式分析量化了在纳入临床修饰语方面的脆弱性。在105例病例上评估了与两名放射科医生的一致性。【结果】GPT-5-mini在两种对抗性编辑下均取得最高的事实忠实性和确定性保真度。在术语替换下，GPT-5-mini摘要中幻觉发生率为28.1-30.1%，而Claude Sonnet 4.5为35.3-36.4%，MedGemma为41.4-41.9%。印象移除编辑的处理比术语替换更稳健。即使对于得分最高的摘要器，解剖学术语的替换在23.7%的摘要中未被反映，诊断确定性在22.3%中未被反映，描述性术语（例如“substantial”）在21.2%中未被反映。评判者-放射科医生一致性（macro-F1：0.55-0.56）与放射科医生间一致性（0.53）相当。【结论】对抗性评估揭示了具有临床意义的失败模式，包括遗漏解剖修饰语、改变诊断确定性和省略严重程度描述符。

title: Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
zh_title: 常规病理切片中人口学信息的全院级映射
summary: arXiv预印本分析25个器官130万张H&E全切片、25.7万患者，用病理基础模型与多实例学习检测性别、年龄组与自报种族相关信息。
key_points: 130万张切片、25.7万患者、25个器官
性别AUROC 0.828、年龄组0.733、种族0.662
跨器官差异大，诊断文本聚类内评估有所衰减
reason: 百万级切片大样本系统映射，但为预印本且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，人口学相关信息的可检测程度在器官和疾病状态间的范围仍不清楚。在此，我们分析了来自25个器官、257,322例患者的130万张苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin）全切片图像，使用病理基础模型表征（pathology foundation-model representations）和多实例学习（multiple-instance learning），系统绘制与性别、年龄组和自报种族（self-reported race）相关的信息图谱。在69个器官-人口学组合中，人口学属性总体上可恢复，全器官平均 AUROC 为性别 0.828、年龄组 0.733、自报种族 0.662，并且在不同器官间存在显著差异。人口学类别平衡（demographic-class balancing）使性能变化相对较小，而在诊断文本簇内评估则显示出适度衰减。在基于诊断分组的训练下，人口学相关信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）和皮肤中的自报种族（0.728）。对这些情形的文献引导分析产生了候选的组织形态学和情境解释，供进一步研究。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口学相关信息的系统图谱，为其来源调查、潜在捷径学习（shortcut learning）评估以及更可解释的计算病理学模型的开发提供信息。

title: EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning
zh_title: EndoSCOP-V：内镜多轮视频理解评测框架
summary: 预印本发布1307段真实内镜与结肠镜视频、20274轮问答的多轮结构化报告与临床推理评测框架。
key_points: 视频共63.2小时，97%为1080p，平均约174秒
问答由医生填写的结构化内镜报告确定性生成
源自1033份医生审核模板，非LLM改写
reason: 规模可观且标注来源可靠的多轮视频基准，但为预印本、开放情况未说明
abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).
zh_abstract: 内镜诊断在原生视频上展开，胃肠道遍历过程中的单个阳性发现会触发持续数分钟、围绕部位、形态、严重程度和干预的推理链。现有内镜多模态基准仅测试静态图像或单一疾病视频，遗漏了真实世界报告所需的时间与临床推理。我们提出 EndoSCOP-V，一个基于视频、用于结构化内镜报告和临床推理的多轮评估框架。它包含 1,307 个真实世界内镜和结肠镜视频（63.2 h；97% 为 1080p），平均约 174 s。其 20,274 个问答轮次由临床医生填写的结构化内镜报告电子健康记录（EHRs）确定性地实例化，因此没有任何逐病例标注是合成的或经 LLM 重新措辞的。这些问答轮次来自 1,033 个经临床医生审核的模板，每种疾病约 18 个，覆盖临床对齐的 9 任务 × 30 子任务报告分类体系，涉及 54 种世界内镜组织（WEO）MST 3.0 疾病。22% 的操作带有共存病理，每例最多六种。马尔可夫式上下文剪枝的 oracle-forcing 协议逐轮评估对话，在每个后续轮次之前注入金标准答案，从而使逐轮推理与级联对话错误隔离。由 15 名委员会认证内镜医师组成的小组在 1,500 个问题上设定了 78% 的严格准确率基线。在 14 个开放权重大型多模态模型（LMMs）中，最佳的 27B 级模型达到 59.8% 严格准确率，在排除格式上简单的疾病排除项后降至 53.4%。在受试者间抽查中，3 个前沿专有模型中的最佳者在严格 NDR 准确率上落后临床医生专家组 23 个百分点。子任务分析揭示了在长时程视频上的定量测量、多变量分级和干预推理方面存在一致差距。数据：Hugging Face（EndoSCOP-V）。代码：GitHub（abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V）。

title: Clinical Evidence-Guided Residual Learning for Medication Recommendation with Dynamic DDI Regularization
zh_title: EviDrug：临床证据引导的用药推荐
summary: 预印本提出融合临床证据记忆与动态药物相互作用正则的残差学习框架，在三个ICU数据集上优于十二个基线。
key_points: 自训练访视编码器与病例记忆构建处方
门控修正头结合临床关联与用药史
DDI反馈动态调整正则强度
reason: 多数据集外部评测并对比十二个基线，但为预印本且无临床结局
abstract: Medication recommendation must combine patient-specific treatment evidence with the interaction structure of a prescription. The central challenge is to determine which evidence supports each medication and how strongly to regularize interactions while preserving predictive quality. We propose EviDrug, a clinical evidence-guided residual learning framework. Its clinical-memory backbone integrates a self-trained visit-aware encoder, training-case memory and one medication-set interaction block to establish a patient-specific prescription. A gated refinement head combines the backbone states with clinical associations and history-conditioned medication identities through bounded logit corrections. Drug-drug interaction (DDI) feedback adapts regularization strength using training-query predictions. Across MIMIC-IV, NWICU and SICdb, EviDrug leads twelve published-method baselines in AP, F1 and Jaccard, improving AP by 2.26, 2.06 and 1.71 percentage points over the strongest comparator. These gains come at lower parameter and runtime costs than MetaDrug. Matched controls demonstrate DDI reductions with stable predictive quality. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug.
zh_abstract: 药物推荐必须将患者特异性治疗证据与处方的相互作用结构相结合。核心挑战在于确定哪些证据支持每种药物，以及在保持预测质量的同时以多强的程度对相互作用进行正则化。我们提出 EviDrug，一个临床证据引导的残差学习框架。其临床记忆主干整合了一个自训练的访视感知编码器、训练病例记忆和一个药物集合交互模块，以建立患者特异性处方。门控细化头通过有界 logit 校正，将主干状态与临床关联及以病史为条件的药物身份相结合。药物-药物相互作用（DDI）反馈利用训练查询预测调整正则化强度。在 MIMIC-IV、NWICU 和 SICdb 上，EviDrug 在 AP、F1 和 Jaccard 上领先十二个已发表方法基线，相较最强比较方法将 AP 分别提高 2.26、2.06 和 1.71 个百分点。这些增益以低于 MetaDrug 的参数和运行时间成本实现。匹配对照显示 DDI 减少且预测质量稳定。代码可访问 https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/EviDrug

title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
zh_title: TrialJev：开放权重单次试验资格筛选评分
summary: 基于LoRA适配Qwen与指针头的一次前向打分模型，在TREC 2022未见合成患者6975对上准确率约81%。
key_points: 单次前向打分，无需自回归生成
在6975对未见患者数据上准确率80.97%–81.84%
批量1下推理较判定生成快约2.5倍
reason: 开放权重且外部未见数据评测、效率优势明确，但为预印本与合成患者
abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.
zh_abstract: 临床试验筛选需要评估大量患者-试验配对，以对候选者进行详细资格复核排序，且往往受到患者记录共享限制。我们提出 TrialJev，一种开放权重（open-weight）的资格评分器，使用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型和指针头（pointer head），在单次前向传播中对自然语言答案选项评分，无需自回归解码。TrialJev 在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 上训练，并在来自 50 名未见过的 TREC 2022 合成患者的 6,975 个合格或排除配对上进行评估，达到 80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）和 81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B）的准确率，相比之下，在相同数据上微调以生成裁决的 LLM 为 79.87% 和 79.93%。在匹配的 batch-1 测量中，在 9B-27B 规模下，生成裁决所需时间是 TrialJev 单次推理的 2.45-2.70 倍。在一种常见的、基于开发集拟合的决策校正下，两个 27B TrialJev 模型达到 80.99% 和 81.88% 的准确率，而专有托管 Jev API 为 81.28%；配对置信区间包含零。TrialJev 在单块 GPU 上本地运行，27B 规模下每对约需 178 ms，无需将患者文本传输至外部模型 API。A/B-logit 消融表明，避免解码（而非仅指针头）解释了所测得的效率优势。TrialJev 旨在对候选试验进行首轮优先级排序，补充而非替代可解释模型和临床复核。评估仅限于合成患者和特定实现的计时，临床用途尚未验证。适配器、指针头和模型卡已在 Hugging Face 上发布。

title: Dataset Collections: Challenges of Large-Scale Data Aggregation in 3D Medical Image Datasets
zh_title: 大规模3D医学影像数据集聚合的挑战
summary: 在1034个公开数据集、56.5万张3D影像上系统分析数据集聚合的来源丢失、复用扩散与偏倚放大问题。
key_points: 覆盖1034个公开数据集、56.5万张3D影像
形式化“数据集集合”范式并刻画其结构性风险
提供应对复用传播、重复与分布失真的实用资源
reason: 大规模公开影像数据资源与方法分析，但为预印本且未涉临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: The development of deep learning-based medical AI depends on high-quality annotated data. Yet, dataset creation remains constrained by the need for expert radiologist annotations, limiting curated datasets to relatively small cohorts. To overcome this limitation, recent efforts increasingly aggregate disparate public datasets into large-scale dataset collections. However, combining datasets at scale often obscures data provenance, introducing substantial risks of reuse propagation, unintended leakage, bias amplification and distorted data distributions. In this work, we study these problems on a massive collection of 565k 3D radiological images across 1034 public datasets and provide practical resources to address them. Firstly, we formalize dataset collections as a distinct paradigm in medical image analysis and characterize their structural challenges, including reuse propagation, duplication, and provenance fragmentation. Secondly, we perform a large-scale empirical study of duplication on this collection and demonstrate extensive exact and near-duplicate reuse across public datasets via perceptual hashing and manual tracing, identifying a lower bound of 118k duplicate pairs. We make the perceptual hashes publicly accessible for comparison through our website, providing researchers with a standardized reference for identifying potential overlaps and shared provenance. Thirdly, since hashing alone cannot detect all duplicates, we introduce MAP (Metadata for Aggregation and Provenance), a lightweight, portable metadata profile for documenting provenance, known overlaps, and deduplication decisions in dataset collections. Our contributions help dataset collections shift from coarse aggregations to reliable and provenance-aware data scaling mechanisms in medical image analysis. A web tool supporting our work is available at https://mic-dct.dkfz.de/.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习的医学 AI 的发展依赖于高质量标注数据。然而，数据集的创建仍受制于对专家放射科医生标注的需求，使精选数据集局限于相对较小的队列。为克服这一限制，近期工作越来越多地将不同的公共数据集汇总为大规模数据集集合。然而，大规模合并数据集往往掩盖数据来源，带来复用传播、意外泄漏、偏倚放大和数据分布失真的重大风险。在本工作中，我们在一个包含 1034 个公共数据集中 565k 幅 3D 放射影像的大规模集合上研究这些问题，并提供实用资源加以应对。首先，我们将数据集集合正式定义为医学图像分析中的一种独立范式，并刻画其结构性挑战，包括复用传播、重复和来源碎片化。其次，我们对该集合上的重复进行大规模实证研究，并通过感知哈希和人工追踪证明公共数据集之间存在广泛的完全重复和近重复复用，识别出 118k 对重复这一下界。我们通过网站公开提供感知哈希以供比较，为研究人员识别潜在重叠和共享来源提供标准化参考。第三，由于仅靠哈希无法检测所有重复，我们引入 MAP（Metadata for Aggregation and Provenance，聚合与来源元数据），一种轻量、可移植的元数据配置文件，用于记录数据集集合中的来源、已知重叠和去重决策。我们的贡献有助于数据集集合从粗粒度聚合转变为医学图像分析中可靠且来源感知的数据扩展机制。支持我们工作的网络工具可在 https://mic-dct.dkfz.de/ 获取。

title: Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
zh_title: 智能体系统能否用已上市影像AI工具补齐放射报告
summary: 提出放射科智能体框架，编排调用FDA已批准影像AI器械的工具集，在大型多模态报告语料上模拟生成结构化报告。
key_points: 统一编排器调用模块化工具生成结构化报告
工具集来自FDA已批准影像AI器械的发现类别
在多模态报告语料上模拟，未报告临床结局
reason: 智能体与已获批器械结合思路新颖且有基线模拟，但为预印本、无前瞻临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study's modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.
zh_abstract: 放射学 AI 沿两条路径发展：在狭窄任务上表现良好但覆盖临床发现较少的专用模型，以及处理更广泛任务但仍易产生幻觉和测量不准确的通用模型。通过智能体系统将两者结合，为实现全面放射学报告提供了一条路径，但已发表的系统往往局限于单一模态或身体部位。我们描述一个放射学智能体框架，该框架标准化编排器（orchestrator）调用模块化工具以生成结构化报告的方式，并用它来衡量此类系统利用 FDA 批准的放射学 AI 设备工具所能达到的效果。报告生成在一个大型多模态报告语料库上模拟，编排器被给予要么是从已批准设备整合而来的发现类别目录（每个类别在其获批的模态上可用），要么是一个无限制目录（其中可请求任何类别），并且规划要么从临床指征、要么从目标报告出发。工具输出从参考报告模拟，因此比较将工具可用性和编排与工具错误隔离开来。在仅有已批准目录和临床指征的情况下，编排器找回不到三分之一的临床可操作发现；使用无限制目录时找回率显著提高，而当计划根据目标报告撰写时进一步提高。将每个漏掉的发现归因于原因显示，大多数是已批准设备未针对该研究模态提供的类别，而三分之一是已提供但未被调用的类别或工具。添加最常缺失的工具可在留出报告上弥合与无限制目录的大部分差距，而使用无限制目录的较小编排器则放弃了全部增益。因此，工具可用性和有效编排是全面 AI 辅助放射学报告的两个互补约束。

title: Beyond Segmentation: Enriching ImageCAS with Coronary Ostia Landmarks, Rooted Centerline Graphs, and Open-Weight Localization Models
zh_title: ImageCAS扩充冠状动脉开口关键点与中心线图
summary: 为1000例ImageCAS冠脉分割数据集补充开口标注与以开口为根的开放中心线图，并发布开放权重的定位模型。
key_points: 1000例患者均补充开口标注，前500例三标注者标注
中心线图严格基于官方ImageCAS掩膜且起于标注开口
发布开放权重的开口定位模型，规模为同类公开数据之最
reason: 公开数据集与开放权重模型具复用价值，但为预印本、1000例规模中等，属值得一看档
abstract: Coronary ostia and centerlines are key reference points for automated analysis of coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA), from surgical planning to intraoperative vessel tracking. However, the only public ostium annotations cover 77 non-gated aortic scans, not CCTA, while CAT08 and ASOCA (32 and 40 CCTA scans) mark the ostia only implicitly, as centerline start points. This work enriches ImageCAS, the largest public dataset for coronary artery segmentation, with ostium annotations for its 1000 patients and centerline graphs rooted at these new ostia, making it, to the authors' knowledge, the largest public dataset for ostium localization and the only one with centerlines following the official ImageCAS masks and starting at annotated ostia. Three annotators marked each ostium in the first 500 volumes; in the next 500, the candidates of a model trained on the first batch were corrected (human-in-the-loop). Six 3D localization models, trained on ImageCAS, CAT08 and ASOCA, were benchmarked on 58 held-out volumes (50 ImageCAS, 4 CAT08, 4 ASOCA). SwinUNETR-V2 and nnResUNet localized all ostia without failure (>5 mm error), with median errors of 0.70-0.87 mm. Trained on CAT08 and ASOCA alone, SwinUNETR-V2 fails on 34% of right and 53% of left ostia, whereas adding 250 ImageCAS volumes removes all failures. The centerlines were extracted by a deterministic, quality-controlled minimal-path procedure; on ASOCA, they cover a median of 99.5% of the reference length, with a median per-patient mean distance of 0.22 mm between matched reference points and centerlines. Annotations, centerlines, code, and weights are available at https://hal9000-lab.github.io/.
zh_abstract: 冠状动脉开口和中心线是冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影（CCTA）自动化分析的关键参考点，从手术规划到术中血管追踪均会用到。然而，唯一的公开开口标注覆盖 77 例非门控主动脉扫描，而非 CCTA；而 CAT08 和 ASOCA（分别为 32 例和 40 例 CCTA 扫描）仅以中心线起点的形式隐式标记开口。本工作为 ImageCAS——最大的公开冠状动脉分割数据集——补充了其 1000 名患者的开口标注，以及以这些新开口为根的中心线图，据作者所知，使其成为最大的公开开口定位数据集，也是唯一一个中心线遵循官方 ImageCAS 掩膜并从标注开口开始的公开数据集。三名标注者在前 500 个体积中标记每个开口；在接下来的 500 个中，对第一批训练的模型候选结果进行校正（人在回路）。在 ImageCAS、CAT08 和 ASOCA 上训练的六个 3D 定位模型在 58 个留出体积（50 个 ImageCAS、4 个 CAT08、4 个 ASOCA）上进行了基准测试。SwinUNETR-V2 和 nnResUNet 在所有开口定位中均无失败（>5 mm 误差），中位误差为 0.70-0.87 mm。仅在 CAT08 和 ASOCA 上训练时，SwinUNETR-V2 在 34% 的右侧开口和 53% 的左侧开口上失败，而加入 250 个 ImageCAS 体积后消除了所有失败。中心线通过确定性的、经过质量控制的最小路径流程提取；在 ASOCA 上，它们覆盖参考长度的中位数 99.5%，匹配参考点与中心线之间的每患者平均距离中位数为 0.22 mm。标注、中心线、代码和权重可在 https://hal9000-lab.github.io/ 获取。

title: Generating Diverse and Verified Synthetic Clinical Notes with Labels by Construction
zh_title: SPARCLING：按构造标注的合成临床文书生成
summary: 基于LLM的流水线生成带字符级PHI标注的合成德语出院小结，用作去标识模型基准。
key_points: 结合属性采样、模板生成与红队测试
PHI跨度按构造保证标注正确
实验显示内容多样性优于现有公开数据集
reason: 构建多样化且标注可靠的临床NLP基准，但为预印本且限德语，属值得一看档
abstract: Under strict privacy regulations in the clinical domain, de-identification is necessary to enable the use of clinical data such as for natural language processing. However, we currently lack sophisticated ways to tell which de-identification models actually are suitable. Specifically, we need benchmarks that are challenging, diverse, and clinically plausible, all while ensuring label correctness. To this end, we present SPARCLING, an LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic discharge letters with character-exact PHI span annotations. Our pipeline combines structured attribute sampling, template generation, and red teaming to obtain diverse PHI-labeled discharge letters. In our experiments, we demonstrate this superior content diversity over existing public datasets. Further, we show SPARCLING's downstream utility as a benchmark to uncover failure modes of de-identifiers in the German clinical domain. Finally, our experiments show that training on our synthetic data can yield more capable de-identifiers than training on the scarce public data alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator.
zh_abstract: 在临床领域严格的隐私法规下，去标识化对于使临床数据能够用于自然语言处理等用途是必要的。然而，我们目前缺乏复杂的方法来判断哪些去标识化模型实际上适用。具体而言，我们需要具有挑战性、多样性且临床合理的基准，同时确保标签正确。为此，我们提出SPARCLING，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流程，用于生成带有字符精确受保护健康信息（PHI）片段标注的合成出院小结。我们的流程结合结构化属性采样、模板生成和红队测试，以获得多样化的PHI标注出院小结。在实验中，我们证明其内容多样性优于现有公开数据集。此外，我们展示SPARCLING作为基准的下游效用，可揭示德国临床领域中去标识化模型的失效模式。最后，我们的实验表明，与仅使用稀缺公开数据训练相比，使用我们的合成数据训练可产生能力更强的去标识化模型。我们的代码见 https://github.com/Matt00n/phi_discharge_letter_generator。

title: ATLAS: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark and Context-Aware Model for Surgical Anatomy Segmentation
zh_title: ATLAS：手术解剖分割多术式基准与模型
summary: 预印本发布含121,018帧、100段手术视频、14种术式的手术解剖分割数据集，并提出上下文感知分割模型。
key_points: ATLAS-120k含121,018帧、41个类别
覆盖14种腹腔镜与机器人辅助术式
标注结合人工、跟踪传播与外科医生审核
reason: 多术式大规模标注数据集，但预印本且未明示公开，未达外部验证档
abstract: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a clip-level semantic segmentation dataset of 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos, covering 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures and 41 classes. Annotations were created with a pipeline that combines manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and review by surgeons. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model for surgical anatomy recognition. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art natural-image and in-domain foundation models in both segmentation accuracy and temporal consistency, achieving a Dice score of 0.70 with ViT-L while running in real time at 76.2 FPS. Ablations show that the context queries improve accuracy and that query propagation improves temporal consistency. ATLAS also generalizes well, matching a dedicated model zero-shot on CholecSeg8k and improving phase recognition on AutoLaparo over SurgeNet initialization. The model weights, dataset annotations, and annotation tool are publicly available at https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.
zh_abstract: 在微创手术（MIS）中识别解剖结构可支持术中导航并提高患者安全，但进展受限于小型、单一术式数据集以及为自然场景开发的分割方法。本工作通过一个新数据集和模型来解决这两个局限。首先，我们介绍 ATLAS-120k，一个片段级语义分割数据集，包含来自 100 个手术视频的 121,018 个标注帧，涵盖 14 种腹腔镜和机器人辅助术式及 41 个类别。标注通过一个结合人工标注、基于跟踪器的传播和外科医生审核的流程创建。其次，我们提出 ATLAS（Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations），一种用于手术解剖识别的视频语义分割模型。ATLAS 建立在领域内基础模型嵌入之上，并添加上下文查询用于术式和手术阶段，以及帧间查询传播用于短期记忆。ATLAS 在分割准确性和时间一致性方面均优于最先进的自然图像和领域内基础模型，使用 ViT-L 达到 Dice 分数 0.70，同时以 76.2 FPS 实时运行。消融实验表明，上下文查询提高了准确性，查询传播提高了时间一致性。ATLAS 也具有良好的泛化性，在 CholecSeg8k 上零样本匹配专用模型，并在 AutoLaparo 上相较 SurgeNet 初始化改善阶段识别。模型权重、数据集标注和标注工具公开于 https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS。

title: Multilingual Artificial Datasets for AI-Driven Cardiology: the CliTe and ParaCliTe corpora
zh_title: 面向心脏病学AI的多语种人工合成语料CliTe与ParaCliTe
summary: 7家欧洲医院心内科医生生成7语种合成心脏科临床记录，发布CliTe及平行/银标准ParaCliTe语料。
key_points: 心内科医生人工撰写7语种合成病历，兼顾性别平衡
子集经多阶段人工翻译形成平行语料ParaCliTe
其余记录机器翻译构成ParaCliTe Silver
reason: 多语种公开合成临床语料有实用价值，但为预印本、合成数据、验证信息有限
abstract: Background and Aims. Comparable, multilingual, validated cardiology corpora are critical to advance trustworthy natural language processing (NLP) models for cardiology but such resources are scarce due to privacy concerns. This study aimed to cover this gap by presenting suitable artificial corpus creation guidelines and by releasing 3 multilanguage corpora. Methods. Following purpose-specific publicly-available corpus construction guidelines, cardiologists from 7 European hospitals generated artificial clinical records in Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish, ensuring clinical diversity and sex balance, resulting in the CliTe corpus. A CliTe subset underwent a multi-stage manual translation into the other 6 languages, resulting in the parallel ParaCliTe corpus, while the remaining reports were automatically translated, constituting ParaCliTe Silver. Results. CliTe is a collection of 699 artificial cardiology reports, mostly outpatient notes (340 documents), discharge reports (263), and inpatient notes (89), describing fictional patients with ischaemic heart disease (199 patients), heart failure (188), and valvular disease (79), among others. ParaCliTe contains reports from 94 fictitious patients, each available in seven languages with sentence-level alignment, resulting in 658 documents. The corpus mainly comprises discharge reports (322 documents), and outpatient (196) and inpatient (140) notes, describing patients with heart failure (399 documents), ischaemic heart disease (287), and valvular disease (238). Empirical results illustrate the utility of ParaCliTe and highlight the limitations of state-of-the-art NLP models adapted to the cardiology domain. Conclusions. The creation of multilingual, equitable and realistic corpora of artificial patients capable of strengthening NLP performance for cardiology is feasible when supported by detailed guidelines.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】可比、多语言、经过验证的心脏病学语料库对于推进心脏病学可信自然语言处理（NLP）模型至关重要，但由于隐私顾虑，此类资源稀缺。本研究旨在通过提出合适的人工语料库构建指南并发布3个多语言语料库来填补这一空白。【方法】遵循针对特定目的、公开可用的语料库构建指南，来自7家欧洲医院的心脏病学家用捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和瑞典语生成了人工临床记录，确保临床多样性和性别平衡，形成CliTe语料库。CliTe的一个子集经过多阶段人工翻译成其他6种语言，形成平行ParaCliTe语料库，而其余报告经自动翻译，构成ParaCliTe Silver。【结果】CliTe是699份人工心脏病学报告的集合，主要是门诊记录（340份文件）、出院报告（263份）和住院记录（89份），描述虚构患者，包括缺血性心脏病（199例患者）、心力衰竭（188例）和瓣膜病（79例）等。ParaCliTe包含94例虚构患者的报告，每例均有七种语言版本并具有句子级对齐，共形成658份文件。该语料库主要包括出院报告（322份文件）、门诊记录（196份）和住院记录（140份），描述心力衰竭（399份文件）、缺血性心脏病（287份）和瓣膜病（238份）患者。实证结果说明了ParaCliTe的实用性，并突出了适应心脏病学领域的最先进NLP模型的局限性。【结论】在详细指南支持下，创建能够增强心脏病学NLP性能的多语言、公平且逼真的人工患者语料库是可行的。

title: Overview of the ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GANs task: Exploring fingerprint detection, privacy leakage, and synthetic medical image generation
zh_title: ImageCLEFmedical 2026 GANs任务：指纹检测与隐私泄漏
summary: 第四届ImageCLEFmedical GANs任务综述，设训练图像溯源、隐向量识别与隐私保护CT生成三个子任务。
key_points: 设三个子任务：检测GAN训练所用真实图像
新增识别合成图像对应隐向量子任务
要求生成隐私保护CT并权衡保真度与隐私
reason: 公开基准与标注数据的挑战赛综述，非同行走廊评审结果，属值得一看档
abstract: The 2026 ImageCLEFmedical GANs Task Exploring Fingerprint Detection, Privacy Leakage, and Synthetic Medical Image Generation continues to investigate privacy and security concerns around using patient data to generate synthetic medical images, now in its fourth edition. This edition introduces three complementary subtasks: the first extends prior editions by asking participants to detect which real images were used in training a Generative Adversarial Network to produce given synthetic outputs; the second is a novel subtask requiring participants to identify which latent vector produced each synthetic image, probing the faithfulness and reversibility of the latent-to-image mapping; the third asks participants to generate privacy-preserving CT slices, quantifying the trade-off between image fidelity and patient privacy. Ground-truth annotations and benchmark datasets of real and GAN-generated lung CT slices are provided for all subtasks. Evaluation is based on Cohen's Kappa for Subtask 1, matching accuracy for Subtask 2, and a combination of FID and Privacy Preservation Score (PPS) for Subtask 3. Overall, 37 teams registered for the task, with 10 teams submitting runs across subtasks and 6 teams submitting working notes papers. This paper presents an overview of the task setup, datasets, evaluation metrics, and summarises the approaches and results of participating teams.
zh_abstract: 2026 年 ImageCLEFmedical GANs 任务：探索指纹检测、隐私泄露与合成医学图像生成，继续研究使用患者数据生成合成医学图像相关的隐私和安全问题，现已举办第四届。本届引入三个互补的子任务：第一个子任务延续前几届，要求参与者检测哪些真实图像被用于训练生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Network, GAN）以产生给定的合成输出；第二个是新颖的子任务，要求参与者识别哪个潜在向量产生了每张合成图像，以探查潜在向量到图像映射的忠实性和可逆性；第三个要求参与者生成保护隐私的 CT 切片，量化图像保真度与患者隐私之间的权衡。为所有子任务提供了真实和 GAN 生成的肺部 CT 切片的真实标注和基准数据集。评估基于子任务 1 的 Cohen's Kappa、子任务 2 的匹配准确率，以及子任务 3 的 FID 与隐私保护分数（Privacy Preservation Score, PPS）的组合。总体而言，37 支团队注册了该任务，其中 10 支团队提交了跨子任务的运行结果，6 支团队提交了工作笔记论文。本文概述了任务设置、数据集、评估指标，并总结了参赛团队的方法和结果。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Hospital Medicine: Governance, Ethics, Education, Research, and the Future Workforce.
zh_title: 儿科医院医学中的AI：治理、伦理与教育
summary: 综述讨论儿科住院AI的治理、伦理、算法偏倚、可解释性与医学教育挑战。
key_points: 家庭对AI辅助诊疗的接受依赖透明与人工监督
需治理问责、隐私、监管空白与部署后监测
算法偏倚与数据代表性可能加剧健康不平等
reason: 有信息量的治理伦理综述，按综述档最高6分，无新数据
abstract: [Pediatric annals] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing pediatric inpatient care, extending beyond clinical applications to many areas of health care delivery, medical education, and research. Studies suggest that families are receptive to AI-assisted care if transparency, human oversight, and shared decision making are maintained. Effective governance is necessary to address concerns related to accountability, privacy, regulatory gaps, postdeployment monitoring, and equitable implementation. Algorithmic bias, data representativeness, informed consent, and the potential for AI to exacerbate health care disparities pose new ethical concerns. Explainable AI may improve transparency, trust, and acceptance by clinicians through making AI-generated recommendations more understandable. AI can also transform medical education through personalized learning, simulation, and clinical decision support, while requiring new competencies in AI literacy. AI offers opportunities to expedite clinical trials and data analysis but requires pediatric-specific frameworks to address age-related bias and emphasize ethical use of pediatric data in research. Responsible implementation, strong oversight, multidisciplinary collaboration, and continued clinician leadership will be essential to realizing AI's potential while safeguarding the welfare of pediatric patients and their families.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric annals] 人工智能（AI）正日益影响儿科住院诊疗，其影响已超出临床应用，扩展至医疗服务提供、医学教育和研究的许多领域。研究表明，如果保持透明度、人工监督和共同决策，家庭对AI辅助诊疗持接受态度。有效治理对于应对问责、隐私、监管空白、部署后监测和公平实施相关担忧是必要的。算法偏倚、数据代表性、知情同意以及AI可能加剧医疗保健差异，提出了新的伦理问题。可解释AI通过使AI生成的建议更易理解，可能提高透明度、信任度和临床医生的接受度。AI还可通过个性化学习、模拟和临床决策支持改变医学教育，同时要求具备AI素养的新能力。AI为加快临床试验和数据分析提供了机会，但需要儿科特异性框架来解决年龄相关偏倚，并强调在研究中对儿科数据的伦理使用。负责任的实施、强有力的监督、多学科协作和持续的临床医生领导，对于实现AI潜力同时保障儿科患者及其家庭福祉至关重要。

title: AI-Based Digital Pathology Model for Predicting Treatment Response and Prognosis in mHSPC
zh_title: AI数字病理模型预测mHSPC治疗反应的多中心研究
summary: 湘雅医院注册多中心观察研究，拟用AI数字病理模型预测转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌的治疗反应与预后。
key_points: 入组1115例，多中心观察设计
预测6-7个月PSA深度缓解（<0.2 ng/mL）
同时预测进展与预后，尚无结果
reason: 多中心大样本注册研究，但尚无结果，仅登记信息，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Xiangya Hospital of Central South University; conditions: Prostate Cancer, mCRPC (Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1115; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] The goal of this multicenter observational study is to develop and validate an artificial intelligence-based digital pathology model to predict treatment response and prognosis in adult men with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus androgen receptor signaling inhibitors. The main questions it aims to answer are: Can digital pathology-based artificial intelligence predict deep prostate-specific antigen response, defined as prostate-specific antigen less than 0.2 ng/mL at 6 to 7 months after treatment? Can digital pathology-based artificial intelligence predict progression to metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and time to metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer? Researchers will compare artificial intelligence-defined low-risk and high-risk groups to evaluate whether the model can improve prediction of treatment response and prognosis beyond conventional clinicopathological risk stratification. Participants will not receive any additional intervention as part of this study. Researchers will retrospectively collect clinical characteristics, treatment records, prostate-specific antigen response data, follow-up outcomes, and archived prostate biopsy slides from participating centers. The biopsy slides will be scanned into whole-slide images and analyzed using artificial intelligence to develop and validate predictive models.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中南大学湘雅医院；疾病：前列腺癌、mCRPC（转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌）；类型：干预性；分期：NA；入组人数：1115；状态：ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] 这项多中心观察性研究的目标是开发并验证一种基于人工智能的数字病理模型，用于预测接受雄激素剥夺治疗联合雄激素受体信号抑制剂的成年转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌男性的治疗反应和预后。它旨在回答的主要问题是：基于数字病理的人工智能能否预测深度前列腺特异性抗原反应，即治疗后 6 至 7 个月时前列腺特异性抗原低于 0.2 ng/mL？基于数字病理的人工智能能否预测向转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌的进展以及至转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌的时间？研究人员将比较人工智能定义的低风险组和高风险组，以评估该模型能否在传统临床病理风险分层之外改善对治疗反应和预后的预测。作为本研究的一部分，参与者不会接受任何额外干预。研究人员将回顾性收集参与中心的临床特征、治疗记录、前列腺特异性抗原反应数据、随访结局和存档的前列腺活检切片。活检切片将被扫描为全切片图像，并使用人工智能进行分析，以开发和验证预测模型。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Imaging for Diagnosis and Management of Focal Liver Lesions
zh_title: AI辅助影像诊断与管理局灶性肝病变
summary: 中山大学发起的万人级前瞻性干预试验注册，评估AI辅助影像在局灶性肝病变诊疗中的价值。
key_points: 新注册试验，尚无结果，正在招募
计划入组10000例，干预性设计
目标为鉴别影像特征重叠的肝病变类型
reason: 万人级前瞻性干预试验注册，规模可观但尚无结果与验证数据。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sun Yat-sen University; conditions: Focal Liver Lesions; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 10000; status: RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate the clinical value of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted medical imaging in the diagnosis and management of focal liver lesions. Accurate diagnosis of focal liver lesions is important for selecting appropriate treatment strategies. However, distinguishing between different types of liver lesions can be challenging because of overlapping imaging features. AI-based imaging systems may help improve diagnostic accuracy and support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中山大学；疾病：局灶性肝脏病变；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：10000；状态：招募中] 本研究旨在评估人工智能（AI）辅助医学影像在局灶性肝脏病变诊断和管理中的临床价值。局灶性肝脏病变的准确诊断对于选择适当的治疗策略很重要。然而，由于影像特征重叠，区分不同类型的肝脏病变可能具有挑战性。基于AI的影像系统可能有助于提高诊断准确性并支持临床决策。

title: LLM-Supported Pain Neuroscience Education for Physiotherapy Students
zh_title: LLM辅助物理治疗学生疼痛神经科学教育：RCT注册
summary: 一项已完成、尚未公布结果的随机对照试验注册，比较大语言模型反馈与专家反馈对物理治疗学生疼痛解释能力的影响。
key_points: 随机对照试验，纳入120名本科物理治疗学生
干预为在四周疼痛神经科学教育中加入LLM结构化反馈
主要结局为疼痛解释能力，结果尚未公布
reason: RCT设计与教育结局是加分项，但样本小、无结果，仅注册信息
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: İsmail Palalı; conditions: Pain, Chronic Pain, Health Professions Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] Physiotherapists need to explain pain to patients in a way that is scientifically accurate, understandable, and non-threatening. Pain neuroscience education (PNE) improves students' pain knowledge, but it is unclear whether this translates into retained ability to explain pain to patients. This randomized controlled trial tested whether adding structured feedback from a large language model (LLM; GPT-5.2 Instant, OpenAI, via the ChatGPT interface) to a standardized four-week PNE programme improves undergraduate physiotherapy students' pain-explanation competence compared with the same programme using standardized expert-developed (non-AI) feedback. The primary outcome was Pain Explanation Competence (PEC) on a previously unseen clinical transfer scenario, assessed without AI access 12 weeks after the intervention by three assessors blinded to group allocation.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：İsmail Palalı；疾病/状况：疼痛、慢性疼痛、卫生职业教育；类型：干预性；分期：NA；入组人数：120；状态：已完成] 物理治疗师需要以科学准确、易于理解且不具威胁性的方式向患者解释疼痛。疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）可改善学生的疼痛知识，但其是否能转化为向患者解释疼痛的保留能力尚不清楚。这项随机对照试验检验了在标准化为期四周的 PNE 方案中加入来自大语言模型（LLM；GPT-5.2 Instant，OpenAI，通过 ChatGPT 界面）的结构化反馈，与使用由专家制定的标准化（非 AI）反馈的同一方案相比，是否能提高本科物理治疗学生的疼痛解释能力。主要结局是在先前未见过的临床迁移场景中的疼痛解释能力（PEC），在干预后 12 周由三名对分组分配设盲的评估者在无 AI 访问的情况下进行评估。

title: Effect of AI-Assisted Hand Hygiene Training on Hand Hygiene Competency in Newly Hired Workers
zh_title: AI辅助手卫生培训对新员工胜任力的影响
summary: 邵逸夫医院注册的干预性试验，260名新入职人员比较AI实时反馈培训与常规带教的手卫生技能差异，尚无结果。
key_points: 干预性试验，入组260人，已完成

title: Ethical Governance of Artificial Intelligence in Nursing Management: Frameworks, Challenges, and Leadership Imperatives.

abstract: [Journal of nursing management] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in healthcare organizations, influencing workforce management, operational decision-making, quality monitoring, and resource allocation. While AI offers opportunities to improve efficiency and organizational performance, its implementation also introduces significant ethical challenges related to privacy, transparency, accountability, bias, and workforce equity. Nurse leaders occupy a pivotal position in shaping how AI is integrated into healthcare systems and ensuring that technological innovation aligns with professional nursing values. This editorial examines ethical AI governance as a leadership imperative in nursing management, drawing on the American Nurses Association Code of Ethics, World Health Organization guidance, leadership theory, sociotechnical systems theory, and equity-centered scholarship. Key ethical concerns associated with AI-enabled management are explored, including algorithmic bias, workforce surveillance, explainability, and accountability in decision-making. The discussion highlights the responsibility of nurse managers to establish governance structures that protect human dignity, promote justice, and preserve professional judgment. To support this work, the Ethical AI Governance Framework for Nursing Management (EAG-NM) is proposed as a conceptual model integrating ethical foundations, leadership imperatives, sociotechnical dynamics, equity safeguards, and organizational governance. The framework positions nurse leaders as ethical stewards of AI adoption and emphasizes workforce readiness, interdisciplinary oversight, and organizational accountability. As AI continues to transform healthcare operations, nursing leadership must move beyond technology implementation toward intentional governance that ensures AI is deployed in ways that are transparent, equitable, and consistent with the profession's moral commitments.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Nursing Management] 人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）正日益嵌入医疗组织，影响劳动力管理、运营决策、质量监测和资源分配。虽然 AI 为改善效率和组织绩效提供了机会，但其实施也引入了与隐私、透明度、问责、偏见和劳动力公平相关的重大伦理挑战。护士领导者在塑造 AI 如何整合入医疗系统以及确保技术创新与专业护理价值观一致方面占据关键位置。这篇社论将伦理 AI 治理视为护理管理中的领导力要务，借鉴美国护士协会伦理准则、世界卫生组织指南、领导力理论、社会技术系统理论以及以公平为中心的学术研究。文章探讨了与 AI 赋能管理相关的关键伦理问题，包括算法偏见、员工监控、可解释性和决策中的问责。讨论强调了护士管理者建立保护人的尊严、促进公正并维护专业判断的治理结构的责任。为支持这项工作，提出了护理管理伦理 AI 治理框架（Ethical AI Governance Framework for Nursing Management，EAG-NM），作为一个整合伦理基础、领导力要务、社会技术动态、公平保障和组织治理的概念模型。该框架将护士领导者定位为 AI 采用的伦理守护者，并强调劳动力准备度、跨学科监督和组织问责。随着 AI 持续转变医疗运营，护理领导必须超越技术实施，转向有意识的治理，以确保 AI 以透明、公平且与专业道德承诺一致的方式部署。

abstract: [Internal medicine journal] We conducted an exploratory mixed-methods study of clinician attitudes and editing behaviours towards artificial intelligence (AI)-generated discharge summaries. Five clinicians reviewed three summaries and indicated what changes they would make and why, answered a questionnaire, engaged in semi-structured interviews and viewed screen mock-ups of additional editing features. All clinicians expressed positive sentiments and saw AI as saving time. Edits were driven by professional pride and etiquette, most of which were not corrections of factual errors but optimisation of structure, coherence, conciseness, reasoning and tone. Tension arose between desire for personalised content versus potential benefits of standardisation. Various novel editing features were seen as expediting summary review.
zh_abstract: [Internal Medicine Journal] 我们开展了一项探索性混合方法研究，考察临床医生对人工智能（AI）生成出院小结的态度和编辑行为。五名临床医生审阅了三份小结，并指出他们会做哪些修改以及原因，回答了一份问卷，参与了半结构化访谈，并观看了额外编辑功能的屏幕原型。所有临床医生均表达了积极看法，并认为AI能够节省时间。编辑行为受职业自豪感和礼仪驱动，其中大多数并非纠正事实错误，而是优化结构、连贯性、简洁性、推理和语气。对个性化内容的期望与标准化的潜在益处之间产生了张力。各种新颖的编辑功能被认为能够加快小结审阅。

abstract: [Physics and imaging in radiation oncology] Background and purpose: Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into radiotherapy workflows, yet it remains vulnerable to out-of-distribution image data that can introduce unexpected behavior in clinical tasks. Deep learning (DL)-based anomaly detection for pelvic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains limited and transparent evaluation for full automation is lacking. This study aimed to develop two self-supervised anomaly-detection framework variations in radiotherapy for pelvic and brain MRI. Materials and methods: A two-stage self-supervised DL-framework was trained separately for pelvic and brain MRI utilizing three public datasets. The first stage compressed normal image data into discrete representations, and a second stage modeled the representation distribution. Anomaly-evidence was obtained by combining perceptual image differences with token-surprisal scores via negative log-likelihood estimation. Automated detection was evaluated for two anatomical cohorts: pelvis, encompassing both synthetic global anomalies and real clinical anomalies, and brain, comprising clinically annotated anomalies. Performance was assessed using sensitivity, specificity, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). For each cohort, a subset of normal images was reserved for analysis. Results: Promising exploratory performance across evaluation cohorts was obtained. AUCs were 0.97 (95% CI 0.96-0.99) for synthetic pelvic anomalies, 0.95 (95% CI 0.90-1.00) for clinical pelvic anomalies, and 0.81 (95% CI 0.74-0.87) for brain anomalies. Qualitative heatmap analysis showed spatial agreement between detected anomalies and reference annotations. Conclusions: The framework variations showed promising anomaly detection performance across pelvic and brain MRI, supporting its potential for automated MRI quality control in radiotherapy. Heatmap-based visualization further improved interpretability by spatially localizing detected anomalies.
zh_abstract: [Physics and imaging in radiation oncology] 【背景与目的】人工智能正日益整合到放疗工作流程中，但它仍然容易受到分布外图像数据的影响，这些数据可能在临床任务中引入意外行为。针对盆腔磁共振成像（MRI）的基于深度学习（DL）的异常检测仍然有限，并且缺乏用于完全自动化的透明评估。本研究旨在开发两种用于盆腔和脑部 MRI 放疗的自监督异常检测框架变体。【材料与方法】利用三个公共数据集，分别为盆腔和脑部 MRI 训练一个两阶段自监督 DL 框架。第一阶段将正常图像数据压缩为离散表示，第二阶段对表示分布进行建模。通过负对数似然估计，将感知图像差异与 token 惊奇度评分相结合，获得异常证据。对两个解剖队列评估自动检测：盆腔队列（涵盖合成全局异常和真实临床异常）和脑部队列（包含临床标注异常）。使用灵敏度、特异度和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估性能。对于每个队列，保留一部分正常图像用于分析。【结果】在各评估队列中获得了有前景的探索性性能。AUC 分别为：合成盆腔异常 0.97（95% CI 0.96-0.99），临床盆腔异常 0.95（95% CI 0.90-1.00），脑部异常 0.81（95% CI 0.74-0.87）。定性热图分析显示检测到的异常与参考标注之间存在空间一致性。【结论】这些框架变体在盆腔和脑部 MRI 中显示出有前景的异常检测性能，支持其在放疗中用于自动 MRI 质量控制的潜力。基于热图的可视化通过空间定位检测到的异常，进一步提高了可解释性。

title: CrossBoneNet: An Ultralightweight Hybrid CNN-ViT Architecture via Asymmetric Reversed Cross-Attention for Radiographic Fracture Detection.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Misdiagnoses in emergency departments are often associated with the difficulty in interpreting radiological findings on bone fractures due to millimetric fractures, overlapping bones, or superimpositions. Despite the high efficiency of state-of-the-art models in diagnosing such cases, their massive computational requirements severely hinder their implementation on resource-constrained devices in real-world clinical settings. In this study, we propose an ultralightweight CNN-ViT model, CrossBoneNet, which is designed for edge AI compatibility with minimal memory requirements. CrossBoneNet combines local microfracture detection using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and global anatomical recognition using vision transformers (ViTs). The model merges features from both architectures using the proposed asymmetric reversed cross-attention, where CNN features act as queries and ViT features act as keys and values-to efficiently map fine-grained local anomalies into a broader global anatomical context. Operating with a minimal parameter count (0.593 M) and low computational cost (1.527 GFLOPs), CrossBoneNet achieved a PR-AUC of 0.8498 ± 0.0086 and a ROC-AUC of 0.8427 ± 0.0072 on the MURA dataset in a patient-wise isolated evaluation. It achieves highly competitive performance-remaining within a 4% margin of the 88.59 million parameter ConvNeXt-Base model-while delivering over 99% memory savings. After fine-tuning on the FracAtlas dataset, CrossBoneNet achieved a specificity of 0.9760 ± 0.0080 and PR-AUC of 0.7568 ± 0.0414, demonstrating effective cross-domain transfer learning. With a compact footprint (< 3 MB) and high specificity at the default 0.50 operating threshold, CrossBoneNet demonstrates potential as a point-of-care decision support and worklist prioritization tool on resource-constrained devices, while calibrating the decision threshold (e.g., τ = 0.3837 and τ = 0.3449 ) enables high-sensitivity screening modes (achieving 85.03% and 89.96% sensitivity on MURA, respectively), pending prospective validation. This retrospective study establishes proof of concept; future work will focus on prospective clinical trials and expansion to multiclass fracture classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine] 急诊科误诊常与解读骨折影像学表现困难相关，原因包括毫米级骨折、骨骼重叠或影像重叠。尽管最先进模型在诊断此类病例方面效率很高，但其巨大的计算需求严重阻碍其在真实临床环境中资源受限设备上的实施。本研究提出一种超轻量CNN-ViT模型CrossBoneNet，其设计用于边缘AI兼容并具有最小内存需求。CrossBoneNet结合使用卷积神经网络（CNN）进行局部微骨折检测和使用视觉Transformer（ViT）进行整体解剖识别。该模型使用所提出的非对称反向交叉注意力融合两种架构的特征，其中CNN特征作为查询，ViT特征作为键和值，以高效地将细粒度局部异常映射到更广泛的整体解剖背景中。CrossBoneNet以最小参数量（0.593 M）和低计算成本（1.527 GFLOPs）运行，在按患者隔离的评估中，于MURA数据集上达到PR-AUC 0.8498 ± 0.0086和ROC-AUC 0.8427 ± 0.0072。其性能极具竞争力——与8859万参数的ConvNeXt-Base模型相差在4%以内——同时节省超过99%的内存。在FracAtlas数据集上微调后，CrossBoneNet达到特异性0.9760 ± 0.0080和PR-AUC 0.7568 ± 0.0414，证明有效的跨域迁移学习。凭借紧凑占用（< 3 MB）和在默认0.50操作阈值下的高特异性，CrossBoneNet显示出作为资源受限设备上的床旁决策支持和工作列表优先级排序工具的潜力；而校准决策阈值（例如τ = 0.3837和τ = 0.3449）可实现高灵敏度筛查模式（在MURA上分别达到85.03%和89.96%的灵敏度），尚待前瞻性验证。这项回顾性研究确立了概念验证；未来工作将聚焦于前瞻性临床试验以及扩展到多类骨折分类。

abstract: Abstract Background: Ambient AI documentation reduces documentation burden and electronic health record (EHR) time for ambulatory clinicians. Newer features also queue orders and offer some level of coding support for clinician review. This study compares two commercial products deployed at UCLA Health. Objective: To compare Nabla and Epic Systems, Inc. ambient AI solution among ambulatory clinicians at UCLA Health on usability, documentation burden, perceived note quality, adoption, EHR time and productivity, clinician-reported experience with order queueing and coding support, coding and billing patterns and integrity, work productivity, and patient-reported communication experience. Methods: Two-arm parallel-group randomized trial, 1:1, among 374 ambulatory clinicians at a single academic health system who hold an active license for a standalone ambient application (Nabla). Randomization is covariate-constrained where cohort size permits, balancing age, sex, half-day clinic sessions, specialty group, and baseline System Usability Scale (SUS) score. Intervention runs 11/9/2026 to 1/17/2027, with the first four weeks as lead-in. The primary outcome is SUS score at follow-up, compared between arms. Analysis is by intention-to-treat using mixed-effects models. Ethics and dissemination: Determined exempt by the UCLA Institutional Review Board (IRB-26-2147). Survey completion indicates consent. No patient-level data are collected. Findings will directly inform operational decision making and will be published regardless of direction.
zh_abstract: 【背景】环境式 AI 记录可减轻门诊临床医生的记录负担和电子健康记录（EHR）时间。较新的功能还可将医嘱加入队列，并提供一定程度的编码支持供临床医生审核。本研究比较了在 UCLA Health 部署的两种商业产品。【目的】在 UCLA Health 的门诊临床医生中比较 Nabla 与 Epic Systems, Inc. 的环境式 AI 解决方案，比较内容包括可用性、记录负担、感知记录质量、采用情况、EHR 时间和生产力、临床医生报告的关于医嘱排队和编码支持的经验、编码和计费模式及完整性、工作生产力，以及患者报告的沟通体验。【方法】在单一学术卫生系统中持有独立环境式应用程序（Nabla）有效许可证的 374 名门诊临床医生中开展双臂平行组随机试验，按 1:1 分配。在队列规模允许时采用协变量约束随机化，平衡年龄、性别、半日门诊场次、专科组和基线系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale，SUS）评分。干预时间为 2026 年 11 月 9 日至 2027 年 1 月 17 日，前四周为导入期。主要结局是随访时的 SUS 评分，在组间进行比较。分析采用意向性治疗原则，使用混合效应模型。【伦理与传播】经 UCLA 机构审查委员会（Institutional Review Board，IRB-26-2147）判定为豁免。完成调查即表示知情同意。不收集患者层面数据。研究结果将直接为运营决策提供信息，且无论结果方向如何都将发表。
