abstract: Motivation: Toxicologists today face a challenge: although vast amounts of data describing how chemicals affect human health are available across scientific publications and regulatory reports, much of this information remains underutilized because extracting and interpreting evidence across thousands of studies is impractical to perform manually. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in large language models (LLMs), provide new opportunities to automate toxicological literature analysis. Results: Herein, we present the Adverse Outcome Pathway Toolkit (AOPTK), an open-source Python package for AI-enhanced analysis of toxicological and biomedical literature. AOPTK supports (i) automated literature retrieval from databases such as PubMed Central and Europe PMC, (ii) direct processing of full-text articles in PDF format, and (iii) LLM-assisted analysis tools to identify chemicals and extract their relationships to biological effects under user-defined conditions. We demonstrate its utilities through a case-study identifying potential non-genotoxic carcinogens based on their ability to inhibit gap junction intercellular communication (GJIC). The LLM-enhanced analysis achieves 81% agreement with an expert-curated inhibitor list and 95% accuracy in predicting inhibition versus no inhibition when analysing the same subset of 86 publications. Automated retrieval and analysis of 1 124 publications from PubMed Central further demonstrated the feasibility of applying AOPTK to large-scale literature analyses. Availability: The package is developed open source on GitHub, disseminated through PyPI and Bioconda and releases are archived on Zenodo. Individual tools are available in the Galaxy platform for accessible data analysis with user-friendly, findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable (FAIR) and end-to-end workflows provided via WorkflowHub. The tools are available on usegalaxy.eu and usegalaxy.cz and are developed open source on GitHub.
zh_abstract: 【动机】当今毒理学家面临一个挑战：尽管科学出版物和监管报告中已有大量描述化学品如何影响人类健康的数据，但其中许多信息仍未得到充分利用，因为跨数千项研究提取和解释证据无法实际手动完成。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是大语言模型（LLM），为自动化毒理学文献分析提供了新机会。【结果】在此，我们介绍不良结局通路工具包（Adverse Outcome Pathway Toolkit，AOPTK），这是一个用于毒理学和生物医学文献 AI 增强分析的开源 Python 包。AOPTK 支持（i）从 PubMed Central 和 Europe PMC 等数据库自动检索文献，（ii）直接处理 PDF 格式的全文文章，以及（iii）LLM 辅助分析工具，用于识别化学品并在用户定义条件下提取其与生物学效应的关系。我们通过一个案例研究展示其实用性，该研究基于潜在非遗传毒性致癌物抑制缝隙连接细胞间通讯（GJIC）的能力来识别这些致癌物。在分析同一组 86 篇出版物时，LLM 增强分析与专家整理的抑制剂列表达到 81% 的一致性，并在预测抑制与无抑制方面达到 95% 的准确率。对来自 PubMed Central 的 1 124 篇出版物进行自动检索和分析，进一步证明了将 AOPTK 应用于大规模文献分析的可行性。【可用性】该包在 GitHub 上开源开发，通过 PyPI 和 Bioconda 分发，发布版本归档于 Zenodo。各个工具可在 Galaxy 平台中使用，以支持可访问的数据分析，并通过 WorkflowHub 提供用户友好、可发现、可访问、可互操作和可重用（FAIR）及端到端的工作流。这些工具可在 usegalaxy.eu 和 usegalaxy.cz 上使用，并在 GitHub 上开源开发。

title: Multi-Agent Generative Artificial Intelligence for Transfusion Reaction Feature Extraction
zh_title: 多智能体生成式AI提取输血反应特征
summary: 开源多智能体管线用三个开放权重模型从自由文本笔记提取输血反应特征，两名医师盲评。
key_points: 基于NHSN协议整理181项特征
50份笔记，仅测试三个开放权重模型
两名医师独立盲法评估全部输出
reason: 开源智能体管线加医师盲评，但预印本、仅50份笔记，证据有限
abstract: BACKGROUND: Many transfusion reactions are not reported to hemovigilance systems, and the features needed to recognize them are often documented only in free-text clinical notes. We sought to develop and evaluate an open-source, multi-agent artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline to extract transfusion reaction features defined by the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) Hemovigilance Module from clinical notes. METHODS: We curated 181 features from the NHSN protocol and developed a multi-stage pipeline that extracted features, their timing, and clinical details from free-text notes. Three open-weight large language models (Qwen 3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Kimi K3) were applied to 50 notes from expert-written scenarios, published case reports, and MIMIC-IV discharge summaries. Two physicians independently evaluated every model output in a blinded interface. The primary analysis was restricted to feature occurrences with concordant physician assessments. RESULTS: Physicians agreed on 1,201 of 1,343 co-rated feature occurrences (89.4%; Krippendorff's alpha 0.73). Precision was above 0.98 for all models. Sensitivity was 0.774 (95% CI 0.745-0.800) for Kimi K3, 0.636 (0.604-0.667) for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.624 (0.593-0.655) for Qwen 3.6-27B, and specificity ranged from 0.952 to 0.991. Omissions accounted for more than 94% of false negatives. Timing and clinical details were judged supported or reasonable in more than 92% and 97% of assessments, respectively. Results were consistent across note sources and in analyses including discordant assessments. CONCLUSION: Multi-agent AI pipelines provide a feasible method for extracting transfusion reaction signals from clinical notes with high precision. Our work may have applications in active hemovigilance, reaction classification, and big data research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】许多输血反应未上报至血液警戒系统，而识别这些反应所需的特征往往仅记录在自由文本临床笔记中。我们旨在开发并评估一个开源的多智能体人工智能（AI）流程，以从临床笔记中提取由 National Healthcare Safety Network（NHSN）Hemovigilance Module 定义的输血反应特征。【方法】我们从NHSN方案中整理了181个特征，并开发了一个多阶段流程，从自由文本笔记中提取特征、其发生时间及临床细节。将三个开放权重的大语言模型（Qwen 3.6-27B、GPT-OSS-120B和Kimi K3）应用于50份笔记，这些笔记来自专家编写的情景、已发表的病例报告和MIMIC-IV出院摘要。两名医生在盲法界面中独立评估每个模型输出。主要分析仅限于医生评估一致的特征出现项。【结果】医生对1,343个共同评分的特征出现项中的1,201个达成一致（89.4%；Krippendorff's alpha 0.73）。所有模型的精确率均高于0.98。Kimi K3的敏感度为0.774（95% CI 0.745-0.800），GPT-OSS-120B为0.636（0.604-0.667），Qwen 3.6-27B为0.624（0.593-0.655），特异度范围为0.952至0.991。遗漏占假阴性的94%以上。分别有超过92%和97%的评估认为时间信息和临床细节有支持或合理。结果在笔记来源间以及纳入不一致评估的分析中均一致。【结论】多智能体AI流程提供了一种可行的方法，能够以高精确率从临床笔记中提取输血反应信号。我们的工作可能应用于主动血液警戒、反应分类和大数据研究。

title: Leave-One-Out-Cross-Validation Based Machine Learning Algorithms for Efficient, Scalable, and Robust Prediction of Artemisinin Resistance in Plasmodium falciparum Kelch13 mutants.
zh_title: 机器学习预测疟原虫青蒿素耐药
summary: bioRxiv预印本用机器学习基于K13突变理化结构偏差预测青蒿素敏感或耐药表型。
key_points: 构建40个代表性K13突变体特征集
以相对野生型的理化与结构偏差作输入
目标为替代耗时RSA的快速变异株分型
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，验证规模有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Emerging Plasmodium falciparum resistance to frontline artemisinin (ART) derivatives threatens global malaria control efforts. Current protocols assigning ART-sensitive (ART-S) or -resistant (ART-R) phenotypes to parasite strains with Kelch13 (K13) mutations remain time-intensive for real-time surveillance. Ring-survival assay (RSA), an ex vivo gold standard mandates laboratory-adaptation under culture conditions and frequently does not replicate clinical ART-responsiveness, thereby limiting its utility for rapidly triaging newly emerging K13 variants. In contrast, advent of artificial intelligence (AI)-derived models hold potential to screen >100 K13 variants within hours, enabling rapid near-real-time prediction of ART-S/R. Here, we engineered a panel of forty representative K13 variants by computing their relative deviations from wild-type K13 across ten physicochemical and structural descriptors, yielding a compact feature set which captures mutation-induced perturbations in folding, stability, and solvent exposure. These can be further utilized to train and validate AI classifier to predict resistance.
zh_abstract: 新出现的恶性疟原虫对一线青蒿素（ART）衍生物耐药威胁全球疟疾控制工作。当前将携带 Kelch13（K13）突变的寄生虫株分配为 ART 敏感（ART-S）或耐药（ART-R）表型的方案，对于实时监测仍然耗时。环状体存活试验（RSA）是一种 ex vivo 金标准，要求在培养条件下进行实验室适应，且常常不能复制临床 ART 反应性，从而限制了其快速分诊新出现的 K13 变异体的用途。相比之下，人工智能（AI）衍生模型的出现有潜力在数小时内筛选 >100 个 K13 变异体，从而能够快速近实时预测 ART-S/R。在此，我们通过计算 40 个代表性 K13 变异体在十项理化与结构描述符上相对于野生型 K13 的相对偏差，构建了一组这些变异体，产生了一个紧凑的特征集，可捕捉突变诱导的折叠、稳定性和溶剂暴露扰动。这些特征可进一步用于训练和验证 AI 分类器以预测耐药性。

title: Automated MRI-Based Segmentation of the Cranio-Cervical Venous System Using a Dedicated Deep Learning Pipeline
zh_title: 基于深度学习的颅颈静脉系统MRI自动分割
summary: 单中心回顾性研究用nnU-Net v2构建颅颈静脉系统MRI自动分割流程，五折平均DSC为0.94，并集成开源软件。
key_points: 单中心194例增强MRI，50例手工标注
nnU-Net v2迭代训练，五折DSC 0.94
流程开源为VenousNetworkAnalyzer
reason: 方法清晰且开源，但为单中心回顾性、仅内部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: PURPOSE To develop an automated magnetic resonance imaging based segmentation pipeline for the cranio-cervical venous system (CCVS), a complex anatomical network for which no dedicated segmentation tool is currently available. MATERIALS AND METHODS A retrospective single-center cohort of 194 contrast-enhanced cranio-cervical MRI examinations acquired between 2019 and 2024 was used. Manual reference segmentations were performed on 50 examinations using 3D Slicer. A nnU-Net v2-based segmentation model was trained through an iterative process combining automatic segmentation, manual correction, and retraining. Segmentation performance was assessed using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC). The complete processing pipeline was integrated into an open-source software application, VenousNetworkAnalyzer (VNA). RESULTS The final model achieved a mean DSC of 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.95) in five-fold cross-validation on 106 examinations with manual reference segmentations. Iterative optimization progressively reduced manual processing time from approximately 10 hours of fully manual segmentation to less than 10 minutes of manual correction per patient. Application of the final model to the entire cohort enabled the generation of patient-specific three-dimensional reconstructions of the cranio-cervical venous system. The segmentation workflow was successfully integrated into the VNA software environment, allowing automated processing and visualization of MRI datasets. CONCLUSION This study demonstrates the feasibility of automated segmentation of the cranio-cervical venous system from contrast-enhanced MRI using a dedicated deep-learning pipeline. The resulting reduction in processing time and integration into an open-source software platform provide a foundation for future large-scale anatomical studies of cranio-cervical venous draina
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发一套基于磁共振成像的颅颈静脉系统（cranio-cervical venous system, CCVS）自动分割流程；该解剖网络复杂，目前尚无专用分割工具。【材料与方法】使用一个回顾性单中心队列，包含2019年至2024年间采集的194例对比增强颅颈MRI检查。使用3D Slicer在50例检查上完成人工参考分割。通过结合自动分割、人工校正和再训练的迭代过程，训练了一个基于nnU-Net v2的分割模型。使用Dice相似系数（Dice Similarity Coefficient, DSC）评估分割性能。完整处理流程已集成到开源软件应用VenousNetworkAnalyzer（VNA）中。【结果】最终模型在106例具有人工参考分割的检查上进行五折交叉验证，平均DSC为0.94（95% CI，0.93-0.95）。迭代优化将人工处理时间从完全人工分割约10小时逐步缩短至每例患者人工校正不足10分钟。将最终模型应用于整个队列，能够生成患者特异性的颅颈静脉系统三维重建。分割工作流已成功集成到VNA软件环境中，可对MRI数据集进行自动处理和可视化。【结论】本研究证明，使用专用深度学习流程从对比增强MRI自动分割颅颈静脉系统具有可行性。由此实现的处理时间缩短以及开源软件平台集成，为未来大规模颅颈静脉引流解剖研究奠定了基础。

title: BioLT: Streaming Biosignal Modeling
zh_title: BioLT：长时程生物信号的流式建模框架
summary: 预印本提出 BioLT 流式解码框架，可将窗口级信号模型转为可处理数小时长程生物信号的流式模型。
key_points: 不连续性感知编码把窗间间隔作为显式输入通道
固定大小压缩记忆库，训练与推理随记录长度线性增长
面向 ECG、PPG、EEG 等数小时长程监护与可穿戴信号
reason: 预印本新方法，思路有新意但无外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档。
abstract: Clinical biosignals such as ECG, PPG, and EEG are increasingly acquired as hours-long streams from bedside monitors and wearables, yet existing analysis pipelines almost universally operate on isolated short windows of around 10 seconds and cannot process the long, irregular, frequently interrupted signals. We introduce BioLT, a streaming decoder-only framework for long-context biosignal modeling that turns any window-level feature extractor or pretrained biosignal foundation model into a streaming model. BioLT combines (i) a discontinuity-aware encoding that exposes the inter-window elapsed time as an explicit input channel, so that the decoder can learn to model these gaps as clinically meaningful information, and (ii) a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics, which keeps both training and inference linear in the recording length while preserving long-range context. We evaluate on CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and for forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead, using domain features and embeddings from six biosignal foundation models. Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13 settings, and shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art snapshot foundation-model embeddings. These highlight the importance of modeling how streaming biosignal representations evolve over time, beyond improving window-level representations alone.
zh_abstract: 临床生物信号，如ECG、PPG和EEG，越来越多地以长达数小时的流形式从床旁监护仪和可穿戴设备中采集，然而现有的分析流程几乎普遍在约10秒的孤立短窗口上运行，无法处理长时、不规则、频繁中断的信号。我们介绍BioLT，一种用于长上下文生物信号建模的流式仅解码器框架，可将任何窗口级特征提取器或预训练生物信号基础模型转化为流式模型。BioLT结合了（i）不连续性感知编码，将窗口间经过时间作为显式输入通道暴露出来，使解码器能够学习将这些间隔建模为具有临床意义的信息，以及（ii）一个固定大小的压缩记忆库，用累积汇总统计量进行监督，使训练和推理均与记录长度呈线性关系，同时保留长程上下文。我们在CPSC-2021、VitalDB、MC-MED和CHB-MIT上评估心律失常、脓毒症和癫痫发作检测以及提前至20分钟的预测，使用领域特征和来自六个生物信号基础模型的嵌入。在21个数据集-特征设置中，BioLT在15个设置中实现了最高的检测AUROC，在13个设置中实现了最高的20分钟预测AUROC，并且相较于最先进的快照基础模型嵌入表现出持续的性能提升。这些结果突出了建模流式生物信号表示如何随时间演变的重要性，而不仅仅是改进窗口级表示。

title: mFrag: Integrating External DNA Methylation References Improves Lung Cancer Early Detection by Fragmentomics
zh_title: mFrag：融合外部甲基化参考提升肺癌早检
summary: 预印本提出 mFrag，将外部 DNA 甲基化图谱与片段组学特征结合用于肺癌早期检测，并在独立测试集评估。
key_points: mFrag-Weight 用甲基化信息为片段组学特征加权
mFrag-Net 以神经网络融合片段组学与外部甲基化数据
训练 287 人，独立测试集含 385 例对照与 46 例癌症
reason: 预印本有独立测试集，但癌症样本仅 46 例，属值得一看档。
abstract: Fragmentomics analyzes features of circulating cell-free DNA fragments (e.g., fragment length or end motifs) derived from whole-genome sequencing of liquid biopsy samples (blood or other body fluids), enabling non-invasive early cancer detection. Here we present mFrag, a framework that integrates external methylation reference atlases with fragmentomic features for lung cancer detection. mFrag comprises two complementary methods: mFrag-Weight, which uses DNA methylation information to weight fragmentomic features, and mFrag-Net, which integrates fragmentomic features and external DNA methylation data through neural networks. We average the output probabilities of the two methods to obtain a final prediction score. The mFrag model was trained using 287 individuals at risk for lung cancer. In an independent case-control testing set comprising 385 non-cancer controls and 46 cancers (28 stage I, 12 stage II, and 6 stage III or IV), mFrag outperforms a DELFI-style fragmentomic approach, improving PR-AUC from 0.455 to 0.720 and sensitivity at 99% specificity from 0.043 to 0.478, with ROC-AUC from 0.871 to 0.908. For stage I lung cancer, mFrag raises PR-AUC from 0.314 to 0.558 and ROC-AUC from 0.855 to 0.894. Applied to end 4-mer motif features, mFrag likewise improved over an unweighted baseline, with gains contributed by both mFrag-Weight and mFrag-Net. In summary, mFrag improves the accuracy of fragmentomics-based lung cancer detection through integrating external DNA methylation data and the complementarity of its two component models, without incurring any additional data-generating cost.
zh_abstract: 片段组学分析源自液体活检样本（血液或其他体液）全基因组测序的循环细胞游离 DNA 片段特征（如片段长度或末端基序），从而实现无创早期癌症检测。在此，我们提出 mFrag，这是一个整合外部甲基化参考图谱与片段组学特征用于肺癌检测的框架。mFrag 包含两种互补方法：mFrag-Weight 利用 DNA 甲基化信息对片段组学特征进行加权，mFrag-Net 通过神经网络整合片段组学特征与外部 DNA 甲基化数据。我们将两种方法输出的概率取平均，得到最终预测评分。mFrag 模型使用 287 名肺癌风险个体进行训练。在包含 385 名非癌症对照和 46 名癌症患者（28 例 I 期、12 例 II 期和 6 例 III 期或 IV 期）的独立病例对照测试集中，mFrag 优于 DELFI 风格的片段组学方法，将 PR-AUC 从 0.455 提高到 0.720，将在 99% 特异性下的敏感性从 0.043 提高到 0.478，并将 ROC-AUC 从 0.871 提高到 0.908。对于 I 期肺癌，mFrag 将 PR-AUC 从 0.314 提高到 0.558，将 ROC-AUC 从 0.855 提高到 0.894。应用于末端 4-mer 基序特征时，mFrag 同样优于未加权基线，其增益由 mFrag-Weight 和 mFrag-Net 共同贡献。总之，mFrag 通过整合外部 DNA 甲基化数据及其两个组成模型的互补性，提高了基于片段组学的肺癌检测准确性，且未产生任何额外数据生成成本。

title: Rapid generation of antibody conformational ensembles using machine learning
zh_title: 机器学习快速生成抗体构象系综
summary: bioRxiv预印本提出生成框架Cadense，由序列生成多样Fv构象系综，将分子动力学数天计算缩短至秒级。
key_points: 从序列生成抗体Fv构象系综
匹配MD的构象与生物物理性质分布
可同时恢复同一抗体的apo与holo构象
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，证据限于方法层面，属值得一看档
abstract: We introduce Cadense, a generative framework for antibody ensemble prediction that produces diverse Fv structures from sequence, informed by conformational dynamics. While a valuable resource, static structure prediction provides only a single snapshot of dynamic proteins, whose motions influence their binding and other properties. This is particularly relevant for antibodies, an important class of molecules for drug discovery, where flexible complementarity determining region (CDR) loops are difficult to model with static approaches. Cadense addresses this gap by generating ensembles that match conformational and biophysical property distributions from molecular dynamics (MD), while reducing the computational burden from days of simulation to seconds of generation. We show Cadense ensembles can recover both apo and holo conformations of the same antibody and serve as effective input to physics-based docking, capturing the conformational flexibility important to properly model antibody antigen interactions. Together, these results establish Cadense as a useful tool for antibody conformational ensemble generation with the promise to enable faster, dynamics-aware antibody design.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍 Cadense，一种用于抗体集合预测（antibody ensemble prediction）的生成式框架，它从序列产生多样的 Fv 结构，并以构象动力学为依据。静态结构预测虽然是有价值的资源，但仅提供动态蛋白的单一快照，而蛋白运动会影响其结合及其他性质。这对抗体尤其相关，抗体是药物发现中一类重要分子，其灵活的互补决定区（complementarity determining region, CDR）环难以用静态方法建模。Cadense 通过生成与分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）的构象和生物物理性质分布相匹配的集合来填补这一空白，同时将计算负担从数天模拟降低到数秒生成。我们表明，Cadense 集合能够恢复同一抗体的 apo 和 holo 构象，并可作为基于物理的对接的有效输入，捕获对正确建模抗体-抗原相互作用重要的构象灵活性。总之，这些结果确立 Cadense 作为抗体构象集合生成的有用工具，并有望实现更快速、动力学感知的抗体设计。

title: GeneEmbedLLM: Harnessing Large Language Models for Gene Functional Embedding and Association Prediction
zh_title: GeneEmbedLLM：用大模型生成基因功能嵌入
summary: 预印本提出基于Longformer与对比学习的框架，整合五个数据库文本生成基因嵌入并预测基因关联。
key_points: 整合五个权威数据库的多源结构化文本
基于Longformer的属性感知注意力
在分子互作、表型依赖等任务验证
reason: 预印本方法有新意，证据限于自身基准
abstract: Effective and high-quality gene function representations are crucial for bioinformatics tasks. While biological knowledge about genes is inherently textual, encompassing functional descriptions and pathway annotations, current methods often rely on single-source, non-textual data, failing to capture the rich semantic information in multi-source gene annotations. In this paper, we propose GeneEmbedLLM, a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered framework for generating universal, semantically-aware gene embeddings. The proposed approach advances the gene representation learning through multi-source structured text integration from five authoritative databases and attribute-aware attention based on Longformer architecture and contrastive learning. Experimental results on diverse downstream tasks, ranging from molecular interactions and phenotypic dependencies to epigenetic regulation, confirm the validity and effectiveness of our proposed approach, where competitive performance is achieved across all evaluated benchmarks. We further validate the quality of the generated embeddings through comprehensive analyses, including embedding visualizations, intra-pathway similarity assessments, ablation study, and parameter analysis.
zh_abstract: 有效且高质量的基因功能表征对生物信息学任务至关重要。尽管关于基因的生物学知识本质上是文本性的，包含功能描述和通路注释，但现有方法往往依赖单一来源的非文本数据，未能捕捉多来源基因注释中丰富的语义信息。本文提出 GeneEmbedLLM，一个由大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的框架，用于生成通用的、语义感知的基因嵌入。所提方法通过整合来自五个权威数据库的多源结构化文本，以及基于 Longformer 架构和对比学习的属性感知注意力，推进基因表征学习。在从分子相互作用和表型依赖到表观遗传调控等多种下游任务上的实验结果，证实了所提方法的有效性和实效性，在所有评估基准上均取得了有竞争力的性能。我们进一步通过综合分析验证所生成嵌入的质量，包括嵌入可视化、通路内相似性评估、消融研究和参数分析。

title: BioMeme: biological response memory for virtual cells
zh_title: BioMeme：面向虚拟细胞的生物响应记忆
summary: 预印本提出以实测实验记忆替代学习式状态-响应层，预测新细胞类型的下一剂量响应并可追溯到具体测量。
key_points: 预测结果为具名实测数据的加权和，可引用支撑实验
记忆更新只需一次线性求解，无需重训练
三项筛选中九组预注册比较的方向预测优于替代学习器
reason: 有新方法且预注册比较优于基线，但为预印本、仅在细胞筛选数据上验证
abstract: Virtual cells predict responses to unmeasured perturbations, but neural models absorb measurements into weights, require retraining and cannot cite supporting experiments. Here we introduce biological response memory, replacing a learned state-to-response layer with a memory of measured experiments. BioMeme predicts next-dose responses in a new cell type from measured lower-dose states, recalling similarly responding compounds in that cell and the same compound in a reference cell line. Each prediction is an exact weighted sum of named measurements, and memory updates with one linear solve. In all nine preregistered comparisons across three screens, memory predicted response direction better than the learners it replaced. In U2OS, BioMeme outperformed input-matched ridge, adapted chemCPA and a neural layer in memory's place, and matched a full-panel network reading reference responses directly (error within 3.4%). Transfer was compound-specific, lowering error by 21.2% against at most 1.8% for wrong compounds, and replicated in reserved MCF7 data. With 20 references, fitting took seconds on one CPU thread, at least 420 times faster than neural tuning and fitting. Adding its prediction to one measured well cut that well's error by 27-31%. Biological response memory establishes a design principle for virtual cells any laboratory can update, inspect and run.
zh_abstract: 虚拟细胞可预测对未测量扰动的响应，但神经模型将测量结果吸收到权重中，需要重新训练，且无法引用支持性实验。在此，我们提出生物响应记忆（biological response memory），用已测量实验的记忆取代学习到的状态到响应层。BioMeme 从测得的较低剂量状态预测新细胞类型中的下一剂量反应，回忆该细胞中反应相似的化合物以及参考细胞系中的同一化合物。每个预测都是具名测量的精确加权和，记忆通过一次线性求解更新。在三项筛选中的全部九项预注册比较中，记忆在预测反应方向方面优于其所取代的学习器。在 U2OS 中，BioMeme 优于输入匹配岭回归、适配的 chemCPA 以及置于记忆位置的神经层，并与直接读取参考反应的全面板网络相当（误差在3.4%以内）。迁移具有化合物特异性，使误差降低21.2%，而错误化合物至多降低1.8%，并在预留的 MCF7 数据中重复。使用20个参考时，在单个 CPU 线程上拟合耗时数秒，比神经调参和拟合至少快420倍。将其预测加入一个已测量孔使该孔的误差降低27-31%。生物响应记忆为虚拟细胞建立了一种设计原则，任何实验室都能更新、检查和运行。

title: Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions
zh_title: 容量感知学习以减少医院再入院
summary: arXiv预印本将周期性重训的再入院风险预测器纳入出院排队MDP，论证容量感知策略可缓解删失偏倚。
key_points: 揭示有偏再入院预测器与出院决策的恶性循环
将队列MDP扩展为含定期重训预测器
证明出院上限策略下重复重训可收敛
reason: 方法有新意且涉及公平性，但为理论性预印本，缺少真实数据外部验证
abstract: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.
zh_abstract: 预测算法正越来越多地用于指导医院出院决策，但这些模型可能因历史数据不足或既往出院决策而对脆弱患者表现出删失偏倚。当带有偏倚的再入院风险预测器被用于为出院决策提供信息时，由出院决策生成的训练数据在预测器重新训练时可能延续类似偏倚，从而导致恶性循环。我们将基于排队论的医院出院马尔可夫决策过程进行扩展，以纳入定期重新训练的再入院风险预测器。我们的关键洞见是，成本最优且“容量感知”的运营决策策略能够自然使观察到患者结局的住院时长多样化，从而无需显式公平性约束即可实现再入院风险的一致估计。我们证明，在模型正确设定（well-specification）下，按容量上限出院（discharge-up-to）策略下的反复重新训练会收敛到无偏风险估计。在合成实验和基于合作医院患者层面数据校准的模拟中，我们发现，常用的基于风险阈值（threshold-on-risk）策略可能持续存在偏倚，而按容量上限出院策略相较现状决策策略（如基于风险设定阈值）将学习误差降低24%-25%。这些估计改进还缓解了某些形式的偏倚，使再入院成本差异（已按人口统计学组间基线风险差异进行调整）降低38%-63%。我们的结果证明，容量感知决策策略如何通过处理删失偏倚来同时改善预测性能和公平性。

title: Task-adaptive anonymisation enables privacy-preserving sharing of clinical speech data
zh_title: 任务自适应匿名化实现临床语音数据隐私共享
summary: 预印本提出CASA智能体，按临床任务动态调整声纹与内容匿名化，以兼顾隐私与临床可用性。
key_points: 将匿名化转为任务引导的优化过程
针对声纹与语音内容两类隐私风险
采用递归自我改进策略
reason: 预印本新方法有想法，但证据与外部评测有限
abstract: Clinical speech is increasingly used for disease screening and clinical assessment, but directly distributing speech recordings poses privacy risks because they contain both speaker-identifying voiceprints and sensitive spoken content. Existing speech anonymisation approaches are primarily developed for general speech applications or task-specific clinical speech and overlook that different clinical tasks rely on distinct speech characteristics, necessitating task-adaptive anonymisation strategies to protect patient privacy while preserving clinical utility. Here we introduce CASA, a clinically adaptive speech anonymisation agent that transforms anonymisation from a fixed processing procedure into a task-guided optimisation process, dynamically tailoring voiceprint and content anonymisation to task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements. Through recursive self-improvement (RSI), CASA iteratively evaluates and refines anonymisation strategies against task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements, while learning from these outcomes to guide more efficient planning in subsequent clinical tasks. CASA is validated across 14 clinical tasks encompassing five languages, diverse elicitation paradigms, and mental health, cognitive and voice disorders. CASA preserved disease-related classification performance while meeting speaker-anonymisation requirements across all clinical tasks, versus only 8/14 for the strongest fixed method. Assessments of resistance to speaker re-identification by external attackers and identification and redaction of sensitive personal information in clinical speech further demonstrated CASA's dual protection of speaker identity and sensitive spoken content. Clinical expert assessments further supported the preservation of clinically relevant information and the acceptability of anonymised speech for controlled research sharing.
zh_abstract: 临床语音正越来越多地用于疾病筛查和临床评估，但直接分发语音录音会带来隐私风险，因为其中既包含可识别说话人的声纹，也包含敏感的语音内容。现有语音匿名化方法主要针对通用语音应用或特定任务的临床语音开发，忽视了不同临床任务依赖不同的语音特征，因此需要任务自适应的匿名化策略，在保护患者隐私的同时保留临床效用。在此我们提出 CASA，一种临床自适应语音匿名化智能体，它将匿名化从固定的处理流程转变为任务引导的优化过程，动态调整声纹和内容匿名化，以满足任务特定的隐私和临床效用要求。通过递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement, RSI），CASA 针对任务特定的隐私和临床效用要求迭代评估并优化匿名化策略，同时从这些结果中学习，以指导后续临床任务中更高效的规划。CASA 在 14 项临床任务中进行了验证，涵盖五种语言、多种诱发范式，以及心理健康、认知和语音障碍。CASA 在所有临床任务中均保留了疾病相关分类性能，同时满足说话人匿名化要求，而最强的固定方法仅在 8/14 项任务中做到。对外部攻击者进行说话人重识别的抵抗能力评估，以及对临床语音中敏感个人信息的识别与删改评估，进一步证明了 CASA 对说话人身份和敏感语音内容的双重保护。临床专家评估进一步支持其保留了临床相关信息，并且匿名化语音可用于受控研究共享的可接受性。

title: Target Recoverability under Selective Labels: A Failure Mode in ECG-Based Acute Coronary Syndrome Prediction
zh_title: 选择性标签下的目标可检出性：ECG预测ACS的失效模式
summary: 预印本形式化分析「仅在受检者中可学、未受检者中反转」的选择性标签偏差，并以ECG预测急性冠脉综合征为例实证。
key_points: 提出诊断包含模型输入无法检出病例时的偏差机制
模拟显示检测越选择性强、不可检出病例越多则越严重
ECG基础模型在ACS预测上做了实证分析
reason: 方法学问题有新意且用真实ECG任务验证，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Medical machine learning models often learn from diagnoses observed only in patients clinicians chose to test. The biases of such selective labels are well known, but less understood is what happens when a diagnosis includes cases the model's inputs cannot detect. Because testing decisions draw on information the model does not see, these cases can appear predictable among tested patients, producing relationships that fail, and can even reverse, among the untested. We formalize this mechanism and show in simulations that it worsens as testing becomes more selective or undetectable cases more common, while models trained only on detectable cases remain informative. We empirically study electrocardiogram (ECG)-based prediction of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), which is confirmed only by invasive testing and whose subtypes differ in how clearly they appear on the ECG. Three ECG foundation models fine-tuned on revascularization, our ACS proxy, performed well among catheterized patients (AUROC 0.740-0.770) but worse than chance for 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events among untested patients (AUROC 0.381-0.478). Models trained on ECG-visible subtypes retained discrimination (AUROC 0.680-0.709), whereas a model trained on unstable angina, which can occur without ECG changes, was inversely related to risk (AUROC 0.310). Under selective labels, effective learning therefore requires prediction targets that can be inferred from the model's inputs and evaluation in the intended deployment population, which often extends beyond the patients who were tested.
zh_abstract: 医学机器学习模型常常从临床医生选择检测的患者中所观察到的诊断进行学习。这种选择性标签的偏倚众所周知，但较少被理解的是：当诊断包含模型输入无法检测的病例时会发生什么。由于检测决策依据模型未看到的信息，这些病例在接受检测的患者中可能显得可预测，从而产生在接受检测者中成立、但在未接受检测者中失效甚至反向的关系。我们形式化了这一机制，并在模拟中显示：当检测变得更具选择性或不可检测病例更常见时，该问题会加重，而仅在可检测病例上训练的模型仍具有信息价值。我们实证研究了基于心电图（ECG）的急性冠脉综合征（ACS）预测；ACS仅通过侵入性检测确诊，且其亚型在ECG上显现的清晰程度不同。三个在血运重建（我们的ACS替代指标）上微调的ECG基础模型，在接受导管检查的患者中表现良好（AUROC 0.740-0.770），但在未接受检测患者的30天主要不良心血管事件方面低于随机水平（AUROC 0.381-0.478）。在ECG可见亚型上训练的模型保留了区分能力（AUROC 0.680-0.709），而在不稳定型心绞痛（可不伴ECG改变发生）上训练的模型与风险呈反向关系（AUROC 0.310）。因此，在选择性标签下，有效学习要求预测目标能够从模型输入中推断，并在预期部署人群中评估，而该人群往往超出接受检测的患者。

title: DuSS-PET: Self-Supervised Low-Dose PET Reconstruction Using Pseudo-Dual-Domain Consistency Without Paired Data
zh_title: DuSS-PET：无需配对数据的自监督低剂量PET重建
summary: 提出基于Noisier2Noise的自监督低剂量PET重建框架，无需配对低剂量与全剂量扫描。
key_points: 用伯努利损坏策略模拟低计数噪声模式
自适应Swin Transformer用于伪正弦图复原
规避配对数据采集的临床不可行性
reason: 思路有一定新意的重建方法预印本，尚未见到外部或多中心验证
abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is pivotal in medicine and healthcare, but requires high radiation doses for quality imaging. Although deep learning has shown promise for low-dose PET reconstruction/enhancement, existing methods primarily rely on fully supervised learning, which requires paired low- and full-dose scans that are clinically impractical to obtain. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose DuSS-PET, a novel self-supervised PET reconstruction framework that operates without any paired low- and full-dose data. Our method is built upon a computational Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) paradigm, featuring a Bernoulli corruption strategy that serves as an image-space approximation to emulate low-count noise patterns in image-derived pseudo-sinogram representations. The DuSS-PET framework integrates three core components: an adaptive Swin transformer for pseudo-sinogram restoration, a plug-and-play module for image enhancement, and a consistency-constrained SSL strategy that enforces agreement between the pseudo-sinogram and image representations. Extensive experiments on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DuSS-PET achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming state-of-the-art SSL methods and achieving comparable or even better results than fully supervised approaches across various dose levels. In particular, it exhibits exceptional generalization across different scanner vendors. This work is among the first self-supervised low-dose PET reconstruction framework that enforces consistency between reconstructed images and pseudo-sinograms, where the pseudo-sinogram generated in the image space serves as a solid computational consistency constraint for enhanced imaging without full-dose training scans. The source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DuSS-PET.
zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）在医学和医疗保健中至关重要，但实现高质量成像需要高辐射剂量。尽管深度学习在低剂量PET重建/增强方面显示出前景，但现有方法主要依赖全监督学习，这需要成对的低剂量和全剂量扫描，而临床中获取这些数据并不现实。为克服这一根本限制，我们提出DuSS-PET，这是一种新颖的自监督PET重建框架，无需任何成对的低剂量和全剂量数据。我们的方法建立在计算型Noisier2Noise（Nr2N）范式之上，采用伯努利损坏策略作为一种图像空间近似，以模拟图像衍生的伪正弦图表示中的低计数噪声模式。DuSS-PET框架整合三个核心组件：用于伪正弦图恢复的自适应Swin transformer、用于图像增强的即插即用模块，以及强制伪正弦图与图像表示之间一致性的受一致性约束的自监督学习（SSL）策略。在多中心数据集上的大量实验表明，DuSS-PET取得了优越的重建性能，优于最先进的SSL方法，并在各种剂量水平下取得与全监督方法相当甚至更好的结果。特别是，它在不同扫描仪厂商之间表现出卓越的泛化能力。这项工作属于首批强制重建图像与伪正弦图之间一致性的自监督低剂量PET重建框架之一，其中在图像空间生成的伪正弦图作为可靠的计算一致性约束，用于在无全剂量训练扫描的情况下增强成像。源代码将在https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DuSS-PET公开。

title: Open Problems in Chatbots and Mental Health
zh_title: 聊天机器人与心理健康中的开放问题
summary: arXiv评述梳理通用聊天机器人用于心理支持时的评估效度、谄媚、妄想强化与危机响应等开放问题。
key_points: 静态基准无法确立聊天机器人安全性
需验证多轮交互评估与仿真方法
指出谄媚、强化妄想与危机响应不足等风险
reason: 议题重要的开放问题评述，属观点类预印本，无新数据，按规则不超过6分
abstract: General-purpose chatbots are increasingly used for emotional and mental health support. They can be useful, but issues such as sycophancy, reinforcement of delusional beliefs, and poor crisis response create risks that are difficult for researchers to study and evaluate. In this paper, we review the most critical open problems for researchers and policymakers in the use of general-purpose chatbots and their effects on mental health. First, there are tractable problems in the controlled evaluation of chatbots: establishing the construct and ecological validity of evaluations, evaluating multi-turn interactions, and connecting evaluations to improvements in chatbot behavior. For example, conventional benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets cannot establish chatbot safety, and novel simulation methods need validation. Second, researchers must connect their studies of chatbots and mental health to real-world evidence. This includes analyzing the chatbot products that AI companies and mental health practitioners have deployed, including their user interfaces and human review and escalation practices for user welfare concerns. However, clinical analysis opportunities afforded by real chat log data sharing are complicated by significant privacy concerns. Finally, we argue that researchers should take an active role in the construction and refinement of evidence-based policy through corporate and governmental decisions such as user protections, standards of care, protected access to user chat logs, data sharing between institutions, incident reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. Such behavioral evaluations, studies of real-world outcomes, and data governance depend on each other and must be addressed in tandem. We believe a coordinated research effort would have substantial real-world impact.
zh_abstract: 通用聊天机器人正越来越多地被用于情感和心理健康支持。它们可能有用，但谄媚（sycophancy）、强化妄想信念以及危机响应不佳等问题会带来研究者难以研究和评估的风险。在本文中，我们综述了研究者和政策制定者在通用聊天机器人使用及其对心理健康影响方面最关键的一些开放问题。首先，在聊天机器人的受控评估中存在可处理的问题：确立评估的构念效度和生态效度、评估多轮交互，以及将评估与聊天机器人行为的改进联系起来。例如，主要依赖静态数据集的传统基准无法确立聊天机器人的安全性，而新的模拟方法需要验证。其次，研究者必须将其关于聊天机器人与心理健康的研究与现实世界证据联系起来。这包括分析AI公司和心理健康从业者已部署的聊天机器人产品，包括其用户界面，以及针对用户福祉关切的人工审核和升级处置实践。然而，真实聊天日志数据共享所提供的临床分析机会因重大隐私关切而变得复杂。最后，我们认为研究者应发挥积极作用，通过企业与政府决策来构建和完善循证政策，例如用户保护、照护标准、对用户聊天日志的受保护访问、机构间数据共享、事件报告和部署后监测。此类行为评估、真实世界结局研究和数据治理相互依赖，必须协同推进。我们相信，协调一致的研究努力将产生重大的现实世界影响。

title: Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality
zh_title: 缺失SLO模态下的条件扩散代理表征恢复预测BCVA
summary: 用条件扩散模型在潜特征空间恢复缺失SLO代理表征，融合OCT与临床文本预测术后最佳矫正视力。
key_points: 面向白内障术后BCVA术前预测
不重建原图，改为潜空间代理表征恢复
融合OCT图像与临床文本多模态特征

abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.
zh_abstract: 术前预测术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）可支持白内障手术的预后评估和个体化决策。多模态学习可整合术前光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像、扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）图像和临床文本，以刻画患者状态。然而，由于采集或数据管理问题，真实世界临床数据中SLO图像常缺失，导致多模态输入不完整。为解决该问题，本文提出一种基于条件扩散的方法，用于SLO代理表示恢复与融合预测。该方法不重建原始SLO图像，而是将SLO缺失建模为潜在特征空间中的代理表示恢复。具体而言，首先融合OCT图像特征与临床文本特征，构建OCT-文本条件表示，该表示引导扩散模型的反向去噪过程，以估计样本特异性的SLO代理表示。随后，将恢复的SLO代理表示作为不可用SLO模态的替代，纳入下游多模态融合预测网络，用于术后BCVA预测。在2,141例术前多模态白内障样本上进行实验，SLO缺失率为58.80%。在绝对预测误差不超过0.1 LogMAR的标准下，所提方法达到0.9714的准确率，平均绝对误差为0.0423，优于代表性的术后视力预测方法和缺失模态学习方法。这些结果表明，表示层面的代理恢复可缓解SLO模态缺失对术后BCVA预测的影响。

title: Causal Outcome Learning with Noisy Proxies
zh_title: 含噪代理下的因果结局学习
summary: 提出SCOUT框架，在高维含噪基线变量中学习治疗反应性结局并估计ATE与CATE。
key_points: 构建低维调整表征控制混杂
调整空间至多二维以便异质性分析
面向观察性生物医学数据
reason: 因果效应估计方法预印本，方法有一定新意但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Modern observational biomedical datasets contain increasingly extensive baseline and outcome measurements, yet detecting a clinically meaningful treatment effect remains difficult because investigators must identify an outcome that captures treatment response while adjusting for confounding distributed across numerous noisy baseline variables. We introduce SCOUT (Score-based Causal Outcome Learning Using Treatment signals), a framework that learns a clinically interpretable, treatment-responsive outcome while adjusting for confounding throughout the learning process. SCOUT constructs low-dimensional adjustment representations of high-dimensional baseline measurements to estimate the average treatment effect (ATE) and conditional average treatment effect (CATE) for the learned outcome. Importantly, the final adjustment space is at most two-dimensional, allowing treatment-effect heterogeneity to be estimated in this space rather than in the full high-dimensional covariate space. SCOUT also introduces a fourth-order statistic for testing treatment-effect heterogeneity that emphasizes unusually large deviations from the ATE. In synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments, the algorithm achieved competitive ATE estimation accuracy and substantially lower CATE estimation error. In an observational study of patients with bipolar disorder, SCOUT identified a clinically recognizable lithium-associated adverse-effect profile, detecting both a significant ATE (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.0026) and significant treatment-effect heterogeneity (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.033).These results demonstrate how jointly learning outcomes and controlling for confounding can facilitate the discovery of treatment effects in high-dimensional observational data.
zh_abstract: 现代观察性生物医学数据集包含越来越广泛的基线与结局测量，然而检测具有临床意义的治疗效应仍然困难，因为研究者必须识别一个能捕捉治疗反应的结局，同时校正分布于众多含噪基线变量中的混杂。我们提出SCOUT（Score-based Causal Outcome Learning Using Treatment signals，基于治疗信号的评分因果结局学习），该框架在学习过程中学习一个临床可解释、对治疗有反应的结局，同时全程校正混杂。SCOUT构建高维基线测量的低维校正表示，以估计所学结局的平均治疗效应（ATE）和条件平均治疗效应（CATE）。重要的是，最终校正空间至多为二维，从而可在该空间中而非完整高维协变量空间中估计治疗效应异质性。SCOUT还引入一种四阶统计量，用于检验治疗效应异质性，该统计量强调相对于ATE的异常大偏差。在合成与半合成实验中，该算法取得了有竞争力的ATE估计精度，并显著降低了CATE估计误差。在一项双相情感障碍患者的观察性研究中，SCOUT识别出临床上可识别的锂相关副作用特征，同时检测到显著的ATE（Holm校正p = 0.0026）和显著的治疗效应异质性（Holm校正p = 0.033）。这些结果表明，联合学习结局并控制混杂如何促进在高维观察性数据中发现治疗效应。

title: Deep learning-based myocardial segmentation using non-contrast-enhanced CT for quantitative SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging.
zh_title: 平扫CT深度学习心肌分割用于SPECT定量

abstract: [EJNMMI physics] Accurate myocardial segmentation is essential for polar map-based quantitative analysis in SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI). Commercial software requires significant manual adjustment to ensure accurate segmentation, particularly for studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake. To address this limitation, we propose deep learning (DL)-based myocardial segmentation using non-contrast-enhanced CT images. Myocardial masks were generated by simply thresholding PET images with uniform myocardial uptake in 125 18F-FDG PET/CT studies. An optimal network was configured through the nn-UNet pipeline with CT images as input and the masks as labels. For evaluation, the network was tested on 50 99mTc-sestamibi SPECT/CT MPI studies with uniform myocardial uptake. Additional 50 SPECT MPI studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake were selected to demonstrate the impact of using DL-masks on polar map-based quantification. Three nuclear cardiologists visually compared myocardium contours with and without DL-masks in commercial software. DL-masks achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.866 ± 0.035 in the PET/CT validation set and 0.846 ± 0.026 in the SPECT/CT test set. For additional studies, segmental differences in the polar map with and without DL-masks indicated meaningful quantitative differences (~ 10%) in basal segments near the septum, compared to mid-cavity or apical segments. Likert scoring demonstrated that DL-masks improved septal and valve plane placement in commercial software, resulting in accurate myocardial segmentation without manual adjustment. We demonstrated a DL segmentation model for accurate myocardial segmentation without manual adjustment and corresponding polar map-based quantification, particularly in studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake.
zh_abstract: [EJNMMI physics] 准确的心肌分割对于 SPECT 心肌灌注成像（MPI）中基于极坐标图的定量分析至关重要。商业软件需要大量手动调整才能确保准确分割，尤其是对于存在严重心肌缺损或高心外摄取的研究。为解决这一局限，我们提出使用非增强 CT 图像的基于深度学习（DL）的心肌分割。心肌掩膜通过在 125 项具有均匀心肌摄取的 18F-FDG PET/CT 研究中简单阈值化 PET 图像生成。通过 nn-UNet 流程配置了一个最优网络，以 CT 图像为输入、掩膜为标签。为进行评估，该网络在 50 项具有均匀心肌摄取的 99mTc-sestamibi SPECT/CT MPI 研究上测试。另选取 50 项存在严重心肌缺损或高心外摄取的 SPECT MPI 研究，以展示使用 DL 掩膜对基于极坐标图定量的影响。三位核心脏病学家在商业软件中肉眼比较了有和无 DL 掩膜时的心肌轮廓。DL 掩膜在 PET/CT 验证集中达到 Dice 相似系数 0.866 ± 0.035，在 SPECT/CT 测试集中达到 0.846 ± 0.026。对于额外研究，有和无 DL 掩膜时极坐标图的节段差异表明，与中腔或心尖段相比，靠近室间隔的基底段存在有意义的定量差异（约 10%）。Likert 评分显示，DL 掩膜改善了商业软件中室间隔和瓣膜平面的放置，从而无需手动调整即可实现准确的心肌分割。我们展示了一个 DL 分割模型，可在无需手动调整的情况下实现准确的心肌分割及相应的基于极坐标图定量，尤其是在存在严重心肌缺损或高心外摄取的研究中。

title: Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports
zh_title: 用 LLM 不确定性区分放射报告抽取失败与临床不一致
summary: 预印本在 1045 例 CCTA 患者中评估 LLM 抽取狭窄程度时的不确定性，用以区分抽取失败与 CCTA-ICA 不一致。
key_points: 参考标准为 253 例专家标注与 729 例后续 ICA

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can structure clinical datasets, but extraction error must be distinguished from discordance in the underlying data. From a real-world cohort of 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA), we evaluated whether LLM uncertainty during vessel-level coronary artery disease (CAD) stenosis extraction could identify extraction failure and clinical discordance. References were expert CCTA annotations (253 patients) and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA; 729 patients). We quantify extraction failure as disagreement between stenosis severity in LLM extracted versus expert annotations, and clinical discordance as disagreement in stenosis severity between CCTA and subsequent ICA. Stenosis Margin, selected from ten candidate measures, was used to quantify LLM uncertainty, and generalized estimating equation logistic regression and AUC evaluated its association and incremental discrimination for each failure mode. LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$). In contrast, LLM uncertainty weakly associated with clinical discordance (adjusted OR 1.22 [1.04--1.43], Holm-adjusted $P=0.118$) but provided no incremental discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity ($Δ$AUC $+0.01$ [$-0.00$, $+0.02$], $P=0.245$). Moreover, extraction errors and clinical discordance showed little overlap, with 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90%) having been extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty may identify extraction failures without identifying underlying clinical discordance, supporting failure attribution when evaluating LLM-derived clinical datasets.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以结构化临床数据集，但提取错误必须与基础数据中的不一致区分开来。从一个由1,045名接受冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）的患者组成的真实世界队列中，我们评估了LLM在血管水平冠状动脉疾病（CAD）狭窄提取过程中的不确定性是否能够识别提取失败和临床不一致。参考标准为专家CCTA标注（253名患者）和随后的有创冠状动脉造影（ICA；729名患者）。我们将提取失败量化为LLM提取的狭窄严重程度与专家标注之间的不一致，并将临床不一致量化为CCTA与随后ICA之间狭窄严重程度的不一致。从十个候选指标中选择的Stenosis Margin用于量化LLM不确定性，并使用广义估计方程逻辑回归和AUC评估其与每种失败模式的关联及增量区分能力。LLM不确定性（与提取失败）强相关（校正OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57–6.69]，P<0.001），并在LLM提取的CCTA狭窄严重程度之外显著改善了区分能力（AUC 0.81至0.86；ΔAUC +0.06 [+0.03, +0.09]，P=0.001）。相比之下，LLM不确定性（与临床不一致）弱相关（校正OR 1.22 [1.04–1.43]，Holm校正P=0.118），但在LLM提取的CCTA狭窄严重程度之外未提供增量区分能力（ΔAUC +0.01 [−0.00, +0.02]，P=0.245）。此外，提取错误和临床不一致几乎没有重叠，42条临床不一致血管中有38条（90%）被正确提取。LLM不确定性可能识别提取失败，但不能识别潜在的临床不一致，这支持在评估LLM衍生的临床数据集时进行失败归因。

title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
zh_title: EvoDiff：生成式主动学习实现标签高效的全器官超声诊断
summary: 提出EvoDiff生成式主动学习框架，结合扩散模型与信息论目标，在异构超声数据中选取高信息量样本以降低标注需求。
key_points: 扩散模型生成特征空间合成探针
结合信息增益、进化搜索与课程采样
面向多器官超声与跨中心数据稀缺
reason: 预印本方法创新，针对超声标注瓶颈，证据有限
abstract: Medical ultrasound (US) enables real-time, non-invasive diagnosis, yet building US-based AI systems is limited by data scarcity, costly expert annotation, and limited cross-center generalizability. Privacy constraints and instance-level reporting hinder the collection of diverse abnormal cases and frame-level labels, while repeated retraining for new centers increases computational cost. We introduce EvoDiff, a generative active learning framework that integrates diffusion modelling with information-theoretic objectives, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling to select informative samples across heterogeneous US datasets. EvoDiff formulates sample selection as a generate-to-retrieve process, in which diffusion-based optimization in feature space guided by information gain produces synthetic probes, and only the real unlabeled samples retrieved by these probes are annotated and used for downstream training. Across six benchmarks covering fifteen datasets and 16,696 images, we evaluate EvoDiff on convolutional network and transformer-based foundation model. EvoDiff approaches fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels, outperforms active learning baselines, and improves foundation model generalization under cross-domain external validation on unseen cohorts. A reader study with six radiologists indicates the potential to support clinical annotation workflows, with a model-based estimated 24% to 84% reduction in annotation workload at matched downstream performance.
zh_abstract: 医学超声（US）能够实现实时、无创诊断，但构建基于 US 的人工智能系统受限于数据稀缺、专家标注成本高昂以及跨中心泛化能力有限。隐私约束和实例级报告阻碍了多样化异常病例和帧级标签的收集，而为新中心反复重新训练会增加计算成本。我们提出 EvoDiff，一种生成式主动学习框架，它将扩散建模与信息论目标、进化搜索和课程式采样相结合，以在异构 US 数据集之间选择信息量大的样本。EvoDiff 将样本选择表述为一个“生成以检索”（generate-to-retrieve）过程：在特征空间中，由信息增益引导的基于扩散的优化生成合成探针，并且仅由这些探针检索到的真实未标注样本会被标注并用于下游训练。在涵盖 15 个数据集和 16,696 张图像的六个基准上，我们在卷积网络和基于 transformer 的基础模型上评估 EvoDiff。EvoDiff 以显著更少的标签接近全监督性能，优于主动学习基线，并在未见队列的跨域外部验证中改善基础模型的泛化能力。一项由 6 名放射科医师参与的阅片者研究表明，其有潜力支持临床标注工作流程，在匹配下游性能时，基于模型的估计可将标注工作量减少 24% 至 84%。

title: Pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke
zh_title: 脉搏波形形态编码卒中前血流动力学特征
summary: 基于ICU（MIMIC-III，176例）与急诊（MC-MED，154例）队列，用可解释脉搏波形态描述符在卒中识别前360分钟区分即将发生的卒中。
key_points: 使用ICU与急诊两个院内队列
按搏动提取时序、幅值、轮廓等特征
识别前360分钟可区分将发生卒中
reason: 预印本、回顾性双队列但样本仅数百例，无临床结局改善，属值得一看档。
abstract: Stroke is a disorder of the circulation, yet the haemodynamic state that immediately precedes it has rarely been observed, because continuous physiological recordings before a stroke are seldom available. Photoplethysmography (PPG), recorded by every pulse oximeter and by hundreds of millions of wearable devices, captures the peripheral pulse beat by beat, but its morphology is largely discarded. Here we ask whether pulse waveform morphology encodes haemodynamic signatures of impending stroke. Using in-hospital stroke as a natural experiment that provides continuous PPG before physician-adjudicated stroke recognition, we studied intensive-care (MIMIC-III, $n=176$) and emergency-department (MC-MED, $n=154$) cohorts and described each beat with interpretable descriptors of pulse timing, amplitude, contour and variability. At a nominal 360-min horizon, morphology separated pre-recognition from stable windows with $F_1$ scores of 0.941 and 0.989 (sensitivity 0.998 and 0.980), with models transferred unchanged to the second cohort, and outperformed heart rate alone on identical windows. The signature was dominated by systolic crest time and its change from each patient's own baseline, feature attribution was concordant across cohorts (Spearman $ρ=0.865$), and morphology recorded in the first two hours of care stratified the subsequent clinical course ($F_1$ 0.714 and 0.691). In high-risk patients without stroke, 29% and 14% of windows were positive, but five-window persistence rules limited alerts to 17% and 2% of patients. The results demonstrate that the routinely recorded pulse thus carries haemodynamic imprint of the period preceding stroke, positioning pulse morphology as a candidate continuous cerebrovascular biomarker.
zh_abstract: 卒中是一种循环障碍，然而其即将发生前的血流动力学状态很少被观察到，因为卒中前的连续生理记录很少可获得。光电容积脉搏波描记法（photoplethysmography，PPG）由每个脉搏血氧仪和数亿计可穿戴设备记录，逐搏捕捉外周脉搏，但其形态在很大程度上被丢弃。在此，我们探究脉搏波形形态是否编码了即将发生卒中的血流动力学特征。利用院内卒中作为自然实验，该实验提供了医生裁定卒中识别之前的连续 PPG，我们研究了重症监护（MIMIC-III，n=176）和急诊科（MC-MED，n=154）队列，并用脉搏时序、幅度、轮廓和变异性的可解释描述符描述每个心搏。在名义 360 分钟时间窗上，形态将识别前窗口与稳定窗口区分开来，F1 分数分别为 0.941 和 0.989（敏感度分别为 0.998 和 0.980），模型未经改动迁移到第二个队列，并在相同窗口上优于仅使用心率。该特征以收缩期波峰时间及其相对于每名患者自身基线的变化为主，特征归因在队列间一致（Spearman ρ=0.865），并且护理最初两小时内记录的形态对后续临床病程进行了分层（F1 0.714 和 0.691）。在无卒中的高风险患者中，分别有 29% 和 14% 的窗口为阳性，但五窗口持续性规则将警报限制在 17% 和 2% 的患者。结果表明，常规记录的脉搏因而携带卒中前时期的血流动力学印记，将脉搏形态定位为一种候选的连续脑血管生物标志物。

title: BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models
zh_title: 医学基础模型提示后门的跨模型迁移与防御
summary: 预印本首次研究提示学习植入的后门在医学基础模型间的迁移性，并提出提示级修复防御。

reason: 安全方向有新意，但为预印本且评测范围有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus
zh_abstract: 医学基础模型（Med-FMs）正越来越多地通过提示学习适配临床任务，即只调校一小组提示词元（prompt tokens）而主干保持冻结。近期工作表明，这种高效性带来了一种脆弱性：在少样本适配过程中联合优化可学习提示和不可感知的噪声触发器会植入后门，使干净性能保持不变，但会把被触发的输入导向攻击者选定的类别。由于提示紧凑且易于共享，这引出了两个问题：被植入后门的提示是否仍能在不同的 Med-FM 上有效，以及是否能在不重新训练主干的情况下修复它。我们在 BAPLe++ 中同时解决这两个问题。首先，我们首次研究基于提示的后门的跨模型可迁移性，并用提出的两个指标——干净准确率差异（Clean Accuracy Difference, CAD）和后门准确率差异（Backdoor Accuracy Difference, BAD）——进行量化。其次，我们提出 DePLe（Defense via Prompt Learning），它把受感染的提示作为固定锚点，并在小型干净集上学习一个新提示，在保留干净任务的同时偏离受损的嵌入区域。在四个 Med-FM 和六个胸部 X 射线与组织病理学数据集上的实验表明，后门可跨模型迁移，但这种迁移是不对称的且依赖数据集。与四种无需训练的输入变换相比，DePLe 更一致地降低后门准确率，同时保持干净准确率，并在若干设置下提升干净准确率。我们的代码可访问 https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus

title: Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 不确定性而非隐瞒：视觉语言模型迎合行为再审视
summary: 预印本用表征探针、激活引导与强制二选一，在四种视觉语言模型与胸片上分析模型对图文冲突的迎合行为。
key_points: 四种指令微调VLM在胸片场景存在冲突行为抑制
线性探针可区分匹配与不匹配输入
激活引导与强制二选一均无法引出矛盾报告
reason: 机制分析有新意且涉及安全部署，但为预印本、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/.
zh_abstract: 在医学检索增强生成中，视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）必须能够在检索到的报告与X射线相矛盾时指出这一点，因此理解它们能否检测此类冲突对于安全部署很重要。谄媚面具假说（sycophancy mask hypothesis）认为，这些模型内部检测到冲突但拒绝报告，从而隐藏了已检测到的矛盾。我们引入一个由三部分组成的诊断方法，将隐藏与不确定性区分开来：表征探测、激活引导和双向强制选择。在四个针对胸部X射线进行指令微调的VLM上，我们确认了矛盾的行为抑制，并发现线性探针能够区分匹配与不匹配输入，其表现超过简单CLIP模型所能达到的水平。引导学习到的冲突方向从未引出矛盾表述，强制二选一也无法恢复矛盾；相反，不匹配对上的跨模态图像注意力下降。我们得出结论：这些模型未能提出矛盾，是因为不匹配被登记为带对冲的、受门控的不确定性，而非被隐藏的知识，这要求重新接地（re-grounding）并使不确定性显性化。代码见 https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/。

title: A Clinical Evaluation of Conformal Prediction for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
zh_title: 胸片报告生成保形预测的临床评估
summary: 预印本提出CLARITY临床可接受性标准，以放射科医生标注为参考，评估保形预测与自动指标对临床相关错误的识别。
key_points: MLLM报告生成存在幻觉，需风险控制方法
常用可接受性代理指标系统性漏检临床错误
以放射科医生标注作为评估参考
reason: 有专家标注的评估研究、问题有价值，但属预印本、未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved automated radiology report generation, they remain prone to hallucinations, necessitating clinically meaningful risk-control methods. Conformal prediction (CP) provides statistical guarantees, yet existing CP approaches rely on uncalibrated automated extractors and fail to account for the clinical relevance of errors. We introduce clinical admissibility criteria (CLARITY), a framework for evaluating radiology reports that explicitly distinguishes clinically consequential errors from minor deviations. To eliminate reliance on automatic judges, we collected radiologist annotations of MLLM-generated reports using CLARITY. By benchmarking CP strategies and automatic evaluation metrics against these expert annotations, we demonstrate that commonly used admissibility proxies systematically fail to detect clinically relevant errors. Our findings reveal that automated admissibility judgments are largely decoupled from true clinical admissibility.
zh_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（multimodal large language models, MLLMs）改进了自动化放射学报告生成，但它们仍然容易出现幻觉，因此需要具有临床意义的风险控制方法。共形预测（conformal prediction, CP）提供统计保证，但现有CP方法依赖未校准的自动提取器，并且未能考虑错误的临床相关性。我们引入临床可接受性标准（clinical admissibility criteria, CLARITY），这是一个用于评估放射学报告的框架，明确区分具有临床后果的错误与轻微偏差。为消除对自动评判器的依赖，我们使用CLARITY收集了放射科医生对MLLM生成报告的标注。通过以这些专家标注为基准，对CP策略和自动评估指标进行基准测试，我们证明常用的可接受性代理指标系统性地无法检测临床相关错误。我们的发现表明，自动可接受性判断在很大程度上与真实的临床可接受性脱钩。

title: Contrastive fine-tuning against stain and scanner bias improves robustness and downstream performance across pathology foundation models
zh_title: 对比微调提升病理基础模型染色与扫描仪鲁棒性
summary: 提出SPECTRA框架，用LoRA对比后训练对齐多扫描仪、多染色切片，提升病理基础模型鲁棒性。
key_points: 模型无关的对比后训练框架，显式对齐扫描仪与染色差异
基于PLISM多扫描仪多染色全切片，用同条件其他区域作负样本
在PathoROB等鲁棒性指标上取得提升
reason: 方法有新意且跨多种病理基础模型验证，但为预印本、无外部临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. We introduce SPECTRA (Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment), a model-agnostic contrastive learning post-training framework which explicitly encourages scanner- and stain-robust representations, to optimize performance and generalization on downstream applications. Using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters trained on matched multi-scanner and multi-stain whole-slide images sourced from the PLISM dataset, our method aligns spatially corresponding regions across acquisition conditions (scanner, stain), using other locations within each candidate condition as negatives. SPECTRA improved PathoROB robustness index, gene-expression prediction on HEST, slide-level classification AUC on CPTAC, and held-out PLISM retrieval for every model. Overall tile-level classification on THUNDER also improved, with exceptions for segmentation and calibration tasks. We open-source our training and evaluation codebases and release adapters and model weights for selected backbones.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学基础模型在多种下游任务中表现强劲，但已有研究表明其表征会编码扫描仪和站点特异性偏差，造成泛化差距，并可能限制实际应用价值。我们提出 SPECTRA（Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment，扫描仪与病理嵌入对比调优以实现稳健对齐），这是一个与模型无关的对比学习后训练框架，明确促使表征对扫描仪和染色稳健，以优化下游应用的性能和泛化能力。使用在来自 PLISM 数据集的配对多扫描仪和多染色全切片图像上训练的、参数高效的 LoRA 适配器，我们的方法在不同采集条件（扫描仪、染色）下对齐空间对应的区域，并将每个候选条件内的其他位置用作负样本。SPECTRA 提升了每个模型的 PathoROB 稳健性指数、HEST 上的基因表达预测、CPTAC 上的切片级分类 AUC，以及留出 PLISM 检索性能。THUNDER 上的整体瓦片级分类也有所提升，但分割和校准任务除外。我们开源训练和评估代码库，并发布选定骨干网络的适配器和模型权重。
