title: Interpretable Context-Aware Multi-Label Retinal Classification with Dual-Hub Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
zh_title: 双枢纽异质图网络的视网膜多标签分类
summary: 提出耦合眼底图像与临床协变量的双枢纽异质图网络，在BRSET（8524人、16266张）上七种病变Macro-AUPRC达76.1%。
key_points: BRSET数据集含16266张眼底照片
图注意力显式量化图像与风险因素贡献
七种病变Macro-AUPRC为76.1%
reason: 预印本，使用较大规模公开数据集但仅单数据集评估，属值得一看档。
abstract: Multi-label retinal screening requires capturing co-occurring pathologies and clinical context, yet standard multimodal fusion remains opaque. We propose a dual-hub heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) that couples spatial fundus features and structured clinical covariates through cross-modal message passing while providing inherent interpretability. Rather than relying on post-hoc saliency approximations, our architecture exposes multi-level decision pathways during forward aggregation: spatially biased self-attention captures lesion-level patch interactions, while modality-specific graph attention coefficients explicitly quantify the contribution of visual regions and clinical risk factors to each disease node. Evaluated on the BRSET dataset (16,266 photographs from 8,524 patients), the proposed model achieves 76.1% Macro-AUPRC across seven conditions, matching or exceeding image-only (75.9%) and ResNet-50+MLP fusion (75.9%) baselines, with largest contextual gains in macular edema (+3.5%) and diabetic retinopathy (+2.1%). Codebase is available at: https://github.com/proshanto-c/ca-mlc-refactor.
zh_abstract: 多标签视网膜筛查需要捕获共现病变和临床背景，但标准多模态融合仍不透明。我们提出一种双枢纽异构图神经网络（GNN），通过跨模态消息传递将空间眼底特征与结构化临床协变量耦合，同时提供内在可解释性。我们的架构不依赖事后显著性近似，而是在前向聚合过程中暴露多层次决策路径：空间偏置自注意力捕获病变级图块交互，而模态特异性图注意力系数明确量化视觉区域和临床风险因素对每个疾病节点的贡献。在BRSET数据集（来自8,524例患者的16,266张照片）上评估，所提出模型在七种病症上达到76.1% Macro-AUPRC，匹配或超过仅图像（75.9%）和ResNet-50+MLP融合（75.9%）基线，最大上下文增益见于黄斑水肿（+3.5%）和糖尿病视网膜病变（+2.1%）。代码库见：https://github.com/proshanto-c/ca-mlc-refactor。

title: MSR-ABC: Complementary Feature Fusion for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
zh_title: MSR-ABC：透明细胞肾癌多特征融合分类
summary: 提出融合MedVAE、MedSigLIP与影像组学的全局-局部框架，在396例KiTS23及外部队列上评估透明细胞肾癌分类。
key_points: 跨表示注意力实现空间匹配的局部特征交互
影像组学辅助监督保留定量肿瘤属性
患者级划分396例KiTS23并设外部队列验证
reason: 有外部队列但样本量有限（396例）、仅报告判别指标，属值得一看档
abstract: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) classification from computed tomography (CT) may benefit from representations that capture different aspects of tumour phenotype. However, simply concatenating reconstruction-derived features, image--text embeddings, and radiomic descriptors may not fully exploit their complementary information. We propose MSR-ABC, a global--local framework integrating MedVAE, MedSigLIP, and radiomics. Spatially matched local image descriptors interact through cross-representation attention, while radiomic auxiliary supervision encourages the pooled local representation to retain quantitative tumour attributes. A gated residual mechanism integrates local information with global summaries. Area-aware pooling and visual and soft-text prompting complete the framework. We evaluate discrimination using a patient-level split of 396 KiTS23 cases and an external cohort of 111 TCGA/TCIA cases, reporting mean AUROC over three training seeds with 95% patient-bootstrap confidence intervals. MSR-ABC achieves mean AUROCs of 0.806 internally and 0.879 externally. Internally, it exceeds global MedVAE--radiomics and three-source concatenation by 3.35 and 3.61 AUROC percentage points, respectively. Removing any source lowers mean AUROC in both cohorts, with the largest decreases following radiomics removal. Individual removal of cross-representation attention, auxiliary supervision, or gated fusion also lowers internal mean AUROC. These findings are consistent with complementary contributions within the integrated architecture and support further investigation of structured representation fusion for non-invasive renal tumour characterisation.
zh_abstract: 基于计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）的透明细胞肾细胞癌（clear cell renal cell carcinoma, ccRCC）分类可能受益于能捕捉肿瘤表型不同方面的表征。然而，简单拼接重建衍生特征、图像--文本嵌入和影像组学描述符可能无法充分利用它们的互补信息。我们提出 MSR-ABC，一个整合 MedVAE、MedSigLIP 和影像组学的全局-局部框架。空间匹配的局部图像描述符通过跨表征注意力进行交互，而影像组学辅助监督促使池化后的局部表征保留定量肿瘤属性。门控残差机制将局部信息与全局摘要整合。区域感知池化以及视觉与软文本提示完善了该框架。我们使用 396 例 KiTS23 病例的患者级划分和一个由 111 例 TCGA/TCIA 病例组成的外部队列评估判别能力，报告基于三个训练种子的平均 AUROC 及 95% 患者自助法置信区间。MSR-ABC 在内部达到平均 AUROC 0.806，在外部达到 0.879。在内部，它分别比全局 MedVAE--影像组学和三源拼接高出 3.35 和 3.61 个 AUROC 百分点。移除任一来源都会降低两个队列中的平均 AUROC，其中移除影像组学后的下降最大。分别移除跨表征注意力、辅助监督或门控融合也会降低内部平均 AUROC。这些发现与集成架构内的互补贡献相一致，并支持进一步研究用于无创肾肿瘤表征的结构化表征融合。

title: The Role Of Recurrent Refinement In Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: 循环细化模块提升医学图像分割鲁棒性
summary: 在分割骨干网络后接轻量循环细化模块（CRF、现代 Hopfield 网络、卷积 GRU），在测试时迭代提升含噪数据表现。
key_points: 在 Kvasir-SEG 与 ARCADE 两数据集上评估
参数增加不到 1.5%，干净数据最高提升 1.4pp
噪声条件下最高提升 17pp，HD95 下降，代码已公开
reason: 新方法有基线对比且开源，但仅两个公开数据集、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: While feed-forward segmentation networks perform well on large cohorts, they degrade in constrained clinical settings with few training samples and imaging artifacts. Human vision, by contrast, remains robust under these conditions, a property partly attributed to the recurrent and feedback connectivity of the visual cortex, which refines visual information over time. Inspired by this, we append lightweight recurrent refinement blocks to segmentation backbones, namely Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), modern Hopfield networks and convolutional GRUs, and study their behaviour as the number of iterations increases at test time (including beyond the training horizon). Evaluated on two open-source datasets, Kvasir- SEG and ARCADE, our recurrent blocks add less than 1.5% parameters and yield gains on clean data (up to 1.4 pp) and under noise (up to 17 pp) while reducing HD95. Code is available at https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation .
zh_abstract: 尽管前馈分割网络在大型队列上表现良好，但在训练样本少且存在成像伪影的受限临床环境中会退化。相比之下，人类视觉在这些条件下仍保持稳健，这一特性部分归因于视觉皮层的循环和反馈连接，其随时间细化视觉信息。受此启发，我们在分割骨干网络后附加轻量级循环细化模块，即条件随机场（CRFs）、现代 Hopfield 网络和卷积 GRU，并研究其在测试时迭代次数增加（包括超出训练时程）时的行为。在两个开源数据集 Kvasir-SEG 和 ARCADE 上评估，我们的循环模块增加少于 1.5% 的参数，并在干净数据上（最高 1.4 个百分点）和噪声下（最高 17 个百分点）带来增益，同时降低 HD95。代码见 https://github.com/joaodsmarques/recurrencehelpsegmentation 。

title: Causal graph fusion across incomplete cohorts and causal steering of tabular foundation models
zh_title: 跨不完整队列的因果图融合与表格基础模型因果引导
summary: 提出在缺失数据下学习并融合各队列因果图，并把图编译进冻结表格基础模型的注意力，改善分布偏移下的判别。
key_points: 因果图融合在发现过程中处理缺失，用马尔可夫毯引导重填补
因果注意力引导无需重训练即可用于冻结的表格基础模型
各缺失与异质性条件下优于汇总与单队列基线（p<0.001）
reason: 方法有新意并有基线对比与显著性检验，但为预印本、未见外部临床验证
abstract: Clinical data are split across incomplete cohorts with partially overlapping variables. Causal discovery under missing data and multi-source integration have developed separately, and tabular foundation models cannot take a causal graph without retraining. We make two contributions. First, causal graph fusion learns a partial ancestral graph on the shared variables, fuses it into each cohort's graph under temporal background knowledge and lets Markov blankets guide re-imputation, so missing data are handled inside discovery. Second, causal attention steering compiles the learned graph into the attention of a frozen tabular foundation model at inference. Against known ground truth, fusion dominates pooled and per-cohort baselines in every missingness and heterogeneity condition tested (p<0.001), and steering improves discrimination under distribution shift (p<10^{-5}), a gain that a random graph does not produce. In two spinal cord injury cohorts, fusion orients age, albumin and hemoglobin as ancestors of length of stay, a set no single cohort orients in full, and yields compact, temporally ordered predictor sets that match or exceed automatic feature selection on four of five outcomes.
zh_abstract: 临床数据分散在变量部分重叠的不完整队列中。缺失数据下的因果发现与多源整合一直分别发展，而表格基础模型无法在不重新训练的情况下接收因果图。我们做出两项贡献。第一，因果图融合在共享变量上学习一个部分祖先图，在时间背景知识下将其融合到每个队列的图中，并让马尔可夫毯（Markov blankets）指导重新插补，从而在发现过程中处理缺失数据。第二，因果注意力引导在推理时将学习到的图编译到冻结的表格基础模型的注意力中。在已知真实基准下，融合在所有测试的缺失性和异质性条件中均优于合并和逐队列基线（p<0.001），并且引导在分布偏移下改善判别（p<10^{-5}），而随机图不会产生这种增益。在两个脊髓损伤队列中，融合将年龄、白蛋白和血红蛋白定向为住院时长的祖先，这一集合没有任何单一队列能完整定向，并产生紧凑、按时间排序的预测变量集，在五个结局中的四个上匹配或超过自动特征选择。

title: Frequency-consistent synthesis and selective transfer for medical image analysis
zh_title: 频率一致合成与选择性迁移用于医学图像分析
summary: 以自适应频率一致性和选择性特征迁移，将医学图像合成与下游任务学习联结，在五个数据集上评估。
key_points: 频率约束保证合成图像结构与细节一致
仅当合成数据教师模型任务误差更低时才迁移特征
五种数据集上翻译保真度提升，脑肿瘤分割与病灶中心点检测改善
reason: 多数据集对比、报告 105 组配对比较，但为预印本且缺乏外部临床验证
abstract: Complementary imaging is not always available, and realistic synthesis does not necessarily improve downstream analysis. Here we introduce a training framework linking medical image synthesis to task learning through adaptive frequency consistency and selective feature transfer. Image-specific frequency constraints encourage consistency of structure and detail. Features are transferred only when a teacher using synthetic images achieves a lower task-error score than the student by a task-specific margin on a labelled training sample. Evaluations across five datasets show improved translation fidelity with three adversarial and diffusion-based translators trained without paired supervision, alongside gains in brain-tumour segmentation on tumour-containing slices and lesion centre-point detection. All 105 reported paired comparisons yielded point estimates favouring the proposed methods, including 36 external translation comparisons on post?treatment MRI without retraining. These findings support synthetic modalities as task-oriented complements to acquired scans when complementary imaging is unavailable.
zh_abstract: 互补成像并不总是可用，而逼真的合成并不必然改善下游分析。在此，我们提出一个训练框架，通过自适应频率一致性和选择性特征迁移，将医学图像合成与任务学习联系起来。针对特定图像的频率约束促进结构与细节的一致性。仅当使用合成图像的教师模型在带标签训练样本上以任务特定裕度取得比学生模型更低的任务误差分数时，才迁移特征。在五个数据集上的评估显示，使用三个在无配对监督下训练的对抗式和扩散式翻译器时，翻译保真度得到改善，同时在含肿瘤切片上的脑肿瘤分割和病灶中心点检测方面也取得提升。所有 105 项报告的配对比较均产生有利于所提方法的点估计，其中包括 36 项无需重新训练的治疗后 MRI 外部翻译比较。这些发现支持：当互补成像不可用时，合成模态可作为采集扫描的任务导向补充。

title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
zh_title: RuACT：把失效评分规则变为评论者与教师
summary: 针对医学RL训练中大量评分规则失效的问题，提出按缺失信号分配教师或评论者角色的方法。
key_points: 发现在Qwen3-4B医学训练中约60.88%的查询-规则观察无学习信号
区分不可达与饱和两类失效，分别给予不同监督信号
以奖励门控的在线自蒸馏利用不可达规则
reason: 有新意的训练方法预印本，仅报告训练层面指标，无临床评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
zh_abstract: 基于评分细则的强化学习（RL）通过依据查询特定的评分细则对每个回答打分，将带可验证奖励的 RL 扩展到开放式任务。然而，在组相对优化下，如果每个采样回答都未通过某条评分细则（不可达）或都通过某条评分细则（饱和），则该评分细则会给所有回答相同结果，不提供学习信号；在 Qwen3-4B 医学训练中，60.88% 的查询-评分细则观测处于非激活状态。我们发现这两种状态缺乏的监督并不相同：在提示中陈述一条不可达评分细则可将其满足率从 1.13% 提高到 91.25%，而全部通过某条饱和评分细则的回答在质量上仍然存在差异。因此我们提出 RuACT（Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers，评分细则作为自适应评判者和教师），它为每条非激活评分细则分配能补足其所缺内容的角色。Rubric as Teacher 将不可达评分细则作为特权信息，用于奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏；Rubric as Critic 将饱和评分细则分解为子评分细则，这些子评分细则能区分当前回答，同时共享父评分细则的权重。在 Qwen3-4B 上，RuACT 在全部四个医学与科学基准上优于 GRPO、评分细则重加权和评分细则引导探索；在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得最佳平均值。在初始不可达评分细则上，无引导恢复率从 35.02% 升至 42.86%，而子评分细则细化将独立推演上的奖励-质量对齐从 57.74% 提高到 60.77%。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT。

title: Mosaic:montage-agnostic self-distilled graph learning for subject-independent ieeg seizure detection
zh_title: MOSAIC：跨蒙太奇自蒸馏图学习用于iEEG癫痫检测
summary: 提出轻量图学习框架，无需固定电极蒙太奇即可实现受试者无关的颅内脑电癫痫检测。
key_points: 通道注意力模块自适应推断通道间邻接矩阵
指数滑动平均自蒸馏，向逐患者教师正则化预测
在四个公开iEEG数据集上做受试者无关评估
reason: 多公开数据集且受试者无关评估，但为预印本、仅检测性能无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Intracranial EEG provides high signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution for detecting epileptic activity, but patient-specific electrode placement leads to substantial variation in channel count and montage across subjects. This heterogeneity limits the generalization of existing detectors under subject-independent evaluation. We propose MOSAIC (MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning), a lightweight graph-learning framework for subject-independent iEEG seizure detection. MOSAIC pairs a shared convolutional channel encoder with a patient-agnostic channel-attention module that infers a weighted inter-channel adjacency matrix from the encoded features, requiring no fixed montage graph. An exponential moving average self-distillation objective regularizes each prediction toward a slowly updated per-patient teacher. Across four public iEEG corpora (SWEC-ETHZ long- and short-term, Mayo, FNUSA), MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in F2 and Cohen's $κ$ while learning more stable inter-channel adjacencies, demonstrating that self-distilled connectivity learning transfers across unseen implantations.
zh_abstract: 颅内脑电图（iEEG）在检测癫痫活动方面提供高信噪比和空间分辨率，但患者特异性的电极放置导致受试者之间的通道数量和导联组合存在显著差异。这种异质性限制了现有检测器在受试者独立评估下的泛化能力。我们提出 MOSAIC（MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning，导联组合无关的自蒸馏自适应通道间连接学习），这是一个用于受试者独立 iEEG 癫痫检测的轻量级图学习框架。MOSAIC 将共享卷积通道编码器与患者无关的通道注意力模块配对，该模块从编码特征推断加权通道间邻接矩阵，无需固定的导联组合图。指数移动平均自蒸馏目标将每个预测正则化到缓慢更新的每位患者教师模型。在四个公开 iEEG 语料库（SWEC-ETHZ 长期和短期、Mayo、FNUSA）上，MOSAIC 在 F2 和 Cohen's κ 上优于最先进基线，同时学习到更稳定的通道间邻接关系，表明自蒸馏连接学习可迁移到未见过的植入配置。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Hospital Medicine: Foundations, Clinical Applications, and Emerging Case Uses.
zh_title: 儿科医院医学中的人工智能综述
summary: 综述儿科医院医学中的AI基础、临床应用与新兴案例，涵盖文档、决策与预测等。
key_points: 覆盖电子病历、影像、生理监测与基因组数据
应用含AI scribe、图表摘要与脓毒症预测
亦提及精准用药、罕见病诊断与心理健康
reason: 泛化综述，覆盖广但无新证据，属增量档
abstract: [Pediatric annals] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming health care and has important implications for pediatric hospital medicine. Advances in machine learning and large language models have enabled applications that support patient care in the areas of clinical documentation, decision making, and prognostic modeling. Pediatric AI systems leverage diverse data sources, including electronic health records, medical imaging, physiologic monitoring, wearable devices, and genomic data. Current applications include AI-powered scribes, chart summarization, clinical decision support, prediction of sepsis and clinical deterioration, precision pharmacotherapy, rare disease diagnosis, and mental health interventions. These technologies have demonstrated potential to reduce clinician workload, enhance diagnostic accuracy, and facilitate earlier therapeutic interventions. However, significant challenges remain, including limited and heterogeneous pediatric datasets by virtue of age and developmental characteristics in children, bias, privacy concerns, lack of representativeness, and the need for rigorous validation and oversight. As AI adoption expands, pediatric hospitalists require foundational knowledge of AI principles and limitations to ensure safe, equitable, and effective implementation. With appropriate governance and multidisciplinary collaboration, AI has the potential to improve pediatric inpatient outcomes and health care delivery.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric annals] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变医疗保健，并对儿科医院医学具有重要影响。机器学习和大型语言模型的进展使相关应用能够支持临床文档、决策和预后建模领域的患者照护。儿科AI系统利用多样化的数据来源，包括电子健康记录、医学影像、生理监测、可穿戴设备和基因组数据。当前应用包括AI驱动的记录员、病历摘要、临床决策支持、脓毒症和临床恶化预测、精准药物治疗、罕见病诊断以及心理健康干预。这些技术已显示出减少临床医生工作量、提高诊断准确性并促进更早治疗干预的潜力。然而，仍然存在重大挑战，包括由于儿童的年龄和发育特征导致儿科数据集有限且异质、偏倚、隐私问题、缺乏代表性，以及需要严格验证和监督。随着AI应用的扩大，儿科住院专科医生需要具备AI原理和局限性的基础知识，以确保安全、公平和有效的实施。通过适当的治理和多学科协作，AI有潜力改善儿科住院患者结局和医疗服务提供。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted 4D Dynamic Long-Axial PET Imaging for the Detection of Early Pancreatic Cancer Lesions
zh_title: AI辅助4D动态长轴PET早期胰腺癌检测
summary: 瑞金医院注册观察性研究，计划入组50例，用FDG/FAPI四维动态长轴PET结合AI辅助病灶检测与良恶性鉴别。
key_points: 新注册观察性研究，尚无结果
计划入组50例，正在招募
AI用于病灶检测与良恶性鉴别分析
reason: 仅试验注册、样本小且无结果，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreas Carcinoma, PDAC - Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 50; status: RECRUITING] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is associated with a poor prognosis, and early detection of pancreatic lesions is of great importance for improving patient outcomes. In this study, whole-body imaging with FDG and FAPI will be used to visualize the early development of pancreatic cancer lesions from multiple perspectives, including glucose metabolism, tumor fibrotic stroma, and integrin receptor expression. Furthermore, leveraging the advantages of four-dimensional dynamic long-axial PET imaging, artificial intelligence-assisted lesion detection and analysis will be performed to characterize lesions and differentiate between benign and malignant lesions. The imaging findings will subsequently be compared with postoperative histopathological results to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the proposed imaging approaches.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：瑞金医院；疾病：胰腺癌，PDAC——胰腺导管腺癌；类型：观察性；入组人数：50；状态：招募中] 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）预后差，胰腺病变的早期检测对于改善患者结局至关重要。在本研究中，将使用FDG和FAPI全身成像，从葡萄糖代谢、肿瘤纤维化间质和整合素受体表达等多个角度可视化胰腺癌病变的早期发展。此外，利用四维动态长轴PET成像的优势，将进行人工智能辅助的病变检测和分析，以表征病变并区分良性和恶性病变。随后将影像学发现与术后组织病理学结果进行比较，以评估所提出影像学方法的诊断性能。

title: AI Chatbot Mobile App for Self-Management in Type 2 Diabetes
zh_title: AI聊天机器人App用于2型糖尿病自我管理的RCT
summary: 埃及单中心注册120例随机对照试验，检验阿拉伯语AI聊天机器人App对2型糖尿病自我管理的效果及停用后持续性。
key_points: 干预含教育、提醒、血糖活动记录与痛苦筛查
设护士监督与使用下降时的自适应提示
计划随机120例成人，尚未招募
reason: 单中心小样本注册试验，无结果数据，属增量信息档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Type 2 diabetes needs daily self-management, but most of it happens outside the clinic, where patients get little continuous support. Earlier studies of mobile applications and chatbots were mostly short, and few tested whether benefits last after use stops. This randomized controlled trial will test an Arabic-language mobile application with an artificial intelligence chatbot for adults with type 2 diabetes attending outpatient diabetes clinics in Egypt. The application offers diabetes education, reminders, glucose and activity logging, goal setting, prompts that adapt when use declines, a diabetes distress check, and nurse oversight. A total of 120 adults will be randomly assigned equally to usual care plus the application for 8 weeks, or to usual care with an educational leaflet. Outcome assessors will not know group assignment. The main outcome is self-efficacy. Other outcomes are self-care behaviors, medication adherence, disease knowledge, random blood glucose, diabetes distress, and application use, measured at the start, at 8 weeks, and 6 and 12 weeks after the intervention ends. About 20 intervention participants will then be interviewed about their experiences and what helps or hinders continued use, and these findings will be combined with the trial results.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Alexandria University（亚历山大大学）；疾病：2型糖尿病；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA（不适用）；入组人数：120；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 2型糖尿病需要每日自我管理，但其中大部分发生在诊所之外，患者在那里获得的持续支持很少。先前关于移动应用程序和聊天机器人的研究大多时间较短，且很少检验获益在停止使用后是否持续。这项随机对照试验将测试一款阿拉伯语移动应用程序，该程序配备人工智能聊天机器人，面向在埃及糖尿病门诊就诊的2型糖尿病成人。该应用程序提供糖尿病教育、提醒、血糖和活动记录、目标设定、在使用减少时调整的提示、糖尿病困扰检查以及护士监督。总共120名成人将被随机等分至常规照护加该应用程序8周组，或常规照护加教育传单组。结局评估者将不知道分组。主要结局是自我效能。其他结局是自护行为、用药依从性、疾病知识、随机血糖、糖尿病困扰和应用程序使用情况，在开始时、第8周以及干预结束后第6周和第12周测量。随后约20名干预组参与者将接受访谈，了解其体验以及哪些因素有助于或阻碍持续使用，这些发现将与试验结果结合。

title: Comparing a Mobile App, AI Chatbot, and Printed Materials to Improve Parents' Dental Trauma Knowledge and Emergency Decisions
zh_title: 移动应用、AI聊天机器人与纸质材料改善牙外伤急救知识
summary: 一项三臂随机试验拟纳入220名家长，比较移动应用、AI聊天机器人与纸质手册对儿童牙外伤急救知识及决策的效果。
key_points: 三臂设计，1:1:1分配约220名家长
干预4周，随访至12周
评估知识、模拟急救决策与信心
reason: 注册RCT方案，尚无结果，样本220，属增量
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Lincoln University College; conditions: Dental Trauma; Traumatic Dental Injury; Parent Education / Emergency Decision-Making; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 220; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Dental trauma in children may require prompt decisions by parents or caregivers. This three-arm randomized trial will compare a mobile application, an artificial intelligence chatbot, and a printed dental-trauma first-aid booklet as methods of delivering parental education. Approximately 220 parents or legal guardians will be allocated in a 1:1:1 ratio and will receive their assigned educational resource over four weeks. Parental dental-trauma knowledge and accuracy of responses to simulated emergency scenarios will be assessed at four weeks, with follow-up assessments at 12 weeks. Additional measures include confidence, usability, engagement, recognition of avulsion management, and anxiety. The study is planned in Selangor, Malaysia.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Lincoln University College；疾病/状况：牙外伤；创伤性牙损伤；家长教育/紧急决策；类型：干预性；分期：NA；入组：220；状态：尚未招募] 儿童牙外伤可能需要家长或照护者迅速决策。这项三臂随机试验将比较移动应用程序、人工智能聊天机器人和印刷版牙外伤急救手册作为家长教育提供方法。约 220 名家长或法定监护人将按 1:1:1 比例分配，并在四周内接受其被分配的教育资源。将在第四周评估家长的牙外伤知识以及对模拟紧急场景反应的准确性，并在第 12 周进行随访评估。其他测量包括信心、可用性、参与度、对牙撕脱处理的识别和焦虑。该研究计划在马来西亚雪兰莪州进行。

title: A mixed methods evaluation of confidence, competence, and perceived value following a Teaching Institute on artificial intelligence for gerontology educators.
zh_title: 老年学教育者AI教学研修班的效果评估
summary: 混合方法评估老年学教育者参加AI教学研修班后在使用AI教学方面的信心、能力与感知价值的变化。
key_points: 介绍第14届教学研修班的设计与内容
聚焦伦理、包容与学科特异的AI应用
评估教师信心与感知能力的改变
reason: 医学教育师资培训的单组评估，无AI临床结局或算法创新，属增量档
abstract: [Gerontology & geriatrics education] As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in higher education, gerontology educators face new opportunities and ethical challenges when integrating AI tools into teaching, mentorship, and professional practice. Rapid advances in AI, alongside evolving aging research and policy, require educators to adapt their pedagogical approaches. Organizers for the Academy for Gerontology in Higher Education's 14th Annual Teaching Institute sought to address this need by providing instructor-focused professional development on emerging issues of AI in gerontology education, with an emphasis on ethical, inclusive, and discipline-specific applications. In this paper, we describe the rationale, structure, and content of the 14th Annual Teaching Institute and examine its impact on instructor confidence and perceived competence with utilizing AI professionally. A mixed methods evaluation of the workshop included pre- and post-surveys, confidence ratings, and qualitative feedback from attendees (N = 21). Quantitative results demonstrated statistically significant increases in confidence and perceived competence using AI across multiple professional domains. Qualitative findings highlighted the value of peer learning, hands-on activities, and contextualized discussions of AI in gerontology education. Findings suggest that structured, interactive professional development can enhance instructors' capacity to engage critically and responsibly with AI while reinforcing core gerontology competencies.
zh_abstract: [Gerontology & geriatrics education] 随着人工智能（AI）日益融入高等教育，老年学教育者在将AI工具整合到教学、导师指导与专业实践时面临新机遇和伦理挑战。AI的快速进步，以及不断发展的老龄研究和政策，要求教育者调整其教学法。老年学高等教育学院（Academy for Gerontology in Higher Education）第14届年度教学研究所的组织者试图通过就老年学教育中AI新兴问题提供以教师为中心的专业发展来满足这一需求，重点强调伦理、包容和学科特定的应用。在本文中，我们描述第14届年度教学研究所的理由、结构和内容，并考察其对教师在使用AI方面的专业信心和感知能力的影响。工作坊的混合方法评估包括前测和后测调查、信心评分以及参会者的定性反馈（N = 21）。定量结果显示，在多个专业领域使用AI的信心和感知能力有统计学显著提高。定性发现强调了同伴学习、动手活动以及老年学教育中AI情境化讨论的价值。研究结果表明，结构化、互动式的专业发展可以增强教师批判性和负责任地使用AI的能力，同时强化核心老年学胜任力。

title: Accelerometer Data Harmonization and Feature Engineering for Gait Analytics
zh_title: 步态加速度计数据标准化与特征工程流程
summary: 一项预印本研究构建标准化数据处理流程与数据仓库，整合6个公开步态加速度数据集共935人，并以性别分类作为下游验证。
key_points: 整合6个公开数据集、共935名受试者
构建星型模式数据仓库与质量控制流程
跨数据集与佩戴位置的特征可比性评估
reason: 预印本方法学工作，下游任务仅为概念验证，属增量档
abstract: Gait analytics is utilized for a wide range of health-related applications, ranging from fitness tracking to medical diagnostics, and beyond. Inertial measurement units that are ubiquitously available in mobile devices provide an accessible means of gait analysis but differences in sensor specifications, placement, and recording protocols limit comparability across studies. This study developed and evaluated an analysis-centered data warehouse and standardized quality-assessed processing pipeline to facilitate the integration and joint analysis of heterogeneous gait accelerometer data. Six publicly available datasets including a total of 935 persons were integrated into a star-schema data warehouse, and feature comparability was assessed across datasets and sensor locations. Gender classification served as a proof-of-concept downstream analysis. Gait-cycle extraction, which serves as foundation for feature extraction, was successfully achieved with an accuracy above 99% for the dataset that provides ground truth information. Comparability varied across datasets and sensor configurations, with correlation coefficients between average gait cycles ranging from 0.5 to close to 1.0. Centrally positioned sensors generally show greater correspondence than peripheral sensors, although differences in statistical features persist even between sensors at nominally identical locations. Gender classification performance remains largely near chance level, and no consistent benefit from pooling datasets could be established. These findings demonstrate that heterogeneous gait accelerometer data can be integrated and processed within a common analytical framework, but standardized processing alone does not ensure comparability of the resulting features. The proposed open-source framework implemented in Python provides a foundation for reproducible cross-study gait analysis and for investigating residual heterogeneity associated with datasets and sensor configurations.
zh_abstract: 步态分析被用于广泛的健康相关应用，从健身追踪到医学诊断，乃至更多领域。移动设备中普遍可用的惯性测量单元为步态分析提供了可及的手段，但传感器规格、放置位置和记录方案的差异限制了研究之间的可比性。本研究开发并评估了一个以分析为中心的数据仓库和标准化、经过质量评估的处理流程，以促进异质性步态加速度计数据的整合与联合分析。六个公开可用数据集共纳入 935 人，被整合到一个星型模式数据仓库中，并在不同数据集和传感器位置之间评估了特征可比性。性别分类作为概念验证的下游分析。作为特征提取基础的步态周期提取，在提供真实标注信息的数据集上成功实现，准确率超过 99%。可比性因数据集和传感器配置而异，平均步态周期之间的相关系数范围为 0.5 至接近 1.0。中心位置的传感器通常比外周传感器表现出更高的一致性，尽管即使在名义上相同位置的传感器之间，统计特征差异仍然存在。性别分类性能在很大程度上仍接近随机水平，且未能确定合并数据集有一致获益。这些发现表明，异质性步态加速度计数据可以在共同分析框架内整合和处理，但仅靠标准化处理并不能确保所得特征的可比性。所提出的用 Python 实现的开源框架为可重复的跨研究步态分析以及研究与数据集和传感器配置相关的残余异质性提供了基础。

title: Realism and resolution: How AI-predicted protein structures differ from experimental structures
zh_title: AI预测蛋白结构真实性与分辨率评估工具WhatRes
summary: 预印本提出WhatRes，从“表观分辨率”和“真实性”两个维度评估预测蛋白结构几何与实验结构的差异，揭示高置信模型的过度理想化。
key_points: 从坐标层面评估结构的表观分辨率与真实性
预测模型键长键角变异小于高分辨晶体结构
在高置信模型中同样检出过度理想化
reason: 预印本工具方法，针对结构预测质量控制，属增量改进
abstract: Protein structure predictors can recover protein folds with remarkable accuracy, and their models are increasingly used as if they were experimental structures. Yet even for a confidently predicted fold, it remains difficult to judge how faithfully the model reproduces protein geometry. We introduce WhatRes, which assesses a structure from its coordinates on two complementary axes. Apparent resolution estimates the experimental resolution its local geometry most closely resembles. Realism measures how closely that geometry matches experimental structures at the same apparent resolution. Predicted models can score well on apparent resolution while showing systematically less variation in bond lengths and angles than is observed in high-resolution crystal structures. WhatRes reveals this over-idealisation even in high-confidence models.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质结构预测器能够以显著准确性恢复蛋白质折叠，其模型正越来越多地被当作实验结构使用。然而，即使对于一个高置信度预测的折叠，仍难以判断模型再现蛋白质几何结构的忠实程度。我们提出WhatRes，它从坐标出发在两个互补维度上评估结构。表观分辨率（apparent resolution）估计其局部几何结构最接近的实验分辨率。真实度（realism）衡量该几何结构与相同表观分辨率下实验结构的匹配程度。预测模型可以在表观分辨率上得分良好，同时其键长和键角的变化却系统性低于高分辨率晶体结构中观察到的变化。WhatRes甚至在高置信度模型中也揭示了这种过度理想化。

title: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis
zh_title: 面向非独立同分布生物医学数据的一次性层次联邦聚类
summary: 提出一次性层次联邦聚类框架，以单向原型通信实现机构端分布探索与服务器端聚合，降低开销与隐私风险。
key_points: 面向多机构生物医学数据孤岛与嵌套分布
单次单向原型传输替代递归层次聚类
声称降低计算开销并缓解隐私泄漏
reason: 纯方法预印本，未给出外部验证或医疗任务实证，属增量档
abstract: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.
zh_abstract: 在多机构生物医学数据分析中，全面的疾病画像常分散在不同数据孤岛中。此外，本地数据分布通常表现出不同层次的粒度，甚至复杂的嵌套结构。尽管层次聚类（Hierarchical Clustering, HC）是探索此类数据拓扑的强大工具，但其繁琐的递归过程会带来难以承受的计算开销，并使其极易发生隐私泄露。因此，本文提出一种高效的一次性层次 FC 框架，通过从客户端到服务器的单向原型级通信，执行客户端（机构）端的分布探索和服务器端的分布聚合。尽管所设计的一次性原型传输保证了最小计算开销并降低了隐私风险，但它不可避免地会造成信息损失。为抵消这一点，在服务器端提出一种多粒度竞争学习机制来融合小簇（clusterlets），从而在有限单向通信约束下有效最大化全局分布拓扑的保留和挖掘。结果表明，跨客户端的复杂簇分布可以被高效探索；在公共数据集上与最先进方法进行比较的大量实验证明了所提出框架在平衡稳健聚类、隐私保护和计算效率方面的优越性。

title: NanoNet: Ultra-Lightweight Network for MRI Brain Tumor Classification toward Edge AI
zh_title: NanoNet：面向边缘AI的超轻量脑肿瘤MRI分类网络
summary: 提出仅8132参数的超轻量卷积网络NanoNet，在BRISC 2025基准上脑肿瘤MRI分类准确率92.80%。
key_points: 五个倒残差块，8132个参数
结合结构化剪枝、蒸馏与INT8量化
BRISC 2025基准准确率92.80%
reason: 小样本基准上的轻量化改进，无外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Automated brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can support accessible medical image analysis, but conventional deep learning models often exceed the resource budgets of highly constrained edge-AI platforms. We present NanoNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for resourceconstrained MRI classification and motivated by future edge-AI applications. Inspired by MobileNetV2, NanoNet substantially reduces network depth, channel capacity, expansion ratios, and final feature dimensionality, resulting in only five inverted residual blocks and 8,132 parameters. We further investigate dependency-aware structured pruning, knowledge distillation, and INT8 quantization-aware training for additional compression. Experiments on the BRISC 2025 benchmark show that NanoNet achieves 92.80% accuracy and 92.97% macro F1 with 8,132 parameters and 10.498 MFLOPs. Across three compression seeds, it exceeds the mean accuracy of 70%-pruned MobileNetV2 by 5.20 percentage points while using 60.2% fewer parameters and 9.8% less computation. Converted INT8 NanoNet achieves 89.70% accuracy and 90.22% macro F1 across three QAT seeds. Earlier TensorFlow Lite measurements indicate 27.7 KB of baseline model storage, motivating future edge-AI deployment.
zh_abstract: 从磁共振成像（MRI）自动进行脑肿瘤分类可支持可及的医学图像分析，但传统深度学习模型往往超出高度受限边缘AI平台的资源预算。我们提出NanoNet，一种超轻量卷积神经网络，面向资源受限的MRI分类设计，并受未来边缘AI应用驱动。受MobileNetV2启发，NanoNet大幅减少网络深度、通道容量、扩展比例和最终特征维度，仅包含五个倒残差块和8,132个参数。我们进一步研究依赖感知结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏和INT8量化感知训练以实现额外压缩。在BRISC 2025基准上的实验表明，NanoNet在8,132个参数和10.498 MFLOPs下达到92.80%准确率和92.97%宏F1。在三个压缩随机种子下，其准确率比剪枝70%的MobileNetV2的平均准确率高5.20个百分点，同时参数少60.2%、计算量少9.8%。转换后的INT8 NanoNet在三个QAT种子下达到89.70%准确率和90.22%宏F1。早期TensorFlow Lite测量表明基线模型存储为27.7 KB，为未来边缘AI部署提供了动力。

title: Complementarity without ground truth?
zh_title: 无真值时的人机互补性评估框架
summary: 预印本讨论人机互补性对真值标签的依赖，并提出在无真值任务中用充分性标签构建参照的方法。
key_points: 指出医疗AI建议类任务不适用预测式真值
提出以充分性标签替代真值的参照构建
拓展人机互补性评估的适用边界
reason: 概念与方法学讨论，无实验对照与数据验证，属增量档
abstract: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.
zh_abstract: 人-AI互补性（Human-AI complementarity）指的是这样一种观念：由AI系统辅助的人可以同时胜过单独行动的人和单独行动的AI。在预测任务中，这种改善是相对于通过参考构建程序（reference construction procedure）产生、并旨在代表待预测事态的真实标签（ground truth labels）来评估的。然而，许多人与AI的交互，包括医学AI提供治疗建议的交互，涉及的是预测“什么成立”之外的任务。其相关输出关乎相对于某一实践目标的充分性，并取决于若干评价维度。在这项工作中，我们考察互补性对真实标签的依赖，并将其扩展到真实标签不是适当参照的人-AI交互。我们表明，超越预测的任务仍然可以存在一种参考构建程序，用以生成充分性标签。我们开发了一条将互补性扩展到此类情境的路径。它用依赖情境的充分性标签替代真实标签，这些标签通过受医疗保健多准则决策分析框架启发的两步评分方法生成，并使参考构建背后的规范性选择明确化。由于充分性标签的构建嵌入了评价性选择，我们从计算可靠性主义（computational reliabilism）中汲取方法论灵感，以识别支持其构建的相关技术、科学和社会因素。我们的方法将人-AI互补性的实证研究扩展到预测任务之外，使其能够在真实标签不是适当评价参照的决策支持情境中进行定量评估。

title: Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection
zh_title: Auto-GlaKG：可解释青光眼检测的生物标志物推理
summary: 用 ResNet50 预测杯盘比与六项形态体征，再由知识图谱规则汇总为青光眼评分，在 689 张眼底图上内部交叉验证。
key_points: 结合图像生物标志物预测与固定临床先验规则
研究指出仅有图像时性能未必等同有标注生物标志物的结果
reason: 样本数百例、仅内部交叉验证、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.
zh_abstract: 可解释的青光眼检测需要在眼底图像、具有临床意义的生物标志物和诊断预测之间建立透明联系。知识图谱（KG）推理提供了这种结构，但使用标注生物标志物测得的性能并不能确立仅当图像可用时的性能。我们提出 Auto-GlaKG，一个将基于图像的生物标志物预测与固定临床先验规则相结合的自动化框架。ResNet50 网络在生物标志物监督下预测杯盘比（CDR）和六个形态学征象，知识图谱推理器将其带符号规则贡献聚合为青光眼评分。在 689 张眼底图像上，采用分层、分组感知的五折交叉验证进行评估，Auto-GlaKG 达到合并的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）0.951（95% 置信区间：0.931–0.969），灵敏度为 0.970，特异度为 0.779。匹配的图像分类器也达到 AUC 0.951，而规则阶段每张图像增加 0.2 ms。用其标注替换预测的 CDR 后，折平均 AUC 从 0.953 增至 0.995。该框架为基于图像的预测提供了明确的规则级解释，并将 CDR 估计确定为使用独立测量的生物标志物进行验证的优先事项。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Modeling to Aid in the Identification of Genetic Conditions in Infants with Congenital Heart Disease.
source: PubMed · medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
zh_title: AI建模辅助识别先天性心脏病婴儿遗传病
summary: medRxiv预印本：单中心回顾性队列纳入1720例先心病患儿，用超声影像与病历数据构建多模态模型，按临床可获顺序预测最可能遗传病。
key_points: 单中心回顾性队列，1720例先心病患儿
融合超声图像与序列病历的多模态深度学习
以均衡Top-3准确率为主要指标并给自助法区间
reason: 回顾性单中心内部验证，样本量可观但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Genetic conditions are common in congenital heart disease (CHD) and affect care, but are often missed or diagnosed late. We asked whether routine clinical data can shortlist the most likely genetic conditions. Retrospective single-center cohort of children with CHD and an echocardiogram who had either a confirmed genetic diagnosis or negative cytogenetic testing and CHD gene sequencing. Echocardiogram images and serial medical record data were added as model inputs in the order they become clinically available. Class-balanced logistic regression (LR) and a multimodal deep learning fusion network were fitted to the same inputs at each step. The primary metric was balanced top-3 accuracy (correct diagnosis among the top three, averaged across conditions), with bootstrap intervals. The cohort included 1,720 children (988 with common CHD-associated genetic conditions, 231 rare diagnoses, 501 negative testing). Using only inputs generated at the echocardiogram visit, LR reached a balanced top-3 accuracy 0.758 (chance 0.429). Serial records, radiology notes and ICD-10 codes, raised this to 0.809. Multimodal fusion performed similarly at each stage. With a genetic condition withheld from training, the fusion embedding placed affected children nearest to others sharing a gene group in 0.37 of cases versus 0.10 without the embedding (+0.268 [95% CI +0.242, +0.295]). Routine clinical data available at first echocardiogram can help identify likely genetic diagnoses, and later coded inputs ceiling. Multimodal fusion added no accuracy over LR, but places children sharing a genetic cause near one another, making nearest-neighbor retrieval informative for undiagnosed children.
zh_abstract: [medRxiv：健康科学预印本服务器] 遗传性疾病在先天性心脏病（CHD）中常见并影响诊疗，但常被漏诊或诊断延迟。我们探讨常规临床数据能否筛选出最可能的遗传性疾病。这是一项回顾性单中心队列，纳入患有CHD且接受超声心动图的儿童，这些儿童要么有确诊的遗传学诊断，要么细胞遗传学检测和CHD基因测序均为阴性。超声心动图图像和纵向病历数据按临床可获得顺序逐步作为模型输入。类别平衡的逻辑回归（LR）和多模态深度学习融合网络在每一步拟合相同的输入。主要指标为平衡的top-3准确率（正确诊断位于前三名，按疾病平均），并给出bootstrap区间。队列包括1,720名儿童（988名患有常见CHD相关遗传性疾病，231名罕见诊断，501名检测阴性）。仅使用超声心动图就诊时产生的输入，LR达到平衡top-3准确率0.758（随机水平0.429）。纵向记录、放射学报告和ICD-10编码将其提高至0.809。多模态融合在每个阶段表现相似。当一种遗传性疾病被从训练中保留时，融合嵌入在0.37的病例中将患病儿童置于与其他共享同一基因分组的儿童最近的位置，而无嵌入时为0.10（+0.268 [95% CI +0.242, +0.295]）。首次超声心动图时可获得的常规临床数据有助于识别可能的遗传学诊断，而后续编码输入则达到上限。多模态融合相较LR未增加准确率，但将共享遗传病因的儿童彼此置于邻近位置，使最近邻检索对未确诊儿童具有信息价值。

title: Deep-learning-driven tumor microenvironment profiling improves immunotherapy response prediction.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: EcoNet：深度学习刻画肿瘤微环境预测免疫治疗反应
summary: 基于肿瘤微环境细胞生态与信号网络、用图注意力网络构建的EcoNet，用于改善免疫治疗反应预测。
key_points: 建模共现细胞状态组成的生态系统
构建细胞间与细胞内信号网络
用图注意力网络生成预测嵌入

abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Immunotherapy has transformed the management of many cancers, such as clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), yet durable clinical benefit is achieved in only a subset of patients. Immunotherapy outcomes are governed by the multicellular tumor microenvironment (TME), through the structured and directional interplay of regulatory programs and ligand-receptor communications. Yet most existing methods for immunotherapy response prediction rely on independent signatures or cell types and fail to model the structured and directional signaling network within the TME. To address this gap, we introduce EcoNet, a computational framework that first models ecosystems consisting of co-occurring cell states, then constructs intercellular and intracellular signaling networks based on the ecosystems, and applies a graph attention network to derive embeddings from the signaling network for immunotherapy response prediction. Pretrained on 2,532 pan-cancer immunotherapy samples across multiple cohorts, EcoNet outperformed existing prediction methods by 7.5-19.9% and marker-based signatures by 4.4-21.2% in AUC, and its high-attention genes were enriched among those required for T-cell-mediated tumor killing in an independent CRISPR screen; applied to ccRCC with disease-specific fine-tuning, it stratified an independent ccRCC cohort by clinical outcome ( P =0.024). Biologically, high-attention genes capture an interferon-responsive program that enhances antigen presentation and immune infiltration. To validate these findings, we curated a ccRCC clinical cohort profiled with CosMx single-cell spatial transcriptomics (46 samples, ~450,000 cells) and found the response-associated TME configuration identified by EcoNet localized to immune-enriched niches, supporting the response stratification. These results establish EcoNet as a generalizable framework for TME-informed therapeutic response prediction, readily extensible to other cancer types and therapeutic contexts.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv：生物学预印本服务器] 免疫治疗已改变许多癌症（如透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC））的管理，但仅在部分患者中实现持久临床获益。免疫治疗结局由多细胞肿瘤微环境（TME）通过调控程序与配体-受体通讯的结构化和方向性相互作用所决定。然而，大多数现有免疫治疗反应预测方法依赖独立特征或细胞类型，未能建模 TME 内的结构化和方向性信号网络。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 EcoNet，一个计算框架，其首先建模由共现细胞状态组成的生态系统，然后基于这些生态系统构建细胞间和细胞内信号网络，并应用图注意力网络从信号网络导出嵌入以进行免疫治疗反应预测。在多个队列的 2,532 份泛癌免疫治疗样本上预训练后，EcoNet 在 AUC 上优于现有预测方法 7.5-19.9%，优于基于标志物的特征 4.4-21.2%，其高注意力基因在独立 CRISPR 筛选中于 T 细胞介导肿瘤杀伤所需基因中富集；应用于 ccRCC 并进行疾病特异性微调后，它按临床结局对独立 ccRCC 队列进行分层（P =0.024）。在生物学上，高注意力基因捕获一个干扰素应答程序，该程序增强抗原呈递和免疫浸润。为验证这些发现，我们构建了一个使用 CosMx 单细胞空间转录组学分析的 ccRCC 临床队列（46 个样本，约 450,000 个细胞），发现 EcoNet 识别的反应相关 TME 构型定位于免疫富集生态位，支持反应分层。这些结果确立 EcoNet 为一个可推广的、基于 TME 信息的治疗反应预测框架，易于扩展到其他癌症类型和治疗情境。

title: CXR-CMFA: A Cross-Modal Feature Aggregation Network for Chest X-Ray Pathology Classification
zh_title: 轻量跨模态特征聚合的胸片病理分类
summary: 提出CXR-CMFA，融合双流视觉编码器与影像报告文本编码器，实现轻量级胸片二分类病理识别。
key_points: 双流视觉编码提取全局与局部特征
TF-IDF-MLP编码放射报告文本
两个融合模块以报告门控视觉特征
reason: 预印本方法改进型工作，条目未见外部验证或开源信息，属增量档。
abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.
zh_abstract: 胸部 X 线（chest X-ray，CXR）解读仍然具有挑战性，因为细微病变可能被重叠解剖结构、图像质量变化以及孤立 X 线片中有限的视觉证据所掩盖。尽管仅图像深度学习模型提供了有用的基线，但它们丢弃了放射学报告中可用的互补诊断背景，而大型视觉语言模型对于实际部署可能计算成本高昂。本文提出 CXR-CMFA，一种用于 CXR 病理二分类的轻量级跨模态特征聚合网络。所提出框架将双流视觉编码器（使用 EfficientNet-B0 获取全局解剖表征，使用 DenseNet-121 获取局部病理细节）与 TF-IDF-MLP 报告编码器相结合。两个融合模块整合这些模态：双模态空间注意力模块（Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module，DMSAM）使用报告嵌入对全局和局部视觉特征进行门控，跨模态门控特征融合（Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion，CGFF）模块学习视觉和文本贡献的每个实例权重。在 MIMIC-CXR 基准上使用提供的训练、验证和测试划分进行实验，结果显示 CXR-CMFA 在留出测试集上达到 93.45% 准确率、99.88% 精确率、91.8% 召回率、95.7% F1 分数和 99.19% AUC。该模型在 984 例正常测试病例中仅产生四个假阳性，支持其适用于高特异性筛查流程。消融研究进一步显示，相较于仅全局图像变体，AUC 提高 22.47 个百分点，证实了自适应跨模态融合的价值。这些结果表明，紧凑的报告条件融合可以在不依赖大型预训练语言模型的情况下提供强判别性能。

title: Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness
zh_title: 异构特征空间下的群体鲁棒学习
summary: 提出面向患者特征空间异构的群体鲁棒学习框架，以最差组超额损失替代最高损失加权，促进跨特征空间的知识共享。
key_points: 以最差组超额损失为优化目标
避免把无信息特征的高损失当难点
特征空间不重叠时仍允许组间共享
reason: 预印本方法论文，以临床检查不一致为动机但缺具体临床验证，属增量档。
abstract: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.
zh_abstract: 在临床应用中，患者接受不同的检查组合，因此机器学习模型必须在异构特征空间中确保准确预测。当前方法提高损失最高患者的权重，却没有考虑其特征中有限的预测信息会阻止其损失进一步降低。此外，当患者的特征空间完全不相交时，当前方法退化为训练独立模型，阻碍了它们之间的知识迁移。我们提出了一个跨异构特征空间的分组鲁棒学习框架，其中组是共享同一特征空间的患者。由于高损失可能仅反映无信息特征，我们改为优化最差组超额损失，即组损失与其可达到最优值的估计之间的差距。为允许组间协作，我们使用组特异性编码器映射到共享潜在空间，在该空间中可学习的高斯锚点按结局对患者聚类。在表格和影像医学数据集上，包括特征完全不相交的设置，当各组最优损失不同或无法独自训练良好模型时，我们的框架优于最先进方法，将最差组损失最多降低 79%，将超额损失最多降低 95%，且参数量最多可减少至原来的 1/18。

title: Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion
zh_title: 引导共注意力与自适应门控的多模态医学融合
summary: 预印本提出结合token级引导、双向交叉注意力与自适应门控的融合框架，在配对胸片与放射报告上评估，摘要未列结果。
key_points: token级引导先调制表示再做交叉注意力
构建文本查询图像与图像查询文本双向表示
自适应门控按样本学习两方向表示权重
reason: 预印本新融合方法，仅内部数据评估、摘要无结果，属增量档
abstract: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.
zh_abstract: 多模态融合不仅需要跨模态交换信息，还需要确定哪些表示应参与交互，以及互补的跨模态视图应如何组合。我们提出Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating（带自适应门控的引导式协同注意力），一种融合框架，整合token级引导、双向交叉注意力和样本特异性融合。所提方法构建两个方向性表示：图像条件文本表示，通过允许文本token查询视觉特征获得；以及反向形成的文本条件图像表示。token级引导在交叉注意力之前调制表示，而自适应门学习两个所得方向性表示对每个样本的相对贡献。我们使用配对的胸部X线片和放射学报告作为图像-文本测试平台，评估二分类（正常 vs. 异常）方法。两个交叉注意力方向表现出不同的性能特征，表明反转查询模态和源模态不会产生可互换的表示。消融实验进一步表明，双向交互、自适应门控和token引导提供互补收益。所提模型达到96.05%准确率、96.10% F1分数、98.37% AUC、95.60% Sens@95Spec和96.51% Spec@95Sens，在所有评估指标上取得最高平均性能。这些发现支持在构建多模态表示时显式建模交互方向、token相关性和样本依赖的整合。

title: STAIRS: Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction
zh_title: STAIRS：展开式MRI重建的可容许支撑调度
summary: 预印本提出STAIRS，将中间重建投影到逐步扩展的傅里叶支撑并据此调节更新，实现由粗到细的MRI重建。
key_points: 指出展开网络每级都估计全频谱的问题
用嵌套傅里叶支撑随级联逐步扩展
以协方差对数行列式定义归一化谱坐标
reason: 纯方法预印本，无外部验证与临床结果，属增量档
abstract: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.
zh_abstract: 加速磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging, MRI）从非完整傅里叶测量中形成图像，将采集负担转移到计算重建。深度展开网络交替进行学习到的正则化与数据一致性，但通常在每个级联中估计完整的未测量频谱。我们提出STAIRS（Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling，通过可允许支撑调度分阶段求解逆问题），它将中间重建投影到嵌套的傅里叶支撑上，这些支撑逐步扩展到完整频谱，并使每次更新以其支撑转移为条件。训练协方差的正则化对数行列式得分的条件增量定义了一个归一化频谱坐标，考虑了新纳入频率与先前已纳入频率之间的依赖关系。二元目标（Dyadic targets）将更大的坐标增量分配给较早的级联，并在训练前映射到固定支撑，从而在采样掩模和数据一致性不变的情况下实现由粗到细的重建。在fastMRI和Stanford2D上，STAIRS在单线圈和多线圈重建中改进了匹配的Transformer（HUMUSNet）和卷积（NAFNet）骨干网络，包括放射科医生标注的病理区域。它还在更低的参数开销和推理延迟下优于基于预测器的进展方法。逐阶段分析表明，通过投影进行重复误差校正，并且在整个支撑扩展过程中，中间重建误差低于单独使用骨干网络。消融实验表明，对于方形和线带状支撑，二元分配优于均匀扩展；对于方形窗口，二元分配优于手动前置加载（front-loading）。仅支撑投影即可改善重建，而转移条件化增强了增益。跨数据集评估显示，两个骨干网络在两个方向上均有改善。因此，支撑分配与展开MRI重建中的正则化器设计相辅相成。

title: GRAC: Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning for Surgical Scene Description
zh_title: GRAC：基于图检索增强的手术场景描述生成
summary: 预印本提出GRAC，将手术场景表示为图并检索相似图—描述对辅助生成，在EndoVis-18基准上评估。
key_points: 以图结构刻画器械、动作与解剖结构关系
检索训练集中相关图—描述对辅助生成
用器械—组织交互比较特征条件化生成
reason: 单基准预印本方法，摘要未给对比结果，属增量档
abstract: Purpose: Surgical operative reports support procedural documentation, surgical training, performance assessment, and workflow review. However, extracting meaningful information often requires extensive manual review and clinical expertise. Automated surgical scene descriptions could reduce this burden by leveraging recurring surgical activities and prior knowledge. Methods: We propose GRAC (Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning), a framework that represents surgical scenes as graphs capturing relationships among instruments, actions, and anatomical structures. Given an input scene graph, GRAC learns to retrieve relevant graph-caption pairs from training data. It compares instrument-tissue interactions between retrieved examples and the input scene, using comparison features to condition retrieved-caption representations during generation. Results: On the EndoVis-18 benchmark, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.88, compared with 4.23 for SGT and 3.36 for the strongest conventional Transformer baseline. Exact instrument-action-target triplet-set accuracy reached 52.6%, compared with 32.7% for SGT and 26.2% for the strongest conventional baseline. These results demonstrate improvements in language quality and factual agreement. On TORS, GRAC achieved a CIDEr-D of 5.06, compared with 3.80 for the strongest baseline. Conclusion: GRAC demonstrates that combining structured surgical scene representations with retrieved examples improves surgical scene captioning and produces more contextually meaningful descriptions.
zh_abstract: 【目的】手术操作报告支持手术记录、外科培训、绩效评估和工作流程审查。然而，提取有意义的信息通常需要大量人工审查和临床专业知识。自动手术场景描述可通过利用反复出现的手术活动和先验知识来减轻这一负担。【方法】我们提出 GRAC（Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Captioning），一个将手术场景表示为图以捕捉器械、动作和解剖结构之间关系的框架。给定输入场景图，GRAC 学习从训练数据中检索相关的图-描述对。它比较检索示例与输入场景之间的器械-组织交互，使用比较特征在生成过程中对检索到的描述表示进行条件化。【结果】在 EndoVis-18 基准上，GRAC 达到 CIDEr-D 5.88，而 SGT 为 4.23，最强的传统 Transformer 基线为 3.36。精确的器械-动作-目标三元组集合准确率达到 52.6%，而 SGT 为 32.7%，最强传统基线为 26.2%。这些结果证明了语言质量和事实一致性的改善。在 TORS 上，GRAC 达到 CIDEr-D 5.06，而最强基线为 3.80。【结论】GRAC 表明，将结构化手术场景表示与检索示例相结合可改善手术场景描述生成，并产生更具上下文意义的描述。

title: Unified Framework with Convex-Concave Decomposition and Sparse Topological Learning for Skeleton-Based Clinical Assessment
zh_title: 凸凹分解与稀疏拓扑学习的骨骼康复评估框架
summary: 提出多流图卷积模型，用凸凹距离分解、稀疏正则与自适应拓扑建模病理动作中的关节依赖，用于康复评估。
key_points: 凸凹距离函数刻画局部与全局运动特征
稀疏正则结合近端优化筛选临床相关几何特征
在 KiMoRe 与 UIPRMD 数据集上验证有效性
reason: 两个公开数据集验证但缺乏临床结局与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Skeleton-based rehabilitation assessment faces fundamental limitations of fixed topologies which cannot model compensatory patterns, uniform joint treatments overlook clinically important deviations, and lack of geometric understand- ing. We propose Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network (CC2-STG), a multi-stream model that combines geo- metric decomposition, sparse feature learning, and adaptive topology. Our framework decomposes joint relationships into complementary convex-concave distance functions to model both local and global movement characteristics, with sparse regularization with proximal optimization selecting clinically relevant geo- metric features, while multi-scale topological analysis captures non-anatomical joint dependencies in pathological movements. Experiments on the KiMoRe and UIPRMD datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical pathological movement assessment.
zh_abstract: 基于骨架的康复评估面临固定拓扑的根本局限——无法建模代偿模式；统一的关节处理忽视了临床上重要的偏差；并且缺乏几何理解。我们提出凹凸分解稀疏拓扑图卷积网络（CC2-STG），这是一种多流模型，结合几何分解、稀疏特征学习和自适应拓扑。我们的框架将关节关系分解为互补的凸-凹距离函数，以建模局部和全局运动特征；采用稀疏正则化与近端优化选择临床相关的几何特征；同时多尺度拓扑分析捕捉病理性运动中的非解剖关节依赖关系。在 KiMoRe 和 UIPRMD 数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性，在临床病理性运动评估方面达到最先进性能。

title: Agentic AI for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis: A Policy-Grounded Framework for Privacy Preservation
zh_title: 医疗理赔拒付分析的智能体框架
summary: 提出模块化智能体框架，整合拒付风险预测、风险因素识别、编码关系与反事实分析，并结合政策文档RAG与HIPAA合规智能体。
key_points: 四类专用智能体分工完成拒付分析
基于政策文档的混合上下文RAG管线

reason: 预印本且仅合成数据自评，属行政流程应用，证据有限，增量偏上看待
abstract: In the healthcare sector, claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens, emphasizing the need for automated and trustworthy decision-support systems. This paper proposes a modular Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, integrating specialized agents for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis. The framework integrates predictive analytics, graph-based learning, a Hybrid Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents, and a dedicated HIPAA Compliance Agent to support privacy protection. Evaluated on a synthetic healthcare claims dataset, the framework achieved 98% traceability of reported numerical findings, validated 214 of 216 policy citations, and removed all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without modifying the underlying analysis. These findings pave the way for further research into Agentic AI as a framework for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving healthcare claim denial management.
zh_abstract: 在医疗保健领域，索赔拒付带来显著财务和行政负担，凸显了对自动化且可信决策支持系统的需求。本文提出一个模块化智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）框架，用于医疗保健索赔拒付分析，集成用于拒付风险预测、风险因素识别、诊断-操作-药物代码关系分析和反事实分析的专用智能体。该框架整合预测分析、基于图的学习、以医疗保健政策文件为基础的混合上下文检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，以及专用 HIPAA 合规智能体以支持隐私保护。在一个合成医疗保健索赔数据集上评估，该框架实现了所报告数值发现 98% 的可追溯性，验证了 216 条政策引用中的 214 条，并在不修改底层分析的情况下移除了所有 280 个识别出的敏感标识符。这些发现为进一步研究智能体 AI 作为可解释、政策感知且保护隐私的医疗保健索赔拒付管理框架铺平了道路。

title: Anatomy-Preserving Unpaired Medical Image Translation via Shared Latent Anchoring
zh_title: 共享潜空间锚定的解剖保持无配对图像翻译
summary: 预印本提出两阶段框架：先学习模态无关的共享结构空间，再在冻结结构表示上生成目标模态图像。
key_points: 将解剖结构保持与外观生成解耦
联合源图、目标图与结构掩码训练结构编码
生成器仅作用于冻结的结构表示
reason: 方法类预印本，无数据集规模与验证细节，属增量档
abstract: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. Existing methods learn a direct source-to-target mapping that entangles structure preservation and appearance generation within a single model, often distorting clinically meaningful anatomy in the translated output. We argue that these two objectives should be decoupled entirely: anatomical structure should be captured independently of generation, and the generator should operate only on a frozen structural representation. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework for unpaired medical image translation. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. The project repository is available on GitHub.
zh_abstract: 非配对医学图像到图像翻译需要在没有对齐监督的情况下，从源模态图像合成目标模态图像。现有方法学习直接的源到目标映射，将结构保持和外观生成纠缠在单一模型中，常常使翻译输出中具有临床意义的解剖结构发生扭曲。我们认为，这两个目标应完全解耦：解剖结构应独立于生成过程被捕获，生成器应仅作用于冻结的结构表示。为此，我们提出一个用于非配对医学图像翻译的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们通过在源图像、目标图像和结构掩模上联合训练结构编码器-解码器来学习共享结构空间，利用掩模重建将潜在空间锚定到模态无关的解剖结构。对于没有掩模标注的源图像，目标域记忆库通过原型检索提供软结构监督。在第二阶段，条件流模型学习在固定结构条件下渲染目标域外观。这确保生成器继承目标外观统计特性，并能够完全专注于结构条件化，而不是从头学习外观。我们在OCT到OCTA合成和脑部MR到CT翻译上验证了我们的框架。我们的方法在两个任务上均优于所有非配对基线，并且尽管不需要配对监督，也超过了配对基线，在OCT到OCTA上将PSNR最多提高11.2%，SSIM最多提高26.4%，并在MR到CT上在全图、软组织和骨区域取得一致增益。项目仓库可在GitHub上获取。

title: ATHENA: Hypergraph-Based Learning for Toddler Autism Classification from Eye-Tracking

summary: 提出融合特征增强与自适应超图框架，对幼儿眼动注视坐标进行孤独症分类，报告极高 AUC 与准确率。
key_points: 模型含 FMMix 特征级增强与自适应超图结构
两个眼动数据集报告 AUC 约 99.8% 与 99.86%
作者称结果超过现有方法，但未给出外部验证信息
reason: 预印本、指标近乎饱和且无外部验证，结论可能超出数据
abstract: In this work we proposed a architecture designed for the classification of ASD in toddlers using eye-tracking data, addressing the critical need for early and precise detection. The proposed model incorporates FMMix, a feature-level augmentation technique that bolsters the model's learning capacity, and in this work we proposed the ATHENA, which captures intricate feature relationships via an adaptive hypergraph framework. Evaluated on two datasets dataset of gaze coordinates-the model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with AUC scores of 99.80% and 99.86%, respectively. It also exhibits high accuracy of 98.45% and 98.56%, sensitivity 98.01% and 98.10%, and specificity 98.74% and 99.02%, respectively. Demonstrating its superior ability to identify subtle gaze patterns associated with ASD, these results significantly surpass existing methods, highlighting the model's potential for clinical ASD screening. Future efforts will focus on validation across broader populations and integration with multi-modal data to further refine diagnostic accuracy.
zh_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种旨在利用眼动数据对幼儿 ASD 进行分类的架构，以满足早期、精准检测的关键需求。所提模型纳入 FMMix——一种特征级增强技术，可增强模型的学习能力；并在本工作中提出 ATHENA，它通过自适应超图框架捕捉复杂的特征关系。在两个注视坐标数据集上评估，该模型分别达到 AUC 分数 99.80% 和 99.86% 的最先进性能。它还分别表现出 98.45% 和 98.56% 的高准确率、98.01% 和 98.10% 的灵敏度，以及 98.74% 和 99.02% 的特异度。这些结果显著超过现有方法，证明其识别与 ASD 相关的细微注视模式的优越能力，突显了该模型用于临床 ASD 筛查的潜力。未来的工作将侧重于在更广泛人群中验证，并与多模态数据整合，以进一步完善诊断准确性。
